questions.question:
A state law prohibits the withdrawal of groundwater from any well within the state for use in another state. The express purpose of the law is to safeguard the supply of water for state citizens. Adoption of this state law followed enactment of a federal statute providing that "the transport of groundwater from one state to another may be restricted or prohibited in accordance with the laws of the state in which the water originates."
An association of water users in a neighboring state has filed suit to have the state law declared unconstitutional and enjoined on the ground that it violates the negative implications of the commerce clause.
Which of the following is the best argument supporting a motion to dismiss the lawsuit?

choices.a: Groundwater located within a state is not itself an article of interstate commerce, and therefore state regulation of the withdrawal of such groundwater does not implicate the commerce clause.
choices.b: The federal statute explicitly consents to a state's regulation of its groundwater in a way that would otherwise violate the negative implications of the commerce clause.
choices.c: The law promotes a compelling state interest that outweighs any burden on interstate commercial activity that might result from this state regulation of its groundwater.
choices.d: The Tenth Amendment reserves to the states plenary authority over the regulation of the natural resources located within their respective borders.

data.questionStem:
Q82029

A state law prohibits the withdrawal of groundwater from any well within the state for use in another state. The express purpose of the law is to safeguard the supply of water for state citizens. Adoption of this state law followed enactment of a federal statute providing that "the transport of groundwater from one state to another may be restricted or prohibited in accordance with the laws of the state in which the water originates."

An association of water users in a neighboring state has filed suit to have the state law declared unconstitutional and enjoined on the ground that it violates the negative implications of the commerce clause.

Which of the following is the best argument supporting a motion to dismiss the lawsuit?

一项州法律禁止从州内任何水井中抽取地下水用于他州。该法律的明确目的是保障本州公民的供水。这项州法律是在一项联邦法规颁布之后通过的，该联邦法规规定：“从一州到另一州的地下水运输，可根据水源所在州的法律进行限制或禁止。”

一个邻州的水用户协会提起诉讼，要求宣布该州法律违宪并予以禁止，理由是该法律违反了商业条款的消极默示 (negative implications of the commerce clause)。

以下哪项是支持驳回该诉讼动议的最佳论据？
options:
A. Groundwater located within a state is not itself an article of interstate commerce, and therefore state regulation of the withdrawal of such groundwater does not implicate the commerce clause.
位于一州内的地下水本身不构成州际贸易的物品，因此，州对抽取此类地下水的管制不涉及商业条款。

B. The federal statute explicitly consents to a state's regulation of its groundwater in a way that would otherwise violate the negative implications of the commerce clause.
联邦法规明确同意州对其地下水进行管制，即使这种管制方式在其他情况下会违反商业条款的消极默示。

C. The law promotes a compelling state interest that outweighs any burden on interstate commercial activity that might result from this state regulation of its groundwater.
该法律促进了一项压倒性的州利益，该利益超过了州对地下水的此项管制可能对州际商业活动造成的任何负担。

D. The Tenth Amendment reserves to the states plenary authority over the regulation of the natural resources located within their respective borders.
《第十修正案》为各州保留了管理其各自边界内自然资源的全权。
data.explanation:
Under the negative implications of the commerce clause (ie, the dormant commerce clause ), states are generally prohibited from unduly burdening interstate commerce. An undue burden can arise when a state discriminates against interstate commerce by favoring in-state over out-of-state economic interests. But such discrimination is permitted when Congress explicitly consents to the state's regulation.

Here, the state law discriminates against interstate commerce by prohibiting the withdrawal of in-state groundwater for out-of-state use. But since this law was adopted after the enactment of a federal statute that explicitly consents to such a regulation, the state law does not violate the negative implications of the commerce clause. Therefore, this is the best argument supporting the state's motion to dismiss the lawsuit.

(Choice A) An article of interstate commerce is anything that can be sold, exchanged, or transported between states - including natural resources like groundwater.

(Choice C) A nondiscriminatory state law is justified if the burdens on interstate commerce do not clearly exceed the law's local benefits. But a discriminatory state law (as seen here) cannot be justified on this basis.

(Choice D) The Tenth Amendment reserves to the states all powers that the Constitution does not expressly grant to the federal government - including the power to regulate in-state natural resources. But this power is not plenary (ie, absolute) since states must comply with other constitutional provisions (eg, the dormant commerce clause).

Educational objective: A state law that would ordinarily violate the dormant commerce clause is valid if an exception exists - eg, when Congress explicitly consents to such a law.



选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 70%（正确选项），C选项 15%，D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据商业条款的消极默示（即 休眠商业条款 dormant commerce clause），州通常被禁止对州际贸易施加不当负担。当一个州通过偏袒州内经济利益而歧视州际贸易时，就可能产生不当负担。但是，当国会明确同意州的该项管制时，这种歧视是被允许的。

在本案中，该州法律通过禁止抽取州内地下水供州外使用，从而歧视了州际贸易。但由于该法律是在一部联邦法规颁布后通过的，而该联邦法规明确同意此类管制，因此该州法律并未违反商业条款的消极默示。因此，这是支持州政府驳回诉讼动议的最佳论据。

(选项A) 州际贸易的物品是指可以在州与州之间销售、交换或运输的任何东西——包括像地下水这样的自然资源。

(选项C) 一项非歧视性的州法律是合理的，前提是其对州际贸易的负担没有明显超过该法律带来的地方利益。但是，一项歧视性的州法律（如本案所示）不能以此为由被认定为合理。

(选项D) 《第十修正案》将《宪法》未明确授予联邦政府的所有权力保留给各州——包括管制州内自然资源的权力。但这种权力并非全权（即，绝对的），因为各州必须遵守其他宪法规定（例如，休眠商业条款 dormant commerce clause）。

教学目标：一项通常会违反休眠商业条款的州法律，如果存在例外情况（例如，国会明确同意该法律），则是有效的。

References

  • U.S. Const. art. I, § 8, cl. 3 (commerce clause).
  • Ne. Bancorp, Inc. v. Bd. of Governors of Fed. Reserve Sys., 472 U.S. 159, 174 (1985) (asserting that states can discriminate against interstate commerce when Congress authorizes such action).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations & Commerce Clause

⚖️ 核心考点：国会同意权
休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause, DCC)
通常情况下，如果国会没有立法，各州不得通过歧视州际贸易或对其施加不当负担的法律。
例外：国会的同意 (Congressional Consent)
如果国会通过联邦法规，明确授权 (Explicitly Authorizes) 州政府对州际贸易进行某种限制，那么该州法律即使具有歧视性，也是合宪的。

💡 逻辑： 商业条款赋予国会管理州际贸易的权力。如果国会说“可以限制”，那么州就是在行使国会授予的权力，不再受“休眠”条款的限制。

🧠 解题逻辑流
州法律禁止地下水出口
↓
通常情况：违反 DCC (歧视性)
↓
关键事实：存在联邦法规授权
↓
结论：州法律有效 (Answer B)
✅ 选项 B 正确的原因

论据： 联邦法规明确同意 (Explicitly Consents) 州对其地下水进行管制。

解析：

  • 题目中提到联邦法规规定：“从一州到另一州的地下水运输，可根据...法律进行限制或禁止”。
  • 这构成了国会对州歧视性行为的明确许可。
  • 一旦获得国会许可，该州法律就不再受制于休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause) 的限制。
  • 因此，这是支持驳回原告诉讼（即支持州法律合宪）的最佳论据。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？

选项 A (地下水非商品)：错误

最高法院在 Sporhase v. Nebraska 案中已明确裁定，地下水 (Groundwater) 属于州际贸易的物品 (Article of Commerce)。因此，州对其管制必须遵守商业条款。

选项 C (压倒性州利益)：较弱

虽然保护水资源是重要利益，但该法律是歧视性 (Discriminatory) 的（只禁止出口，不禁止州内使用）。对于歧视性法律，通常适用严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)，很难通过。相比之下，选项 B 的“国会同意”是绝对的抗辩理由，无需进行复杂的利益平衡。

选项 D (第十修正案)：错误

第十修正案并非各州违反宪法其他条款（如商业条款）的“免死金牌”。虽然各州有权管理自然资源，但这种权力不能凌驾于联邦管理州际贸易的权力之上。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tips)
  • 扫描关键词： 看到 "State Law" 限制贸易 + "Federal Statute" 出现时，立刻警觉。
  • 判断顺序：
    1. 该州法律是否歧视州际贸易？(是)
    2. 国会是否批准了？(是 → 合宪)
    3. 如果国会没批准 → 几乎总是违宪 (除非通过严格审查)。
  • 陷阱： 不要被“自然资源”、“环境保护”等高尚目的迷惑，歧视性手段通常是违宪的，除非有国会撑腰。
MBE Constitutional Law Review
© 2025 Exam Prep Assistant

questions.question:
A state legislature conducted an investigation into a series of fatal accidents in the state involving commercial trucks with exteriors made of polished aluminum. The investigation revealed that the sun's glare reflecting off these trucks blinded the drivers of other vehicles. In response, the state's legislature enacted a law prohibiting commercial trucks with polished aluminum exteriors from traveling on the state's highways.
Litigation over the state law resulted in a final decision by the United States Supreme Court that the law impermissibly burdened interstate commerce and therefore was unconstitutional. Congress later enacted a statute permitting any state to enact a law regulating the degree of light reflectiveness of the exteriors of commercial trucks using the state's highways.
Is this federal statute constitutional?

choices.a: No, because Article III vests the judicial power in the federal courts, the essence of judicial power is the ability to render a final judgment, and this statute overrules a final judgment of the U.S. Supreme Court.
choices.b: No, because the U.S. Supreme Court has already determined that state laws of this type impermissibly burden interstate commerce.
choices.c: Yes, because Article I, Section 8 grants Congress authority to enact statutes authorizing states to impose burdens on interstate commerce that would otherwise be prohibited.
choices.d: Yes, because Article I, Section 8 grants Congress authority to enact statutes for the general welfare, and Congress could reasonably believe that state laws regulating the light reflectiveness of the exteriors of commercial trucks promote the general welfare.

Q82021

A state legislature conducted an investigation into a series of fatal accidents in the state involving commercial trucks with exteriors made of polished aluminum. The investigation revealed that the sun's glare reflecting off these trucks blinded the drivers of other vehicles. In response, the state's legislature enacted a law prohibiting commercial trucks with polished aluminum exteriors from traveling on the state's highways.

Litigation over the state law resulted in a final decision by the United States Supreme Court that the law impermissibly burdened interstate commerce and therefore was unconstitutional. Congress later enacted a statute permitting any state to enact a law regulating the degree of light reflectiveness of the exteriors of commercial trucks using the state's highways.

Is this federal statute constitutional?

某州立法机构对该州发生的一系列涉及外壳由抛光铝制成的商用卡车的致命事故进行了调查。调查显示，这些卡车反射的太阳眩光致使其他车辆的驾驶员目眩。作为回应，该州立法机构颁布了一项法律，禁止外壳由抛光铝制成的商用卡车在该州的高速公路上行驶。

围绕该州法律的诉讼，最终由 United States Supreme Court 作出终局裁决，认定该法律不当加重了州际商业的负担，因此违宪。随后，国会颁布了一项法规，允许任何州制定法律，以规制使用该州高速公路的商用卡车外壳的光反射度。

这项联邦法规是否合宪？
options:
A. No, because Article III vests the judicial power in the federal courts, the essence of judicial power is the ability to render a final judgment, and this statute overrules a final judgment of the U.S. Supreme Court.
否，因为 Article III 将司法权授予联邦法院，司法权的本质是作出终局判决的能力，而该法规推翻了 U.S. Supreme Court 的终局判决。

B. No, because the U.S. Supreme Court has already determined that state laws of this type impermissibly burden interstate commerce.
否，因为 U.S. Supreme Court 已经裁定，此类州法律不当加重了州际商业的负担。

C. Yes, because Article I, Section 8 grants Congress authority to enact statutes authorizing states to impose burdens on interstate commerce that would otherwise be prohibited.
是，因为 Article I, Section 8 授予国会权力，使其能够制定法规，授权各州对州际商业施加负担，而若无此授权，这些负担本应被禁止。

D. Yes, because Article I, Section 8 grants Congress authority to enact statutes for the general welfare, and Congress could reasonably believe that state laws regulating the light reflectiveness of the exteriors of commercial trucks promote the general welfare.
是，因为 Article I, Section 8 授予国会为普遍福利制定法规的权力，且国会有理由相信，规制商用卡车外壳光反射度的州法律能促进普遍福利。
data.explanation:
Commerce clause


(U.S. Const. art. I, § 8) Congress can regulate: Commerce clause
  • channels of interstate commerce
  • instrumentalities of interstate commerce
  • persons or things moving in interstate commerce
  • activities that substantially affect interstate commerce
States cannot : Dormant commerce clause
  • discriminate against interstate commerce
  • unduly burden interstate commerce
The state legislature enacted a law banning commercial trucks with aluminum exteriors from the state's highways. The U.S. Supreme Court then held that the law impermissibly burdened interstate commerce in violation of the dormant commerce clause.

But the commerce clause (in Article I, Section 8) gives Congress substantial authority to regulate interstate commerce. This includes the ability to share commerce power with the states by authorizing them to impose burdens on interstate commerce that would otherwise be prohibited by the dormant commerce clause. And since Congress used that power to later enact a statute permitting states to regulate the reflectiveness of commercial trucks on state highways, that statute is constitutional.

(Choices A & B) Article III grants federal courts judicial power, including the ability to render a final judgment. And here, the U.S. Supreme Court exercised that power by determining that the state law impermissibly burdened interstate commerce. But this did not preclude Congress from later exercising its commerce powers by authorizing states to impose such burdens.

(Choice D) The taxing and spending clause (in Article I, Section 8) only grants Congress the power to enact statutes to tax and spend for the general welfare - not to enact any type of statute.

Educational objective: The commerce clause grants Congress extensive power to regulate interstate commerce, including the power to authorize state legislation that would otherwise violate the dormant commerce clause.

选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 13%，C选项 64%（正确选项），D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Commerce clause


(U.S. Const. art. I, § 8) 国会可以规制： Commerce clause
  • 州际商业的渠道
  • 州际商业的工具
  • 在州际商业中流动的人员或物品
  • 实质性影响州际商业的活动
各州不能： Dormant commerce clause
  • 歧视州际商业
  • 过度加重州际商业的负担
州立法机构颁布了一项法律，禁止外壳由铝制成的商用卡车进入该州高速公路。U.S. Supreme Court 随后裁定，该法律违反了 dormant commerce clause，不当加重了州际商业的负担。

但是，commerce clause (见 Article I, Section 8) 赋予国会规制州际商业的实质性权力。这包括通过授权各州对州际商业施加负担，从而与各州分享商业权力的能力，而若无此授权，这些负担本应被 dormant commerce clause 禁止。并且，由于国会后来运用该权力颁布了一项法规，允许各州规制州高速公路上商用卡车的反射度，因此该法规是合宪的。

(选项 A & B) Article III 授予联邦法院司法权，包括作出终局判决的能力。在此案中，U.S. Supreme Court 通过裁定该州法律不当加重了州际商业的负担，行使了该权力。但这并不妨碍国会后来通过授权各州施加此类负担来行使其商业权力。

(选项 D) The taxing and spending clause (见 Article I, Section 8) 仅授予国会为普遍福利而征税和支出的权力，而非制定任何类型法规的权力。

教学目标：The commerce clause 授予国会规制州际商业的广泛权力，包括授权制定那些在无此授权时会违反 dormant commerce clause 的州立法。

References

S.-Cent. Timber Dev. v. Wunnicke, 467 U.S. 82, 87 - 88 (1984) (explaining that Congress can authorize states to regulate interstate commerce in a manner that would otherwise not be permissible).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations & Commerce Clause
核心考点：国会的授权权力

虽然各州不能违反休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause)，但国会拥有规制州际商业的绝对权力 (Plenary Power)。这意味着国会可以明确授权各州从事某些通常会被禁止的、加重州际商业负担的行为。

逻辑推演图解

1
初始状态：
州立法禁止抛光铝卡车。由于国会保持沉默，最高法院 (SCOTUS) 依据 Dormant Commerce Clause 裁定该州法律违宪（因为它不当加重了州际商业负担）。
▼
2
国会介入：
国会通过新法规，明确允许 (Permit) 各州规制卡车反光度。
▼
3
法律后果：
一旦国会给予授权，Dormant Commerce Clause 不再适用（因为它不再“休眠”）。各州的限制行为现在得到了联邦法律的支持，因此是合宪的。

选项深度解析

正确选项 C 法律依据：Article I, Section 8
这是本题的正确答案。国会根据商业条款 (Commerce Clause) 拥有规制州际商业的权力。这包括将权力下放给各州，允许各州实施若无国会批准则会被视为违宪的商业限制。

关键点：国会的许可可以“治愈”州法律对休眠商业条款的违反。
错误选项 A & B 关于司法终局性与既判力
这两个选项混淆了司法审查与立法变更。
最高法院之前的判决是基于当时国会“沉默”的状态。当国会通过新法打破沉默时，法律环境改变了。国会并没有“推翻”法院的判决，而是制定了新规则。法院之前的判决是正确的（基于当时的法律），但现在国会行使了宪法赋予的权力改变了规则。
错误选项 D 普遍福利条款 (General Welfare Clause) 陷阱
这是一个经典的 MBE 干扰项。Article I, Section 8 的“普遍福利条款”不是一个独立的立法授权（除了在联邦领地等极少数情况）。它必须与征税和支出权 (Taxing and Spending Power) 结合使用。国会不能仅为了“普遍福利”而制定规制性法律（Regulatory laws），必须依据具体的授权（如商业条款）。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
如果在 MBE 题目中看到：
  1. 最高法院说某州法律违反了 Dormant Commerce Clause；
  2. 随后国会通过法律批准了该州的行为；
那么该州的行为现在就是合宪的。记住：在商业领域，国会是最终的“老板”，它可以否决各州的限制，也可以批准各州的限制。

questions.question:
The United States Department of Energy regularly transports nuclear materials through a city on the way to a nuclear weapons processing plant it operates in a nearby state. The city recently adopted an ordinance prohibiting the transportation of any nuclear materials in or through the city. The ordinance declares that its purpose is to protect the health and safety of the residents of that city.
May the Department of Energy continue to transport these nuclear materials through the city?

choices.a: No, because the ordinance is rationally related to the public health and safety of the city's residents.
choices.b: No, because the Tenth Amendment reserves to the states certain unenumerated sovereign powers.
choices.c: Yes, because the Department of Energy is a federal agency engaged in a lawful federal function and, therefore, its activities may not be regulated by a local government without the consent of Congress.
choices.d: Yes, because the ordinance enacted by the city is invalid because it denies persons transporting such materials the equal protection of the laws.

美国能源部定期通过一个城市运输核材料，以运往其在邻近州运营的一家核武器处理厂。该市最近通过了一项法令，禁止在该市内或途经该市运输任何核材料。该法令宣称其目的是保护该市居民的健康和安全。

能源部是否可以继续通过该市运输这些核材料？
options:
A. No, because the ordinance is rationally related to the public health and safety of the city's residents.
不可以，因为该法令与该市居民的公共健康和安全具有理性关联。

B. No, because the Tenth Amendment reserves to the states certain unenumerated sovereign powers.
不可以，因为《Tenth Amendment》为各州保留了某些未明确列举的主权权力。

C. Yes, because the Department of Energy is a federal agency engaged in a lawful federal function and, therefore, its activities may not be regulated by a local government without the consent of Congress.
可以，因为能源部是一个正在履行合法联邦职能的联邦机构，因此，未经国会同意，其活动不受地方政府的监管。

D. Yes, because the ordinance enacted by the city is invalid because it denies persons transporting such materials the equal protection of the laws.
可以，因为该市颁布的法令是无效的，它剥夺了运输此类材料的人所享有的法律平等保护。
data.explanation:
Federal immunity from state & local taxes/regulations


Tax/regulationDefinitionPermissibility
DirectApplies to federal government - including its agencies & instrumentalitiesImmune unless Congress consents to tax/regulation
IndirectApplies to affiliates - including persons/entities employed by or doing business with federal governmentNot immune unless Congress grants immunity or tax/regulation discriminates against or substantially interferes with federal duties
Under the Article VI supremacy clause, the U.S. Constitution, federal laws, and treaties are the supreme law of the land. A corollary of this principle is that the federal government - including its agencies and instrumentalities - need not comply with a local tax or regulation unless Congress consents. This is because local laws could hinder or destroy the operations of the federal government.

Here, a city recently adopted an ordinance prohibiting the transportation of nuclear materials in or through the city. This hinders the operations of the U.S. Department of Energy since this federal agency is engaged in the lawful federal function of regularly transporting nuclear materials through the city. But since Congress did not consent to this regulation, the Department of Energy cannot be regulated by the city and may continue its operations.

(Choices A & D) Under the equal protection clause, state and local laws that do not substantially impact a fundamental right or protected class (as seen here) are subject to mere rational basis scrutiny. The city's ordinance satisfies this standard since it is rationally related to the public health and safety of its residents. Nevertheless, the federal agency is not subject to this regulation without congressional consent.

(Choice B) The Tenth Amendment reserves to state and local governments all powers not given to the federal government by the Constitution - including the police power to protect residents' health and safety. But when exercising such powers, these entities must comply with other constitutional provisions (eg, the supremacy clause).

Educational objective: The federal government - including its agencies and instrumentalities - is not subject to state and local taxes or regulations in the absence of congressional consent.

选项正确率统计：A选项 15%，B选项 4%，C选项 79%（正确选项），D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

联邦政府对州和地方税收/法规的豁免权


税收/法规定义许可性
直接适用于联邦政府——包括其机构和部门豁免，除非国会同意该税收/法规
间接适用于关联方——包括受雇于联邦政府或与联邦政府有业务往来的人员/实体不豁免，除非国会授予豁免权或该税收/法规歧视或严重干涉联邦职责
根据《Article VI》的至上条款 (supremacy clause)，美国宪法、联邦法律和条约是国家的最高法律。该原则的一个必然推论是，联邦政府——包括其机构和部门——无需遵守地方的税收或法规，除非国会同意。这是因为地方法律可能会阻碍或破坏联邦政府的运作。

在本案中，一个城市最近通过了一项法令，禁止在该市内或途经该市运输核材料。这阻碍了美国能源部的运作，因为该联邦机构正在履行定期通过该市运输核材料的合法联邦职能。但由于国会未同意此项法规，能源部不受该市监管，可以继续其运作。

(选项 A & D) 根据平等保护条款 (equal protection clause)，不严重影响基本权利或受保护阶层（如本案所示）的州和地方法律，仅需接受理性基础审查。该市的法令满足此标准，因为它与居民的公共健康和安全具有理性关联。然而，未经国会同意，该联邦机构不受此法规的约束。

(选项 B) 《Tenth Amendment》为州和地方政府保留了宪法未授予联邦政府的所有权力——包括保护居民健康和安全的警察权。但在行使此类权力时，这些实体必须遵守其他宪法规定（例如，至上条款 (supremacy clause)）。

教学目标：联邦政府——包括其机构和部门——在没有国会同意的情况下，不受州和地方税收或法规的约束。

References

McCulloch v. Maryland, 17 U.S. 316, 436 (1819) (establishing that states cannot directly tax or regulate the federal government, its agencies, or its instrumentalities).

Envtl. Prot. Agency v. California ex rel. St. Water Res. Control Bd., 426 U.S. 200, 211 (1976) (holding that states can directly regulate a federal agency only when Congress consents).

72 Am. Jur. 2d States, Territories, and Dependencies § 23 (2019) (explaining that federal agencies do not need to comply with state regulations).

MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations (Constitutional Law)
⚖️ 核心原则：政府间豁免权 (Intergovernmental Immunity)

根据美国宪法第六条的至上条款 (Supremacy Clause)，联邦政府及其机构 (Agencies and Instrumentalities) 在履行联邦职能时，免受州和地方政府的直接监管或税收，除非国会 (Congress) 明确表示同意。

Key Case: McCulloch v. Maryland (1819)

法律效力层级
联邦法律/机构 (Federal)
⬇️ 监管 (Regulate) ❌
州/地方法律 (State/Local)
未经国会同意，下级不可监管上级

📝 题目分析

事实：美国能源部 (Department of Energy, 联邦机构) 正在运输核材料（联邦职能）。某市通过法令禁止此类运输（地方监管）。

冲突：地方法令试图阻止联邦机构履行其职责。

结论：基于至上条款，联邦机构具有豁免权。无论地方法律的初衷多么合理（如为了安全），它都不能凌驾于联邦运作之上。

✅ 正确答案：选项 C

理由：能源部是联邦机构，运输核材料是其合法职能。根据至上条款，地方政府无权监管或禁止联邦机构的运作，除非国会给予了明确的“同意 (Consent)”。题目中未提及国会同意，因此该市法令对能源部无效。

❌ 选项 A 错误 (Police Power)

虽然州拥有警察权 (Police Power) 来保护居民健康和安全，但这种权力不能用来违反宪法。当州警察权与联邦豁免权冲突时，联邦地位至上。

❌ 选项 B 错误 (10th Amendment)

第十修正案保留了州的权力，但并没有赋予州凌驾于联邦政府之上的权力。它不能作为违反至上条款的借口。

❌ 选项 D 错误 (Equal Protection)

平等保护条款通常涉及对人的歧视。本案的核心是联邦制下的权力分配（结构性问题），而不是个人权利问题。

💡 MBE 答题锦囊

在处理 Federal-State Relations 问题时，请遵循以下步骤：

  1. 识别主体：是联邦机构还是私人？
  2. 识别行为：州/地方试图监管 (Regulate) 或 征税 (Tax) 联邦？
  3. 判断：如果是直接针对联邦机构的监管，除非题目明确说“国会同意”，否则一律选“无效”或“联邦豁免”。

记住口诀：States cannot mandate what the Feds must do.

questions.question:
A city in State X is a center for businesses that assemble personal computers. Components for these computers are manufactured elsewhere in State X and in other states, then shipped to the city, where the computers are assembled.
A city ordinance imposes a special license tax on all of the many companies engaged in the business of assembling computers in that city. The tax payable by each such company is a percentage of the company's gross receipts earned in the state.
A State X statute that authorizes municipalities to impose this license tax has a "State X content" provision. To comply with this provision of the state statute, the city license tax ordinance provides that the tax paid by any assembler of computers subject to this tax ordinance will be reduced by a percentage equal to the proportion of computer components manufactured in State X.
A company assembles computers in the city and sells them from its offices in the city to buyers throughout the United States. All of the components of its computers come from outside State X. Therefore, the company must pay the city license tax in full without receiving any refund. Other computer assemblers in the city use components manufactured in State X in varying proportions and, therefore, are entitled to partial reductions of their city license tax payments.
Following prescribed procedure, the company brings an action in a proper court asking to have the city's special license tax declared unconstitutional on the ground that it is inconsistent with the negative implications of the commerce clause.
In this case, should the court rule in favor of the company?

choices.a: No, because the commerce clause does not interfere with the right of a state to foster and support businesses located within its borders by encouraging its residents to purchase the products of those businesses.
choices.b: No, because the tax falls only on companies resident in State X and, therefore, does not discriminate against or otherwise adversely affect interstate commerce.
choices.c: Yes, because any tax on a company engaged in interstate commerce, measured in whole or in part by its gross receipts earned in the state, is a per se violation of the negative implications of the commerce clause.
choices.d: Yes, because the tax improperly discriminates against interstate commerce by treating in-state products more favorably than out-of-state products.

X州的一座城市是个人电脑组装业务的中心。这些电脑的组件在X州其他地方以及其他州生产，然后运到该市进行组装。

一项城市法令对所有在该市从事电脑组装业务的公司征收特别许可税。每家此类公司应付的税款是其在该州获得的总收入的一定百分比。

一项授权市政当局征收此许可税的X州法规中，有一项“X州内容”条款。为遵守该州法规的这项规定，该市的许可税法令规定，任何受此税收法令约束的电脑组装商所支付的税款，将按照其使用在X州制造的电脑组件的比例获得等额减免。

一家公司在该市组装电脑，并通过其在该市的办公室将其销售给全美国的买家。其电脑的所有组件都来自X州以外。因此，该公司必须全额支付城市许可税，无法获得任何退款。该市的其他电脑组装商则不同程度地使用了在X州制造的组件，因此有权获得部分城市许可税减免。

遵循法定程序，该公司向有管辖权的法院提起诉讼，请求以该市的特别许可税与商业条款(commerce clause)的负面含义不符为由，宣布其违宪。

在本案中，法院应作出对该公司有利的裁决吗？
options:
A. No, because the commerce clause does not interfere with the right of a state to foster and support businesses located within its borders by encouraging its residents to purchase the products of those businesses.
不应，因为商业条款(commerce clause)并不干涉州政府通过鼓励其居民购买境内企业产品来扶持和支持这些企业的权利。

B. No, because the tax falls only on companies resident in State X and, therefore, does not discriminate against or otherwise adversely affect interstate commerce.
不应，因为该税仅针对X州的常驻公司，因此并未歧视或对州际贸易造成其他不利影响。

C. Yes, because any tax on a company engaged in interstate commerce, measured in whole or in part by its gross receipts earned in the state, is a per se violation of the negative implications of the commerce clause.
应，因为任何对从事州际贸易的公司征收的、全部或部分基于其在州内总收入计算的税收，本身就构成了对商业条款(commerce clause)负面含义的当然违反(per se violation)。

D. Yes, because the tax improperly discriminates against interstate commerce by treating in-state products more favorably than out- of-state products.
应，因为该税收通过给予州内产品比州外产品更优惠的待遇，从而不当地歧视了州际贸易。
data.explanation:
The commerce clause gives Congress extensive power to regulate interstate commerce, which encompasses nearly all activities that affect two or more states. As a result, the negative implication of this clause - ie, the dormant commerce clause - prohibits states and municipalities from unduly burdening interstate commerce. A state or municipal tax on interstate commerce is an undue burden unless the tax:
  • is applied to persons or activities with a substantial nexus to the taxing state or municipality
  • is fairly apportioned to avoid taxing interstate activities performed in other states
  • does not discriminate by favoring local over out-of-state entities and
  • is fairly related to services and benefits provided by the taxing state or municipality.
Here, the city's license tax applies to all companies that assemble computers in the city (substantial nexus) at a percentage of their gross receipts (fairly apportioned). The tax is likely reasonable compared to the services provided by the city (fairly related). But it discriminates against interstate commerce by allowing companies to reduce their taxes by using computer components manufactured in the state, thereby treating in-state products more favorably than out-of-state products (Choice B). Therefore, the court should rule in favor of the company.

(Choice A) States and municipalities can encourage their residents to purchase products from businesses located within their borders. But these entities cannot violate the dormant commerce clause when doing so.

(Choice C) A tax on a company engaged in interstate commerce, measured in whole or in part by its gross receipts, is not a per se (ie, automatic) violation of the negative implications of the commerce clause. Instead, such a tax complies with the "fairly apportioned" requirement imposed by this clause.

Educational objective: A state or municipal tax on interstate commerce is valid if it is (1) levied on persons or activities that have a substantial nexus with the taxing entity, (2) fairly apportioned, (3) nondiscriminatory, and (4) fairly related to the services provided by the taxing entity.



选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 13%，C选项 6%，D选项 70%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

商业条款(commerce clause)赋予国会广泛的权力来管理州际贸易，这几乎涵盖了所有影响两个或更多州的活动。因此，该条款的负面含义——即休眠商业条款(dormant commerce clause)——禁止州和市政当局对州际贸易施加不当负担。州或市政当局对州际贸易征税构成不当负担，除非该税收：
  • 适用于与征税的州或市政当局有实质性联系(substantial nexus)的个人或活动
  • 被公平分配(fairly apportioned)，以避免对在其他州进行的州际活动征税
  • 不歧视，即不偏袒本地实体而排斥外州实体 并且
  • 与征税的州或市政当局提供的服务和利益合理相关(fairly related)。
在本案中，该市的许可税适用于所有在该市组装电脑的公司（具有实质性联系），税额为其总收入的一定百分比（公平分配）。与该市提供的服务相比，该税收可能是合理的（合理相关）。但它通过允许公司使用本州制造的电脑组件来减税，从而歧视了州际贸易，这给予了州内产品比州外产品更优惠的待遇（选项B）。因此，法院应作出对该公司有利的裁决。

（选项A）州和市政当局可以鼓励其居民购买境内企业的产品。但这些实体在这样做时不能违反休眠商业条款(dormant commerce clause)。

（选项C）对从事州际贸易的公司征收的、全部或部分基于其总收入计算的税收，并非对商业条款(commerce clause)负面含义的当然（即自动）违反。相反，这样的税收符合该条款所要求的“公平分配”要求。

教学目标：州或市政当局对州际贸易的征税在以下情况下是有效的：（1）对与征税实体有实质性联系的个人或活动征收，（2）公平分配，（3）非歧视性，以及（4）与征税实体提供的服务合理相关。

References

  • U.S. Const. art. I, § 8, cl. 3 (commerce clause).
  • Complete Auto Transit, Inc. v. Brady, 430 U.S. 274, 279 (1977) (setting forth the four-factor test used to determine if a state or municipal tax violates the dormant commerce clause).
  • 71 Am. Jur. 2d State and Local Taxation § 168 (2019) (explaining that a state tax favoring in-state over out-of-state economic interests is invalid).

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law: Dormant Commerce Clause
✅ 正确答案：选项 D

法院应裁定公司胜诉，因为该税收通过给予州内产品比州外产品更优惠的待遇，构成了对州际贸易的不当歧视。

⚖️ 法律依据：休眠商业条款

本题考查的是休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause) 对州政府征税权的限制。

根据最高法院在 Complete Auto Transit, Inc. v. Brady (1977) 确立的标准，一项针对州际贸易的州税必须满足以下四个条件才合宪：

  1. 实质性联系 (Substantial Nexus)： 纳税人与征税州有足够的物理或经济联系。
  2. 公平分配 (Fair Apportionment)： 税收必须根据在该州发生的活动比例进行分配。
  3. 非歧视性 (Non-discrimination)： 这是本题的关键。税收不得偏袒州内利益而损害州外利益。
  4. 合理相关 (Fair Relationship)： 税收与州提供的服务（如警察、消防、道路）合理相关。
🔍 案情深度分析

在本案中，该市的税收制度包含一个“本地成分”条款 (State X content provision)：

  • 如果组装商使用本州 (State X) 制造的零件，可以减税。
  • 如果组装商使用外州 制造的零件，必须全额纳税。

这种机制在法律上被称为“表面歧视” (Facial Discrimination)。它实际上充当了针对外州产品的关税，通过税收优惠诱导企业购买本地产品，从而惩罚购买外州产品的行为。

结论： 这种赤裸裸的经济保护主义 (Economic Protectionism) 是休眠商业条款最核心禁止的行为，因此该税收违宪。

⚠️ 常见陷阱与错误选项

为什么选项 C 是错的？

很多考生看到“总收入税 (Gross Receipts Tax)”就以为违宪。其实，只要税收经过公平分配 (Fairly Apportioned)，即只对在该州产生的收入部分征税，它就是合法的。本题中税收违宪的原因是歧视，而不是因为它是基于总收入计算的。

为什么选项 A 是错的？

虽然州可以作为市场参与者 (Market Participant) 购买本地产品（例如州政府自己买电脑时只买本地的），但当州作为监管者 (Regulator) 征税时，不能通过税收手段来“扶持”本地企业打压外地竞争对手。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理涉及州税收 (State Taxation) 的题目时，请按以下顺序检查：

  1. 是否歧视？ (Discriminatory?) —— 如果税法条款明确写着“本州产品税率低”或“外州产品税率高”，这通常直接违宪（除非有极严格的理由，但MBE中极少见）。
  2. 是否重复征税？ (Apportionment?) —— 如果没有歧视，检查是否对同一笔收入在两个州重复征税。

本题在第一步“歧视”环节就已经违宪，因此直接选 D。

questions.question:
A state enacted a statute requiring the state's appointed presidential electors to swear an oath that they will cast their electoral votes for the presidential and vice-presidential nominees chosen by the popular vote of the state. A provision of the statute provides that an elector who breaks this oath and votes for another candidate will be removed and replaced as an elector and fined $1,000.
Three appointed electors in the state swore the oath as required by the statute. When the time came to cast their electoral votes, however, the electors voted for a presidential candidate who was not chosen by the state's popular vote. The state removed the electors and replaced them with alternates. The state also fined each elector $1,000.
The three electors sued the state in state court, claiming that the statute governing presidential electors violates the United States Constitution.
How should the court rule on the constitutionality of the state statute?

choices.a: The provision imposing a monetary fine on the electors is an unconstitutional bill of attainder.
choices.b: The provision allowing the removal of electors violates their fundamental right to vote.
choices.c: The provision requiring electors to swear an oath violates their First Amendment right to free speech and association.
choices.d: The statute is constitutional in its entirety.

Q82010

A state enacted a statute requiring the state's appointed presidential electors to swear an oath that they will cast their electoral votes for the presidential and vice-presidential nominees chosen by the popular vote of the state. A provision of the statute provides that an elector who breaks this oath and votes for another candidate will be removed and replaced as an elector and fined $1,000.

Three appointed electors in the state swore the oath as required by the statute. When the time came to cast their electoral votes, however, the electors voted for a presidential candidate who was not chosen by the state's popular vote. The state removed the electors and replaced them with alternates. The state also fined each elector $1,000.

The three electors sued the state in state court, claiming that the statute governing presidential electors violates the United States Constitution.

How should the court rule on the constitutionality of the state statute?

某州颁布了一项法规，要求该州指定的总统选举人宣誓，他们将为本州普选选出的总统和副总统候选人投下选举人票。该法规的一项条款规定，违反此誓言并投票给另一位候选人的选举人，将被免职并由他人接替，同时处以1000美元罚款。

该州三名指定的选举人按照法规要求宣了誓。然而，在投下选举人票时，这些选举人投票给了一位未经该州普选选出的总统候选人。该州罢免了这些选举人，并以候补人选接替。该州还对每位选举人处以1000美元罚款。

这三名选举人在州法院起诉该州，声称管辖总统选举人的法规违反了美国宪法。

法院应如何裁定该州法规的合宪性？
options:
A. The provision imposing a monetary fine on the electors is an unconstitutional bill of attainder.
对选举人处以金钱罚款的条款是一项违宪的剥夺公权法案（bill of attainder）。

B. The provision allowing the removal of electors violates their fundamental right to vote.
允许罢免选举人的条款侵犯了他们的基本投票权。

C. The provision requiring electors to swear an oath violates their First Amendment right to free speech and association.
要求选举人宣誓的条款侵犯了他们根据First Amendment所享有的言论自由和结社自由权。

D. The statute is constitutional in its entirety.
该法规整体上是合宪的。
data.explanation:
Every four years, the United States holds a presidential and vice-presidential election. When citizens cast their ballots, they are selecting members of the Electoral College. These presidential electors then vote to determine the next President and Vice President. This process is governed by the following constitutional provisions:

  • Article II - grants state legislatures the power to appoint an allotted number of presidential electors in any manner.†
  • Twelfth Amendment - requires electors to meet in their states , vote separately for President and Vice President, and transmit sealed lists of their votes to the U.S. Senate to be officially counted.


The power to appoint electors also permits states to place conditions on such appointments so long as the conditions do not violate another constitutional provision. Permissible conditions include requiring electors to pledge or swear an oath that they will cast their electoral vote for the candidate chosen by the popular vote. States can also punish an elector who violates the pledge or oath by removing the elector and/or imposing a monetary fine. Therefore, the state statute here is constitutional in its entirety.

†States cannot appoint as electors those who serve in the U.S. Senate or House of Representatives or who hold any other federal office.

(Choice A) A bill of attainder is an unconstitutional legislative act that declares a named person or group guilty of a crime (not seen here) and imposes punishment without a trial.

(Choice B) U.S. citizens who are 18 or older have the fundamental right to vote in federal, state, and local elections. However, this fundamental right does not extend to presidential electors casting electoral votes.

(Choice C) The First Amendment right to free speech and association bars the government from conditioning government employment or office on an overbroad or vague loyalty oath. Here, the oath is not overbroad since it focuses on how electors must vote. It is also not vague since a reasonable person would understand it.

Educational objective: States have power to appoint presidential electors and place conditions on such appointments. Such conditions may include requiring electors to swear an oath that they will cast their electoral vote for the candidate chosen by the state's popular vote and punishing electors who violate this oath through removal and/or a monetary fine.



选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 22%，C选项 8%，D选项 59%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

美国每四年举行一次总统和副总统选举。当公民投票时，他们是在选择选举人团（Electoral College）的成员。这些总统选举人随后投票决定下一任总统和副总统。该过程受以下宪法条款管辖：

  • Article II - 授予州立法机构以任何方式任命指定数量的总统选举人的权力。†
  • Twelfth Amendment - 要求选举人在其所在州集会，分别投票选举总统和副总统，并将密封的选票名单送交美国参议院进行正式计票。


任命选举人的权力也允许各州对此类任命附加条件，只要这些条件不违反其他宪法条款。允许的条件包括要求选举人保证或宣誓，他们将为普选选出的候选人投下选举人票。各州还可以通过罢免选举人和/或处以金钱罚款的方式，来惩罚违反保证或誓言的选举人。因此，本案中的州法规整体上是合宪的。

†各州不得任命在美国参议院或众议院任职，或担任任何其他联邦职务的人为选举人。

(选项 A) 剥夺公权法案（bill of attainder）是一种违宪的立法行为，它不经审判即宣布特定个人或团体有罪（本案中未见）并施加惩罚。

(选项 B) 年满18岁的美国公民拥有在联邦、州和地方选举中的基本投票权。然而，这项基本权利并不延伸至投下选举人票的总统选举人。

(选项 C) First Amendment所保障的言论自由和结社自由权，禁止政府以过于宽泛或含糊的忠诚誓言作为担任政府公职或职位的条件。在本案中，该誓言并不宽泛，因为它集中于选举人必须如何投票。它也不含糊，因为一个通情达理的人能够理解其内容。

教学目标： 各州有权任命总统选举人，并对此类任命附加条件。这些条件可包括要求选举人宣誓，保证为本州普选选出的候选人投下选举人票，并通过罢免和/或罚款的方式惩罚违反此誓言的选举人。

References

  • U.S. Const. art. II, § 1, cl. 2 (appointing presidential electors).
  • U.S. Const. amend. XII (electoral college voting procedure).
  • Chiafalo v. Washington, 140 S. Ct. 2316, 2320 (2020) (holding that a state may penalize a presidential elector for breaking his/her pledge to cast a vote for the candidate who wins that state's popular vote).

MBE 考点解析

宪法：联邦与州的关系 / 选举人团
正确答案：D 该法规整体上是合宪的 (The statute is constitutional in its entirety)。
⚖️ 核心法律依据
Chiafalo v. Washington (2020)

这是本题直接对应的最高法院判例。法院一致裁定：州政府有权惩罚“失信选举人” (Faithless Electors)。

本题考察的是美国宪法 Article II, Section 1 赋予各州立法机关任命总统选举人 (Presidential Electors) 的权力范围。

1. 州的广泛权力：
宪法规定，各州应按照其立法机关所指示的方式 ("in such Manner as the Legislature thereof may direct") 任命选举人。最高法院解释称，这种权力非常广泛，不仅包括选择谁做选举人，还包括对选举人施加条件。

2. 历史与先例：
虽然建国初期的设想是选举人应独立行使判断力，但历史实践早已演变为选举人仅仅是代表本州普选结果的代理人。因此，州可以要求选举人宣誓 (Pledge/Oath) 支持普选获胜者。

3. 强制执行权：
既然州有权要求选举人宣誓，那么州也就有权通过罢免 (Removal) 和罚款 (Fine) 等手段来强制执行这一要求。如果选举人违反誓言（即成为“失信选举人”），州政府对其进行处罚并不违宪。

❌ 干扰项解析
选项 A (Bill of Attainder) 错误： 剥夺公权法案是指立法机关不经审判直接宣布特定的人或群体有罪并施加惩罚。本案中的法规是普遍适用的规则（任何违反誓言的选举人都会受罚），而非针对特定个人的立法惩罚，因此不构成 Bill of Attainder。
选项 B (Right to Vote) 错误： 虽然公民有基本投票权，但选举人 (Electors) 在行使职能时是作为州的官员或代表，而不是作为个人行使私人投票权。州有权指导其官员如何履职。
选项 C (First Amendment) 错误： 选举人的投票行为被视为一种公共职能 (Public Function)，而非个人的言论表达。因此，州要求选举人按照普选结果投票并不侵犯其个人的言论或结社自由。
💡 MBE 备考锦囊

关注近期判例： 本题直接取材于 2020 年的 Chiafalo v. Washington 案。MBE 宪法部分有时会考察相对较新的最高法院判决。

区分角色： 在做选举权相关题目时，务必区分普通选民 (Voters) 的权利和总统选举人 (Electors) 的职责。前者享有严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny) 保护的基本权利，而后者更多受制于州立法机关的 Article II 权力。

questions.question:
State A requires commercial airlines to pay an annual property tax based on the value of the airline's fleet of planes that operate in the state. The tax is calculated by multiplying the percentage of the airline's annual arrivals and departures in the state by the fleet's overall value. The airline's fleet of planes is based in State B. Ten percent of the airline's annual arrivals and departures occur in State A. The airline has sued to challenge the State A tax, arguing that it is unconstitutional.
Is the state tax likely constitutional?

choices.a: No, because Congress has the sole power to tax property moving in interstate commerce.
choices.b: No, because the airline's fleet is based in State B.
choices.c: Yes, because it does not place an undue burden on interstate commerce in violation of the negative implications of the commerce clause.
choices.d: Yes, because states have plenary authority to construct their tax system in any manner they choose.

State A requires commercial airlines to pay an annual property tax based on the value of the airline's fleet of planes that operate in the state. The tax is calculated by multiplying the percentage of the airline's annual arrivals and departures in the state by the fleet's overall value. The airline's fleet of planes is based in State B. Ten percent of the airline's annual arrivals and departures occur in State A. The airline has sued to challenge the State A tax, arguing that it is unconstitutional.

Is the state tax likely constitutional?

A州要求商业航空公司根据其在该州运营的机队价值缴纳年度财产税。该税收的计算方法是，将该航空公司在该州的年度进出港航班百分比乘以其机队的总价值。该航空公司的机队基地位于B州。该航空公司百分之十的年度进出港航班发生在A州。该航空公司已提起诉讼，以该税收违宪为由对其提出质疑。

该州税法可能合宪吗？
options:
A. No, because Congress has the sole power to tax property moving in interstate commerce.
不合宪，因为国会拥有对跨州际商业流动的财产征税的专属权力。

B. No, because the airline's fleet is based in State B.
不合宪，因为该航空公司的机队基地位于B州。

C. Yes, because it does not place an undue burden on interstate commerce in violation of the negative implications of the commerce clause.
合宪，因为它没有对州际商业构成不当负担，从而没有违反商业条款的负面含义。

D. Yes, because states have plenary authority to construct their tax system in any manner they choose.
合宪，因为各州拥有以其选择的任何方式构建其税收制度的全权。
data.explanation:
A state tax on the value of property in the state (ie, ad valorem property tax) is generally valid. But when this property moves in interstate commerce (eg, planes), the state tax must comply with the negative implication of the commerce clause.† This prohibits states from discriminating against or unduly burdening interstate commerce. As a result, this type of state tax is valid when :
  • the state has a substantial nexus with the taxed property, which is established when the property has sufficient contacts with the state such that the property has acquired a taxable situs in the state
  • the tax is fairly apportioned based on the amount of time that the taxed property is in the state
  • the tax is not discriminatory against interstate commerce and
  • the tax is fairly related to the benefits or services provided by the taxing state (Choice A).


Here, there is a substantial nexus between State A and the airline since 10% of the airline's annual arrivals and departures occur in the state (taxable situs) (Choice B). The tax is fairly apportioned because it is based on the percentage of the airline's annual arrivals and departures in the state. It is nondiscriminatory since it applies equally to intrastate and interstate commerce. And the tax is fairly related to the benefits provided by the state (eg, use of airport). Therefore, the state tax does not unduly burden interstate commerce and is likely constitutional.

†A state tax on property permanently located in another state is unconstitutional since the taxing state lacks jurisdiction over the property.

(Choice D) The Tenth Amendment reserves to the states any power that the Constitution does not expressly grant to the federal government, including the power to construct a state tax system. But this power is not plenary (ie, absolute) because states must comply with other constitutional provisions.

Educational objective: A state tax on property moving in interstate commerce is valid if:
  • (1) the state has a substantial nexus with the taxed property such that the property has a taxable situs in the state,
  • (2) the tax is fairly apportioned,
  • (3) the tax is nondiscriminatory, and
  • (4) the tax is fairly related to benefits or services provided by the state.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

对州内财产价值征收的州税（即从价财产税）通常是有效的。但是，当此财产在州际商业中流动时（例如，飞机），州税必须符合商业条款的负面含义。† 这禁止各州歧视或对州际商业施加不当负担。因此，此类州税在以下情况下是有效的：
  • 州与被征税财产有实质性联系（substantial nexus），这种联系在财产与该州有足够的接触，从而使财产在该州获得应税所在地（taxable situs）资格时成立
  • 税收根据被征税财产在该州停留的时间进行公平分摊
  • 税收对州际商业不具有歧视性 并且
  • 税收与征税州提供的利益或服务公平相关 （选项A）。


在本案中，A州与该航空公司之间存在实质性联系，因为该航空公司10%的年度进出港航班发生在该州（应税所在地）（选项B）。该税收是公平分摊的，因为它是基于该航空公司在该州的年度进出港航班的百分比。它不具歧视性，因为它同等适用于州内和州际商业。并且，该税收与该州提供的利益（例如，使用机场）公平相关。因此，该州税没有对州际商业造成不当负担，并且可能是合宪的。

†对永久位于另一州的财产征收州税是违宪的，因为征税州对该财产没有管辖权。

（选项D） Tenth Amendment（第十修正案）将《宪法》未明确授予联邦政府的任何权力保留给各州，包括构建州税收制度的权力。但这种权力并非全权（即绝对的），因为各州必须遵守其他宪法规定。

教学目标：对在州际商业中流动的财产征收州税，在以下情况下是有效的：
  • (1) 州与被征税财产有实质性联系，从而使财产在该州获得应税所在地资格，
  • (2) 税收是公平分摊的，
  • (3) 税收不具有歧视性，以及
  • (4) 税收与州提供的利益或服务公平相关。


References

  • Complete Auto Transit, Inc. v. Brady, 430 U.S. 274, 279 (1977) (setting forth the four-factor test used to determine if a state tax violates the commerce clause).
  • Braniff Airways, Inc. v. Neb. State Bd. of Equalization and Assessment, 347 U.S. 590, 599 - 601 (1954) (holding that a state ad valorem property tax on an airline's fleet was valid since the airline had a taxable situs in the state).
  • 71 Am. Jur. 2d State and Local Taxation § 163 (2020) (explaining that states may levy taxes on instrumentalities of commerce when they have a taxable situs in the state and the tax is fairly apportioned to their time in the state).

MBE 考点解析

宪法：州际商业的州税收
✅ 正确答案：选项 C

合宪，因为该税收没有对州际商业构成不当负担（Undue Burden），符合商业条款的负面含义（Negative Implications of the Commerce Clause）。

核心规则：Complete Auto 测试

根据最高法院在 Complete Auto Transit, Inc. v. Brady 案中确立的标准，州政府对从事州际商业的财产征税必须满足以下四个条件才合宪：

实质性联系 (Substantial Nexus)
被征税对象必须与该州有足够的物理接触或商业活动。
公平分摊 (Fair Apportionment)
税收必须根据该财产在州内的活动比例进行计算，不能对同一价值重复征税。
非歧视性 (Nondiscrimination)
不能偏袒州内企业而歧视州外企业。
公平相关性 (Fair Relationship)
税收必须与州提供的公共服务（如警察、消防、道路）合理相关。
本案逻辑推演

本题考察的是对移动中的商业工具（Instrumentalities of Commerce，如飞机、卡车、船舶）征收从价财产税（Ad Valorem Property Tax）。

✈️ 关键事实应用：

  1. 联系 (Nexus)： 航空公司有10%的航班在A州起降。这建立了足够的“应税所在地”（Taxable Situs）。
  2. 分摊 (Apportionment)： A州并没有对飞机总价值全额征税，而是乘以了进出港百分比。这完全符合公平分摊原则。

因此，该税收没有对州际商业造成不当负担，是合宪的。

❌ 为什么 A 错误？

国会没有“专属”征税权。 虽然国会监管州际商业，但只要州税收符合上述四个条件，各州拥有并发权力（Concurrent Power）进行征税。

❌ 为什么 B 错误？

基地（Domicile）不是唯一征税地。 虽然B州作为基地州可以征税，但其他州只要满足“公平分摊”原则，也可以对在该州运营的部分价值征税。如果只允许基地州征税，就违背了分摊原则。

❌ 为什么 D 错误？

州权力不是绝对的（Plenary）。 州的征税权受到美国宪法（特别是商业条款和正当程序条款）的限制。州不能“随心所欲”地构建税收系统。

💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到“州税”+“跨州业务”的题目，立即联想 Complete Auto 四要素测试。只要税收是“分摊”的（Apportioned），通常都是合宪的。

questions.question:
A federal statute provides that the cities in which certain specified airports are located may regulate the rates and services of all limousines that serve those airports, without regard to the origin or destination of the passengers who use the limousines.
A city in State A is located adjacent to a city in State B. The airport serving both of them is located in the State A city and is one of those airports specified in the federal statute. The State A city council has adopted a rule that requires any limousines serving the airport to charge only the rates authorized by the State A city council.
An airline limousine service has a lucrative business transporting passengers between the State B city and the airport in the State A city, at much lower rates than those required by the State A city council. It transports passengers in interstate traffic only; it does not provide local service within the State A city. The new rule adopted by the State A city council will require the limousine service to charge the same rates as limousines operating only in the State A city.
Must the airline limousine service comply with the new rule of the State A city council?

choices.a: No, because the airline limousine service is engaged in interstate commerce and this rule is an undue burden on that commerce.
choices.b: No, because the rule would arbitrarily destroy a lucrative existing business and, therefore, would amount to a taking without just compensation.
choices.c: Yes, because Congress has authorized this form of regulation by the State A city and, therefore, removed any constitutional impediments to it that may have otherwise existed.
choices.d: Yes, because the airport is located in the State A city and, therefore, its city council has exclusive regulatory authority over all transportation to and from the airport.

一项联邦法规规定，某些特定机场所在的城市可以监管为这些机场服务的所有豪华轿车的费率和服务，无论使用这些豪华轿车的乘客的出发地或目的地为何。

A州的一座城市与B州的一座城市相邻。为这两座城市服务的机场位于A州的城市内，并且是联邦法规中指定的机场之一。A州市议会通过了一项规定，要求所有为该机场服务的豪华轿车只能收取A州市议会授权的费率。

一家航空公司豪华轿车服务公司有一项利润丰厚的业务，即在B州城市与A州城市的机场之间运送乘客，其收费远低于A州市议会要求的费率。该公司只从事州际客运业务；它不提供A州城市内的本地服务。A州市议会通过的这项新规将要求该豪华轿车服务公司收取与仅在A州城市运营的豪华轿车相同的费率。

该航空公司豪华轿车服务公司是否必须遵守A州市议会的新规定？
options:
A. No, because the airline limousine service is engaged in interstate commerce and this rule is an undue burden on that commerce.
不，因为该航空公司豪华轿车服务从事的是州际商业，而这项规定对该商业构成了不当负担。

B. No, because the rule would arbitrarily destroy a lucrative existing business and, therefore, would amount to a taking without just compensation.
不，因为该规定将任意摧毁一项利润丰厚的现有业务，因此，这将构成没有公正补偿的征用。

C. Yes, because Congress has authorized this form of regulation by the State A city and, therefore, removed any constitutional impediments to it that may have otherwise existed.
是，因为国会已授权A州城市进行此种形式的监管，因此消除了任何可能存在的宪法障碍。

D. Yes, because the airport is located in the State A city and, therefore, its city council has exclusive regulatory authority over all transportation to and from the airport.
是，因为机场位于A州城市，因此，其市议会对所有往返机场的交通拥有专属监管权。
data.explanation:
The commerce clause empowers Congress to regulate interstate commerce - ie, nearly all activities involving two or more states. This clause also carries a negative implication (ie, the dormant commerce clause ) that prohibits states and municipalities from discriminating against or otherwise unduly burdening interstate commerce. But Congress can exercise its broad commerce power to explicitly authorize conduct that would otherwise violate the dormant commerce clause.

Here, the State A city council rule requires all airport limousine services to charge only the rates authorized by the city council. It can be presumed that this rule unduly burdens interstate commerce because it regulates economic activities between State A and State B. But since Congress explicitly authorized this type of regulation by the State A city (via the federal statute), any constitutional impediments that may have existed were removed (Choice A). As a result, the interstate limousine service must comply with the State A city rule.

(Choice B) A regulation that destroys all economic value of a business will be deemed a taking. Here, there is no evidence that the interstate limousine service's business will be destroyed by the higher rates, so the State A city council rule is not a taking. And even if it was, this would only allow the limousine service to seek just compensation (ie, fair market value at the time of the taking) - not to ignore the rule.

(Choice D) The city council's regulatory authority over transportation to and from the airport located in the city is not exclusive. Instead, this authority is shared with State A and the federal government.

Educational objective: Congress can explicitly authorize states and municipalities to act in ways that would otherwise violate the dormant commerce clause.



选项正确率统计：A选项 28%，B选项 0%，C选项 63%（正确选项），D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

商业条款 (Commerce Clause) 授权国会监管州际商业——即几乎所有涉及两个或多个州的活动。该条款还带有一个负面含义（即休眠商业条款 (dormant commerce clause)），它禁止州和市政府歧视或以其他方式对州际商业造成不当负担。但是，国会可以行使其广泛的商业权力，明确授权那些在其他情况下会违反休眠商业条款的行为。

在此案中，A州市议会的规定要求所有机场豪华轿车服务只能收取市议会授权的费率。可以推定该规定对州际商业构成了不当负担，因为它监管了A州和B州之间的经济活动。但由于国会（通过该联邦法规）已明确授权A市进行此类监管，任何可能存在的宪法障碍都已被消除（选项A）。因此，该州际豪华轿车服务公司必须遵守A州市的规定。

（选项B）一项摧毁企业全部经济价值的法规将被视为一次征用。在此案中，没有证据表明该州际豪华轿车服务公司的业务将因费率提高而被摧毁，因此A州市议会的规定不构成征用。即使构成征用，这也只允许该豪华轿车服务公司寻求公正补偿（即征用时的公平市场价值）——而不是无视该规定。

（选项D）市议会对于位于其市内的机场往返交通的监管权并非专属。相反，该权力是与A州和联邦政府共享的。

教学目标：国会可以明确授权州和市政府以在其他情况下会违反休眠商业条款的方式行事。

References

U.S. Const. art. I, § 8, cl. 3 (commerce clause).

Ne. Bancorp v. Bd. of Governors of Fed. Reserve Sys., 472 U.S. 159, 174 (1985) (setting forth that states can discriminate against interstate commerce when Congress authorizes such action).

15A Am. Jur. 2d Commerce § 27 (2019) (explaining that Congress can authorize state action that would ordinarily violate the dormant commerce clause).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations / Commerce Clause
核心考点：国会授权 (Congressional Authorization)
虽然休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause) 通常禁止州政府对州际商业施加不当负担，但国会 (Congress) 拥有监管州际商业的最高权力。如果国会通过立法明确授权 (Explicitly Authorize) 州政府进行某种监管，那么该州政府的行为就不再受休眠商业条款的限制。
解题逻辑推演
1
识别州际商业：
豪华轿车在A州和B州之间运送乘客，这显然属于州际商业 (Interstate Commerce)。
2
分析默认规则 (DCC)：
如果没有联邦法律，A市强行规定跨州服务的费率，很可能因为对州际商业构成“不当负担” (Undue Burden) 而违宪。
3
寻找关键例外 (Key Fact)：
题目第一段明确指出：“一项联邦法规规定……城市可以监管……无论乘客的出发地或目的地为何。”
4
得出结论：
因为有国会的明确授权 (Federal Statute)，A市的规定获得了宪法上的“通行证”。休眠商业条款的限制被移除了。
选项深度解析
✅ 选项 C (正确答案)
理由：直接击中考点。国会已授权 (Authorized) 这种形式的监管。当国会行使其商业条款权力授权州行为时，该州行为就不受休眠商业条款的攻击。
❌ 选项 A (常见陷阱)
理由：这是典型的“休眠商业条款”分析。如果没有那个联邦法规，选项A就是对的。但在本题中，它忽略了国会授权这一关键事实。
❌ 选项 B (征用条款)
理由：涉及第五修正案的征用条款 (Takings Clause)。仅仅因为监管导致利润下降并不构成征用。只有当法规剥夺了财产的“所有经济价值”时，才可能构成监管性征用 (Regulatory Taking)。
❌ 选项 D (专属管辖权)
理由：法律上并不存在仅仅因为机场位于某市，该市就对所有交通拥有“专属 (Exclusive)”监管权的规则。这种权力通常是共享的，且受制于联邦法律。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 在处理涉及州政府监管商业的题目时：
  1. 首先看是否有联邦法律 (Federal Statute) 授权或禁止该行为。
  2. 如果有联邦授权，州行为通常有效（国会说了算）。
  3. 如果没有联邦法律，才去分析休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause) 是否被违反（即是否存在歧视或不当负担）。

口诀：国会开口，DCC (休眠商业条款) 闭嘴。

questions.question:
A state owned a large natural gas field and took bids for its exploitation. The highest bid came from an interstate pipeline company that distributed natural gas to providers throughout the country. A local gas company submitted the next highest bid, which included the commitment that it would pass along to local customers any savings if it was awarded the contract. The state awarded the contract to the local company.
The interstate company sued to overturn this decision.
Should the interstate company prevail?

choices.a: No, because the state acted as a market participant.
choices.b: No, because the state has a compelling interest in reducing the cost of gas for state citizens.
choices.c: Yes, because the state acted irrationally by not choosing the highest bidder and thus denied the interstate company due process of law.
choices.d: Yes, because the state discriminated against interstate commerce.

data.questionStem:
Q82043

A state owned a large natural gas field and took bids for its exploitation. The highest bid came from an interstate pipeline company that distributed natural gas to providers throughout the country. A local gas company submitted the next highest bid, which included the commitment that it would pass along to local customers any savings if it was awarded the contract. The state awarded the contract to the local company.

The interstate company sued to overturn this decision.

Should the interstate company prevail?

一个州拥有一座大型天然气田，并为其开采进行招标。出价最高的是一家州际管道公司，该公司向全国各地的供应商分销天然气。一家本地天然气公司提交了次高报价，其中包括一项承诺，即如果其获得合同，它将把任何节省的成本转让给本地客户。该州将合同授予了本地公司。

州际公司提起诉讼，要求推翻这一决定。

州际公司应该会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the state acted as a market participant.
不应胜诉，因为该州是作为市场参与者行事。

B. No, because the state has a compelling interest in reducing the cost of gas for state citizens.
不应胜诉，因为该州在为州内公民降低天然气成本方面拥有强制性利益（compelling interest）。

C. Yes, because the state acted irrationally by not choosing the highest bidder and thus denied the interstate company due process of law.
应该胜诉，因为该州没有选择最高出价者，其行为不理性，从而剥夺了州际公司的正当法律程序（due process of law）。

D. Yes, because the state discriminated against interstate commerce.
应该胜诉，因为该州歧视了州际贸易。
data.explanation:
The commerce clause gives Congress broad power to regulate interstate commerce - ie, nearly all activities involving two or more states. The negative implication of this clause (ie, the dormant commerce clause) is that states are generally prohibited from discriminating against or otherwise unduly burdening interstate commerce. But under the market-participant exception, states are not subject to the dormant commerce clause when they act as a market participant - ie, buy or sell goods or services - rather than as a market regulator.

Here, the state discriminated against interstate commerce when it awarded the contract to the local company even though the interstate company was the highest bidder. But since the state was selling the right to exploit the natural gas field that it owned, it acted as a market participant. As a result, the dormant commerce clause does not apply, and the interstate company should not prevail in its suit to overturn the state's decision (Choice D).

(Choice B) Had the dormant commerce clause applied, this state decision would have been subject to strict scrutiny. Under this test, state action that discriminates against interstate commerce is invalid unless:
  • it furthers a legitimate, noneconomic state interest and
  • no reasonable alternative exists.
And since the state's interest in reducing local customers' gas costs is economic in nature, the decision likely would have failed strict scrutiny.

(Choice C) Under the Fourteenth Amendment due process clause, most state deprivations of life, liberty, or property are justified if they are rationally related to a legitimate state interest. And here, choosing the local company's lower bid was rational since any savings would be passed on to local customers - a legitimate state interest. Therefore, the state did not deny the interstate company due process of law.

Educational objective: The dormant commerce clause - which prohibits states from discriminating against or otherwise unduly burdening interstate commerce - does not apply when a state acts as a market participant (eg, buyer or seller).



选项正确率统计：A选项 83%（正确选项），B选项 11%，C选项 0%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

商业条款（Commerce Clause）赋予国会监管州际贸易的广泛权力——即几乎所有涉及两个或多个州的活动。该条款的消极含义（即休眠商业条款 dormant commerce clause）是，通常禁止各州歧视或以其他方式过度负担州际贸易。但根据市场参与者例外（market-participant exception）原则，当州作为市场参与者（即购买或销售商品或服务）而非市场监管者行事时，不受休眠商业条款的约束。

在本案中，尽管州际公司是最高出价者，但州政府仍将合同授予了本地公司，这是对州际贸易的歧视。但由于该州是在出售其拥有的天然气田的开采权，因此它是在作为市场参与者行事。因此，休眠商业条款不适用，州际公司要求推翻州政府决定的诉讼不应胜诉（此理由反驳了选项D）。

（选项B）如果休眠商业条款适用，该州的决定将受到严格审查（strict scrutiny）。根据该审查标准，歧视州际贸易的州行为是无效的，除非：
  • 它促进了合法的、非经济性的州利益，并且
  • 不存在其他合理的替代方案。
并且，由于该州为本地客户降低天然气成本的利益本质上是经济性的，该决定很可能会通不过严格审查。

（选项C）根据第十四修正案的正当程序条款（Fourteenth Amendment due process clause），大多数州政府对生命、自由或财产的剥夺，如果与合法的州利益有理性关联（rationally related），则被认为是正当的。在本案中，选择本地公司的较低报价是理性的，因为任何节省的成本都将转让给本地客户——这是一项合法的州利益。因此，该州没有剥夺州际公司的正当法律程序。

教学目的：休眠商业条款——该条款禁止各州歧视或以其他方式过度负担州际贸易——在州作为市场参与者（例如，买方或卖方）行事时，不适用。

References

  • U.S. Const. art. I, § 8, cl. 3 (commerce clause).
  • Reeves, Inc. v. Stake, 447 U.S. 429, 439 - 40 (1980) (holding that a state acts as a market participant and is not subject to the dormant commerce clause when the state buys or sells goods or services).
  • 15A Am. Jur. 2d Commerce § 33 (2019) (explaining that the dormant commerce clause does not apply when a state acts as a market participant as opposed to a market regulator).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations / Dormant Commerce Clause
核心考点：市场参与者例外
通常，休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause) 禁止各州歧视州际贸易。但是，当州政府作为市场参与者 (Market Participant)（即买方或卖方）而非监管者行事时，它不受该条款的限制。

Market-Participant Exception: States may discriminate when buying/selling goods or services.
本案逻辑链条
1
身份识别：该州拥有一座天然气田（State owned a large natural gas field）。
2
行为定性：该州正在出售开采权。这属于商业交易行为，而非制定法律监管私营企业的行为。
3
法律适用：因为该州是卖家（市场参与者），所以适用市场参与者例外 (Market-Participant Exception)。
4
结论：该州有权选择与谁交易，哪怕这种选择歧视了州际公司（Interstate Company）而偏袒了本地公司。
选项深度解析
正确答案 A

不应胜诉，因为该州是作为市场参与者行事。
这是对规则的直接应用。最高法院在 Reeves, Inc. v. Stake (1980) 等判例中确立了这一原则。只要州政府是在花自己的钱或卖自己的资源，它就可以像私人企业一样行事，自由选择交易对象。

错误选项 D

虽然该州确实“歧视了州际贸易”，但这正是例外情况。如果该州是作为监管者（Regulator）通过法律限制私营天然气田只能卖给本地人，那么选项D就是对的。但在本题中，州是所有者，所以例外原则优先。

错误选项 B

提到“强制性利益 (Compelling Interest)”通常意味着严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)。只有当休眠商业条款适用且州行为具有歧视性时，才需要进行严格审查。既然本案适用“市场参与者例外”，审查标准根本不需要上升到这一高度。此外，单纯的经济保护主义通常不被视为强制性利益。

错误选项 C

涉及正当程序 (Due Process)。只要政府行为与合法利益之间存在理性关联 (Rational Basis)，就不会违反实质性正当程序。为本地居民降低生活成本是合法的州利益，选择承诺降价的本地公司是实现该利益的理性手段。因此，该行为是理性的，并未违反 Due Process。

💡 MBE 抢分技巧 看到涉及“州际贸易歧视”的题目时，第一步先判断角色的身份：
  • 如果是监管者 (Regulator) ➔ 适用休眠商业条款 (DCC) ➔ 歧视通常违宪。
  • 如果是买家/卖家 (Buyer/Seller) ➔ 适用市场参与者例外 (MPE) ➔ 歧视通常允许。

注意：市场参与者例外不适用于该州试图对交易后的“下游”活动施加监管的情况（Downstream Restrictions）。

questions.question:
The United States Department of the Interior granted a man the food and drink concession in a federal park located in a state. The man operated his concession out of federally owned facilities in the park. The federal statute authorizing the Interior Department to grant such concessions provided that the grantees would pay only a nominal rental for use of these federal facilities because of the great benefit their concessions would provide to the people of the United States.
The state legislature enacted a statute imposing an occupancy tax on the occupants of real estate within that state that is not subject to state real estate taxes. The statute was intended to equalize the state tax burden on such occupants with that on people occupying real estate that is subject to state real estate taxes.
Pursuant to that statute, the state's Department of Revenue attempted to collect the state occupancy tax from the man because the federal facilities occupied by the man were not subject to state real estate taxes.
The man sued to invalidate the state occupancy tax as applied to him.
What is the strongest constitutional ground upon which the man could challenge the occupancy tax?

choices.a: The tax violates the commerce clause by unduly burdening the interstate tourist trade.
choices.b: The tax violates the equal protection clause of the Fourteenth Amendment because the tax treats him less favorably than federal concessionaires in other states who do not have to pay such occupancy taxes.
choices.c: The tax violates the privileges or immunities clause of the Fourteenth Amendment by interfering with the fundamental right to do business on federal property.
choices.d: The tax violates the supremacy clause of Article VI and the federal statute authorizing such concessions.

data.questionStem:
Q82020

The United States Department of the Interior granted a man the food and drink concession in a federal park located in a state. The man operated his concession out of federally owned facilities in the park. The federal statute authorizing the Interior Department to grant such concessions provided that the grantees would pay only a nominal rental for use of these federal facilities because of the great benefit their concessions would provide to the people of the United States.

The state legislature enacted a statute imposing an occupancy tax on the occupants of real estate within that state that is not subject to state real estate taxes. The statute was intended to equalize the state tax burden on such occupants with that on people occupying real estate that is subject to state real estate taxes.

Pursuant to that statute, the state's Department of Revenue attempted to collect the state occupancy tax from the man because the federal facilities occupied by the man were not subject to state real estate taxes.

The man sued to invalidate the state occupancy tax as applied to him.

What is the strongest constitutional ground upon which the man could challenge the occupancy tax?

美国内政部授予一名男子在某州一个联邦公园内的餐饮特许经营权。该男子在公园内的联邦所属设施中经营其特许业务。授权内政部授予此类特许经营权的联邦法规规定，鉴于其特许经营将为美国人民带来巨大利益，被授权人只需为使用这些联邦设施支付名义上的租金。

该州立法机关颁布了一项法规，对州内不受州房地产税约束的房地产占用人征收占用税。该法规旨在平衡此类占用人与需缴纳州房地产税的房地产占用人之间的州税负。

根据该法规，州税务局试图向该男子征收州占用税，因为该男子占用的联邦设施不受州房地产税的约束。

该男子提起诉讼，要求宣布适用于他的州占用税无效。

该男子可以用来挑战该占用税的最有力的宪法依据是什么？
options:
A. The tax violates the commerce clause by unduly burdening the interstate tourist trade.
该税收过度加重了州际旅游贸易的负担，违反了 commerce clause。

B. The tax violates the equal protection clause of the Fourteenth Amendment because the tax treats him less favorably than federal concessionaires in other states who do not have to pay such occupancy taxes.
该税收违反了 Fourteenth Amendment 的 equal protection clause，因为它对该男子的待遇不如其他州无需缴纳此类占用税的联邦特许经营人有利。

C. The tax violates the privileges or immunities clause of the Fourteenth Amendment by interfering with the fundamental right to do business on federal property.
该税收干涉了在联邦财产上从事商业活动的基本权利，违反了 Fourteenth Amendment 的 privileges or immunities clause。

D. The tax violates the supremacy clause of Article VI and the federal statute authorizing such concessions.
该税收违反了 Article VI 的 supremacy clause 以及授权此类特许经营的联邦法规。
data.explanation:
Federal immunity from state & local taxes/regulations


Tax/regulationDefinitionPermissibility
DirectApplies to federal government - including its agencies & instrumentalitiesImmune unless: Congress consents to tax/regulation
IndirectApplies to affiliates - including persons/entities employed by or doing business with federal governmentNot immune unless: Congress grants immunity or tax/regulation discriminates against or substantially interferes with federal duties
The supremacy clause immunizes the federal government, including its agencies and instrumentalities, from state and municipal taxation unless Congress consents. But the federal government's affiliates - ie, persons or entities employed by or doing business with the federal government - are only immune if:
  • Congress grants the affiliate immunity
  • the tax discriminates against the federal government or its affiliates or
  • the tax substantially interferes with the affiliate's federal purpose or duties.


Here, the state attempted to collect an occupancy tax from the man - an affiliate of the federal government who was granted the food and drink concession in a federal park. The federal statute authorizing this grant provided that the man would only pay nominal rent due to the great public benefit provided by concessions. And since the state tax may substantially interfere with the man's federal purpose or duties by raising his costs, his strongest argument is that the tax violates the supremacy clause and the federal statute as applied to him.

(Choice A) Under the dormant commerce clause, state taxes are invalid if they unduly burden interstate commerce. But the state tax here does not unduly burden the interstate tourist trade because it:
  • applies to activities with a substantial nexus to the state,
  • is fairly apportioned,
  • does not discriminate against interstate commerce, and
  • is fairly related to the services and benefits provided by the state.


(Choice B) The Fourteenth Amendment equal protection clause is triggered when a state treats similarly situated persons differently. But state laws that do not substantially impact a fundamental right or intentionally discriminate against a protected class (as seen here) are almost always upheld under mere rational basis scrutiny.

(Choice C) The Fourteenth Amendment privileges or immunities clause bars states from interfering with the very limited rights of national citizenship - which do not include a right to do business on federal property.

Educational objective: The federal government's affiliates are subject to state and municipal taxation unless:
  • Congress grants them immunity,
  • the tax is discriminatory, or
  • the tax substantially interferes with their federal purpose or duties.


选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 6%，C选项 4%，D选项 79%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

联邦政府对州和地方税收/法规的豁免权


税收/法规定义可否征收
直接适用于联邦政府——包括其机构和部门豁免，除非：国会同意征税/监管
间接适用于关联方——包括受雇于联邦政府或与联邦政府有业务往来的人员/实体不豁免，除非：国会授予豁免权或税收/法规歧视或实质性干涉联邦职责
supremacy clause 赋予联邦政府（包括其机构和部门）对州和市政税收的豁免权，除非国会同意。但联邦政府的关联方——即受雇于联邦政府或与联邦政府有业务往来的人员或实体——仅在以下情况下享有豁免：
  • 国会授予该关联方豁免权
  • 该税收歧视联邦政府或其关联方，或
  • 该税收实质性地干涉了关联方的联邦宗旨或职责。


在本案中，州政府试图向该男子——作为联邦政府的关联方，在联邦公园内获得了餐饮特许经营权——征收占用税。授权此项特许的联邦法规规定，由于特许经营提供了巨大的公共利益，该男子只需支付名义上的租金。由于州税可能会通过增加其成本而实质性地干涉该男子的联邦宗旨或职责，他最有力的论点是，适用于他的该税收违反了 supremacy clause 和该联邦法规。

(选项 A) 根据 dormant commerce clause，如果州税过度加重了州际贸易的负担，则该州税无效。但本案中的州税并未过度加重州际旅游贸易的负担，因为它：
  • 适用于与该州有实质性联系的活动，
  • 分配公平，
  • 不歧视州际贸易，以及
  • 与州政府提供的服务和利益公平相关。


(选项 B) 当一个州对处境相似的人给予不同待遇时，就会触发 Fourteenth Amendment 的 equal protection clause。但州法律若未实质性影响基本权利或故意歧视受保护阶层（如本案所示），在仅需“合理依据审查”的情况下几乎总能被维持。

(选项 C) Fourteenth Amendment 的 privileges or immunities clause 禁止各州干涉非常有限的国民公民权——其中不包括在联邦财产上从事商业活动的权利。

教学目标：联邦政府的关联方需缴纳州和市政税收，除非：
  • 国会授予他们豁免权，
  • 该税收具有歧视性，或
  • 该税收实质性地干涉了他们的联邦宗旨或职责。


References

U.S. Const. art. VI, cl. 2 (supremacy clause).

McCulloch v. Maryland, 17 U.S. 316, 436 (1819) (establishing federal immunity from state taxation and regulation).

United States v. New Mexico, 455 U.S. 720, 735 n.11 (1982) (explaining that state taxes on affiliates of the federal government must be nondiscriminatory and cannot substantially interfere with its activities).

MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations & Supremacy Clause

核心考点：政府间豁免权 (Intergovernmental Immunity)

根据 Supremacy Clause（至高条款），州政府不能直接对联邦政府征税或监管。但是，对于与联邦政府有业务往来的私人第三方（如承包商、承租人），州政府通常可以征税，除非：

  1. 税收具有歧视性（Discriminatory）；或者
  2. 税收实质性地干扰了联邦政策或法规（Substantially interferes with federal policy）。
本案关键逻辑分析

这道题的陷阱在于：通常情况下，州政府对联邦土地上的私人承租人征收“使用税”（Use Tax）或“占用税”（Occupancy Tax）是合宪的，只要该税收是为了平衡私人土地所有者的税负（即非歧视性）。

但是，本案有一个特殊事实：

存在一项具体的联邦法规 (Federal Statute)，明确规定特许经营者只需支付“名义租金” (nominal rental)，目的是为了给美国人民提供利益。

冲突点：

  • 联邦意图： 通过低成本（低租金）补贴特许经营者，以促进公共利益。
  • 州税收后果： 州政府通过征税增加了经营者的成本，实际上抵消了联邦法规给予的经济优惠。
为什么选 D？

正确答案 D 指出该税收违反了 Supremacy Clause 和授权该特许经营的联邦法规。

当有效的联邦法律与州法律发生冲突，或者州法律阻碍了联邦目标的实现时，联邦法律优先（Preemption）。

在本案中，州税收直接削弱了联邦法规设定的“名义租金”政策。如果没有这个特定的联邦法规，州税收很可能是合法的（参考 United States v. County of Fresno）；但因为有了这个法规，州税构成了对联邦目标的干扰。

其他选项为何错误？
A. Commerce Clause (商务条款)
该税收针对的是州内的不动产占用，属于州内活动。只要税收分配公平且不歧视州际贸易，通常不会违反 dormant commerce clause。题目中明确说该税是为了“平衡税负”，暗示其非歧视性。
B. Equal Protection (平等保护)
经济类法规的分类只需通过合理依据审查 (Rational Basis Test)。州政府为了税收公平（让免税地块的使用者也承担公共服务成本）而征税，完全符合合理依据。
C. Privileges or Immunities (特权或豁免条款)
第十四修正案的此条款适用范围极窄（主要涉及迁徙权等），并不包含“在联邦财产上做生意”的权利。这是MBE中常见的干扰项，几乎永远不是正确答案。
💡 MBE 解题技巧 如果在题目中看到具体的联邦法规（Federal Statute）设定了某种政策（如低租金、特定标准），而州法律试图改变这种结果，首选思考方向应当是 Supremacy Clause（至高条款）。

问自己：州法律是否让联邦法律“落空”或“受阻”？如果是，那就是违宪的。

questions.question:
A federal statute authorizes the Interstate Commerce Commission (ICC) to permit interstate carriers to discontinue any unprofitable route.
An interstate bus company that operates in a five-state area applied to the ICC for permission to drop a very unprofitable route through a sparsely populated mountain region. The ICC granted that permission even though the bus company provided the only public transportation into that region.
A woman owns a mountain resort in this region. The resort's customers usually arrived on buses operated by the company. After exhausting all available federal administrative remedies, the woman filed suit against the bus company in the trial court of the state in which the resort is located to enjoin the discontinuance by the bus company of its service to that area. The woman alleged that the discontinuance of service would violate a state statute that prohibits common carriers from abandoning service to communities having no alternate form of public transportation.
What action should the state court take?

choices.a: Deny the injunction, because a valid federal law preempts the state statute on which the woman relies.
choices.b: Direct the removal of the case to federal court, because this suit involves a substantial federal question.
choices.c: Dismiss the action, because the woman lacks standing to sue.
choices.d: Grant the injunction because, on these facts, a federal agency is interfering with essential state functions.

data.questionStem:
Q82014

A federal statute authorizes the Interstate Commerce Commission (ICC) to permit interstate carriers to discontinue any unprofitable route.

An interstate bus company that operates in a five-state area applied to the ICC for permission to drop a very unprofitable route through a sparsely populated mountain region. The ICC granted that permission even though the bus company provided the only public transportation into that region.

A woman owns a mountain resort in this region. The resort's customers usually arrived on buses operated by the company. After exhausting all available federal administrative remedies, the woman filed suit against the bus company in the trial court of the state in which the resort is located to enjoin the discontinuance by the bus company of its service to that area. The woman alleged that the discontinuance of service would violate a state statute that prohibits common carriers from abandoning service to communities having no alternate form of public transportation.

What action should the state court take?

一项联邦法规授权州际商务委员会 (Interstate Commerce Commission, ICC) 准许州际承运人中断任何不盈利的路线。

一家在五个州运营的州际巴士公司向 ICC 申请许可，要求取消一条穿越人烟稀少的山区的极不盈利的路线。尽管该巴士公司是进入该地区的唯一公共交通工具，ICC 仍批准了该许可。

一名女子在该地区拥有一家山区度假村。该度假村的顾客通常乘坐该公司运营的巴士抵达。在用尽所有可用的联邦行政救济措施后，该女子在度假村所在州的初审法院对该巴士公司提起诉讼，请求法院下达禁令，禁止该公司中断对该地区的服务。该女子声称，中断服务将违反一项州法规，该法规禁止公共承运人放弃对没有其他公共交通方式的社区的服务。

州法院应采取何种行动？
options:
A. Deny the injunction, because a valid federal law preempts the state statute on which the woman relies.
驳回禁令，因为一项有效的联邦法律优先适用于（preempts）该女子所依据的州法规。

B. Direct the removal of the case to federal court, because this suit involves a substantial federal question.
指示将案件移送至联邦法院，因为此诉讼涉及重大的联邦问题。

C. Dismiss the action, because the woman lacks standing to sue.
驳回诉讼，因为该女子缺乏诉讼资格。

D. Grant the injunction because, on these facts, a federal agency is interfering with essential state functions.
批准禁令，因为根据本案事实，一个联邦机构正在干涉州的必要职能。
data.explanation:
Preemption


TypeApplicability
ExpressConstitution grants federal government exclusive power to regulate area or Federal law expressly prohibits state regulation in same area
Field preemption:Congressional intent to occupy entire field inferred from pervasive regulations that leave no room for state involvement
Implied
Conflict preemption:		Direct conflict makes it impossible (or nearly impossible) to comply with federal & state law or Indirect conflict frustrates accomplishment of federal law's purpose
Under the Article VI supremacy clause, a valid federal law preempts (ie, supersedes) conflicting state law. Such preemption can be express or implied. One type of implied preemption is conflict preemption, which stems from either:

  • direct conflict - when it is impossible or nearly impossible to comply with both the federal and state laws or

  • indirect conflict - when the state law frustrates the accomplishment of the federal law's purpose.


Here, the Interstate Commerce Commission (ICC) acted pursuant to a federal statute when it permitted the bus company to drop an unprofitable route. But a state statute prohibits the bus company from dropping that route since the area has no alternate form of public transportation. This frustrates the federal statute's purpose to let the ICC determine whether an interstate carrier may discontinue a given route. And since the federal statute impliedly preempts the conflicting state one, the woman's request to enjoin the discontinuance of the route should be denied.

(Choice B) A state court cannot remove a case to federal court on its own initiative - even if the suit involves a substantial federal question.

Instead, the defendant must request removal (not seen here).

(Choice C) The woman has standing because she can allege an injury-in-fact (loss of customers) that is caused by the challenged action (dropped bus route) and redressable by the remedy sought (injunction).

(Choice D) An essential function of a state is to enact and enforce laws to protect the health, safety, and welfare of the public (ie, police power). But a federal agency can interfere with such functions when acting pursuant to a valid federal law (as seen here).

Educational objective: A federal law will impliedly preempt a conflicting state law that makes it impossible or nearly impossible to comply with both laws (ie, direct conflict) OR frustrates the accomplishment of the federal law's purpose (ie, indirect conflict).

选项正确率统计：A选项 70%（正确选项），B选项 9%，C选项 6%，D选项 13%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

优先适用原则 (Preemption)


类型适用性
明示优先 (Express)宪法授予联邦政府对某一领域的专属管辖权 或 联邦法律明文禁止州在同一领域进行监管
领域优先 (Field preemption):国会有意图占领整个领域的意图，这可以从普遍性的法规中推断出来，这些法规没有为州的参与留下任何空间
默示优先 (Implied)
冲突优先 (Conflict preemption):		直接冲突使得同时遵守联邦和州法律成为不可能（或几乎不可能）或 间接冲突阻碍了联邦法律目的的实现
根据第六条的最高条款 (supremacy clause)，一项有效的联邦法律优先于 (preempts)（即取代）相冲突的州法律。这种优先适用可以是明示的，也可以是默示的。默示优先的一种类型是冲突优先 (conflict preemption)，它源于以下任一情况：

  • 直接冲突 - 当不可能或几乎不可能同时遵守联邦和州法律时 或

  • 间接冲突 - 当州法律阻碍了联邦法律目的的实现时。


在本案中，Interstate Commerce Commission (ICC) 依据一项联邦法规行事，准许该巴士公司取消一条不盈利的路线。但一项州法规禁止该巴士公司取消该路线，因为该地区没有其他形式的公共交通。这阻碍了联邦法规的立法目的，即让 ICC 决定州际承运人是否可以中断某条特定路线。并且，由于联邦法规默示地优先于与之冲突的州法规，该女子要求下达禁令以禁止中断路线的请求应被驳回。

(选项 B) 州法院不能主动将案件移送至联邦法院——即使该诉讼涉及重大的联邦问题。

相反，必须由被告申请移送（本案中未发生）。

(选项 C) 该女子具有诉讼资格，因为她可以声称存在事实上的损害（客户流失），该损害是由被质疑的行为（取消巴士路线）造成的，并且可以通过所寻求的救济（禁令）得到弥补。

(选项 D) 州的必要职能是制定和执行法律，以保护公众的健康、安全和福祉（即警察权）。但是，当联邦机构依据有效的联邦法律行事时，可以干涉这些职能（如本案所示）。

教学目标：当一项州法律使得同时遵守联邦和州法律成为不可能或几乎不可能（即直接冲突），或阻碍了联邦法律目的的实现（即间接冲突）时，联邦法律将默示地优先于（preempt）该与之冲突的州法律。

References

Hines v. Davidowitz, 312 U.S. 52, 67 (1941) (stating that implied preemption occurs when a state law "stands as an obstacle to the accomplishment and execution of the full purposes and objectives of Congress").

Chi. & Nw. Transp. Co. v. Kalo Brick & Tile Co., 450 U.S. 311, 331 (1981) (holding that ICC approval of an abandonment of a common-carrier route preempts conflicting state law).
