data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

联邦优先权原则 (Preemption)

核心法律规则

本题考察的是美国宪法第六条中的最高条款 (Supremacy Clause)。

规则摘要：
当联邦法律与州法律发生冲突时，有效的联邦法律优先于（Preempts）州法律。

优先权 (Preemption) 主要分为两类：

明示优先 (Express Preemption)
国会明确声明取代州法
⬇️
默示优先 (Implied Preemption)
包含：领域独占 & 法律冲突
本案逻辑推演

本题属于默示优先中的冲突优先 (Conflict Preemption)。

第一步：识别联邦行为
联邦法规授权 ICC 允许承运人放弃不盈利的路线。ICC 已经行使该权力，批准了巴士公司的申请。
第二步：识别州法冲突
州法规禁止放弃该路线（因为没有替代交通工具）。这与 ICC 的许可直接对立。
第三步：判定结果
州法律阻碍了联邦目标的实现（即由联邦机构决定路线的经济可行性）。因此，联邦决定优先适用，州法院必须服从联邦决定。

相关判例： Chicago & N.W. Transp. Co. v. Kalo Brick & Tile Co. (1981)。最高法院裁定，ICC 对放弃路线的批准优先于与之冲突的州法律。

选项辨析
选项 A (正确)

拒绝禁令，因为联邦法优先。
这是最高条款的直接应用。州法院不能禁止联邦机构依法授权的行为。

选项 B (错误)

指示移送联邦法院。
Removal (移送管辖) 是被告的权利，法院不能主动（sua sponte）将案件移送。此外，州法院有权也有义务审理涉及联邦抗辩的案件，除非联邦有专属管辖权。

选项 C (错误)

缺乏诉讼资格 (Standing)。
该女子作为度假村所有者，因巴士停运将遭受直接的经济损失（Injury-in-fact），这足以构成诉讼资格。

选项 D (错误)

联邦干涉州职能。
虽然公共交通通常涉及州的警察权 (Police Power)，但根据商业条款 (Commerce Clause)，国会有权监管州际运输。当国会行使该权力时，它可以通过优先权原则“干涉”州的监管。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

当题目中出现“联邦机构批准”与“州法律禁止”这种明显的对立时，首先考虑优先权原则 (Preemption)。

记住关键词：
1. Frustration of Purpose (目的受阻)
2. Physical Impossibility (履行不能)
只要满足其一，州法即无效。

© MBE 备考助手 | 宪法与联邦制

questions.question:
A state requires all corporations that operate in the state to file their annual income tax returns with the state's tax board for the purpose of calculating the amount of income tax that each corporation owes. The board requires corporations to provide reasonable approximations of their income earned on a worldwide basis. The board then calculates the income tax that a corporation owes based on the amount of income attributable to its operations within the state.
Several foreign corporations that operate in the state and do not use the state's method of accounting have sued the board in state court, arguing that the state tax is unconstitutional.
Is the state tax constitutional?

choices.a: No, because Congress has the sole power to tax foreign corporations.
choices.b: No, because the state tax discriminates against foreign commerce.
choices.c: Yes, because the state tax was enacted pursuant to the state's police power, which takes precedence over the negative implications of the commerce clause.
choices.d: Yes, if the court determines that the state tax does not impede federal uniformity in foreign commerce.

data.questionStem:
Q82024

A state requires all corporations that operate in the state to file their annual income tax returns with the state's tax board for the purpose of calculating the amount of income tax that each corporation owes. The board requires corporations to provide reasonable approximations of their income earned on a worldwide basis. The board then calculates the income tax that a corporation owes based on the amount of income attributable to its operations within the state.

Several foreign corporations that operate in the state and do not use the state's method of accounting have sued the board in state court, arguing that the state tax is unconstitutional.

Is the state tax constitutional?

一个州要求所有在该州运营的公司向州税务委员会提交年度所得税申报表，以计算每家公司应缴纳的所得税额。该委员会要求公司提供其在全球范围内赚取的收入的合理估算。然后，委员会根据该公司在该州内的运营所产生的收入额，计算其应缴纳的所得税。

几家在该州运营但未使用该州会计方法的外国公司，已在州法院起诉该委员会，主张该州税收违宪。

该州税收是否合宪？
options:
A. No, because Congress has the sole power to tax foreign corporations.
不合宪，因为国会拥有对外国公司征税的专属权力。

B. No, because the state tax discriminates against foreign commerce.
不合宪，因为该州税收歧视了对外贸易。

C. Yes, because the state tax was enacted pursuant to the state's police power, which takes precedence over the negative implications of the commerce clause.
合宪，因为该州税收是依据州的警察权制定的，该权力优先于商业条款的消极含义。

D. Yes, if the court determines that the state tax does not impede federal uniformity in foreign commerce.
合宪，如果法院认定该州税收不损害对外贸易中的联邦统一性。
data.explanation:
The commerce clause grants Congress the power to regulate foreign commerce. The negative implication of this clause (ie, the dormant commerce clause ) prohibits states from discriminating against or otherwise unduly burdening foreign commerce. However, a state may still tax foreign persons and entities that earn income in the state if the state tax satisfies the Complete Auto and federal uniformity requirements (Choice A). Here, the state tax satisfies the Complete Auto requirements (see image above) because the tax:
  • is applied to the foreign corporations' business activities in the state (substantial nexus)
  • is based on a rational formula that only taxes income earned in the state (fairly apportioned)
  • applies equally to domestic and foreign corporations (nondiscriminatory) (Choice B)
  • and is reasonable compared to services and benefits provided by the state, like infrastructure (fairly related).


Additionally, the state tax must satisfy federal uniformity requirements. This means that the tax must not create an inevitable risk of international multiple taxation OR prevent the federal government from speaking with one voice in international trade or foreign affairs.

Therefore, the state tax is constitutional if the court determines that it satisfies these additional requirements.

(Choice C) The Tenth Amendment gives states all powers that are not expressly granted to the federal government by the Constitution - eg, police power to impose taxes on activities in the state. But pursuant to the supremacy clause, state police powers do not take precedence over other constitutional provisions, including the negative implications of the commerce clause.

Educational objective: A state tax affecting foreign commerce must satisfy the Complete Auto requirements (substantial nexus, fairly apportioned, nondiscriminatory, and fairly related). Additionally, such a tax must not create an inevitable risk of international multiple taxation OR prevent the federal government from speaking with one voice in foreign affairs.



选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 8%，C选项 11%，D选项 70%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

商业条款授予国会监管对外贸易的权力。该条款的消极含义（即休眠商业条款）禁止各州歧视或以其他方式不当加重对外贸易的负担。然而，如果州税满足 Complete Auto 案的要求和联邦统一性要求，州仍然可以对在该州获得收入的外国个人和实体征税（选项A）。在本案中，该州税满足Complete Auto案的要求（见上图），因为该税收：
  • 适用于外国公司在该州的商业活动（实质性联系）
  • 基于一个合理的公式，仅对在该州赚取的收入征税（公平分配）
  • 平等适用于国内和外国公司（非歧视性）（选项B）
  • 并且与州提供的服务和利益（如基础设施）相比是合理的（公平关联）。


此外，州税还必须满足联邦统一性要求。这意味着税收不得造成国际多重征税的必然风险，或阻止联邦政府在国际贸易或外交事务中“用一个声音说话”。

因此，如果法院认定该州税收满足这些额外要求，则其为合宪。

（选项C）《第十修正案》将宪法未明确授予联邦政府的所有权力赋予各州——例如，对州内活动征税的警察权。但根据至高无上条款，州的警察权并不优先于其他宪法规定，包括商业条款的消极含义。

教学目标： 影响对外贸易的州税必须满足 Complete Auto 案的要求（实质性联系、公平分配、非歧视性、公平关联）。此外，此类税收不得造成国际多重征税的必然风险，或阻止联邦政府在外交事务中“用一个声音说话”。

References

U.S. Const. art. 1, § 8, cl. 3 (commerce clause).

Barclays Bank Pub. Ltd. Co. v. Franchise Tax Bd. of Cal., 512 U.S. 298, 311 (1994) (setting forth the requirements for determining whether a state tax that affects foreign commerce violates the commerce clause).

MBE 考点解析

宪法：州对对外贸易的征税权

核心考点：休眠商业条款

本题考察的是休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause) 对州政府向从事对外贸易 (Foreign Commerce) 的公司征税的限制。

虽然国会拥有监管对外贸易的权力，但州在满足特定严格条件时，也可以对外国公司征税。

法律规则：两步测试法

州税要合宪，必须同时通过以下两个测试：

第一步：Complete Auto 测试
(适用于所有州际贸易)
1. 实质性联系 (Substantial Nexus)
2. 公平分配 (Fair Apportionment)
3. 非歧视性 (Nondiscriminatory)
4. 公平关联 (Fairly Related)
⬇️ 必须同时满足
第二步：Japan Line 额外测试
(专门针对对外贸易)
1. 不得造成国际多重征税的必然风险
2. 不得妨碍联邦政府“用一个声音说话”
正确答案 D
为什么选 D？

选项 D 准确地指出了针对对外贸易的特殊宪法要求。

题目中的州税采用了“全球合并报告法”（Worldwide Combined Reporting），这在 Barclays Bank PLC v. Franchise Tax Board (1994) 案中已被最高法院确认合宪。

关键逻辑：
只要州税满足了基本的 Complete Auto 要求，且不损害联邦在对外贸易中的统一性（即不阻止联邦政府在国际事务中 Speak with One Voice），该税收就是合宪的。
陷阱排除
  • 选项 A 错误：虽然国会权力很大，但并非“独占”到禁止州进行任何征税。只要不冲突，州有权征税。
  • 选项 B 错误：题目中提到该税收基于“合理估算”和“州内运营归属比例”，这表明它是公平分配 (Fairly Apportioned) 的，并非表面上的歧视。
  • 选项 C 错误：这是一个经典的宪法陷阱。至高无上条款 (Supremacy Clause) 规定宪法（包括商业条款）高于州的警察权 (Police Power)。州不能用警察权作为违反商业条款的借口。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

看到 "Foreign Corporations" (外国公司) 和 "State Tax" (州税) 的组合时：

  1. 首先检查是否歧视（Discrimination）？如果是，通常违宪。
  2. 如果非歧视，检查是否干扰了联邦政府的外交政策统一性 (Federal Uniformity)。
  3. 记住关键词："Speak with One Voice" (用一个声音说话)。

questions.question:
A federally owned and operated office building located in a state is heated with a new, pollution-free heating system. However, in the coldest season of the year, this new system is sometimes insufficient to supply adequate heat to the building. The federal appropriation statute providing the money for construction of the new heating system permitted use of the old, pollution-generating system when necessary to supply additional heat. When the old heating system operates (only about two days in any year), the smokestack of the building emits smoke that exceeds the state's pollution-control standards.
May the operators of the federal office building be prosecuted successfully by state authorities for violating that state's pollution-control standards?

choices.a: No, because the operations of the federal government are immune from state regulation in the absence of federal consent.
choices.b: No, because the violations of the state pollution-control standards involved here are so insignificant that they are beyond the legitimate reach of state law.
choices.c: Yes, because the regulation of pollution is a joint concern of the federal government and the state and, therefore, both of them may regulate conduct causing pollution.
choices.d: Yes, because the regulation of pollution is a legitimate state police power concern.

一座位于某州的联邦政府所有并运营的办公楼，采用了一种新型的无污染供暖系统。然而，在一年中最冷的季节，这套新系统有时不足以为大楼提供足够的热量。为建造新供暖系统提供资金的联邦拨款法案允许在必要时使用旧的、会产生污染的系统来补充供暖。当旧供暖系统运行时（每年仅约两天），大楼的烟囱会排放超过该州污染控制标准的烟雾。

州政府当局是否可以因联邦办公楼的运营者违反该州的污染控制标准而成功对其提起诉讼？
options:
A. No, because the operations of the federal government are immune from state regulation in the absence of federal consent.
不可以，因为在没有联邦政府同意的情况下，联邦政府的运作享有免受州法规管辖的豁免权。

B. No, because the violations of the state pollution-control standards involved here are so insignificant that they are beyond the legitimate reach of state law.
不可以，因为此处涉及的违反州污染控制标准的行为非常轻微，超出了州法律的正当管辖范围。

C. Yes, because the regulation of pollution is a joint concern of the federal government and the state and, therefore, both of them may regulate conduct causing pollution.
可以，因为污染监管是联邦政府和州政府共同关心的问题，因此，两者都可以对造成污染的行为进行规制。

D. Yes, because the regulation of pollution is a legitimate state police power concern.
可以，因为污染监管属于州政府正当的警察权范畴。
data.explanation:
Under the Article VI supremacy clause, the U.S. Constitution, federal laws, and treaties are the supreme law of the land. As a result, the operations of the federal government - including those of its agencies and instrumentalities - are completely immune from state regulation in the absence of congressional consent. And since Congress did not consent to the state's pollution-control standards in this instance, the operators of the federal office building cannot be successfully prosecuted for violating them.

(Choice B) All federal government violations of state regulations - insignificant or otherwise - are beyond the reach of state law unless Congress consented to the regulation.

(Choice C) Both the federal and state governments may regulate pollution. But the supremacy clause prevents states from enforcing their regulations against the federal government without congressional consent.

(Choice D) The Tenth Amendment reserves to states the broad police power to enact and enforce laws that are reasonably related to protecting public health, safety, and welfare - eg, regulating pollution. But when exercising this power, states cannot violate other constitutional provisions like the supremacy clause (as seen here).

Educational objective: The operations of the federal government - including those of its agencies and instrumentalities - are completely immune from state regulation unless Congress consents.



选项正确率统计：A选项 65%（正确选项），B选项 10%，C选项 7%，D选项 17%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据 Article VI 的至高条款 (supremacy clause)，美国宪法、联邦法律和条约是国家的最高法律。因此，联邦政府的运作——包括其下属机构和部门的运作——在没有国会同意的情况下，完全享有免受州法规管辖的豁免权。而且，由于在此案中，国会并未同意该州的污染控制标准，因此联邦办公楼的运营者不会因违反这些标准而被成功起诉。

(选项 B) 联邦政府所有违反州法规的行为——无论轻微与否——都超出了州法律的管辖范围，除非国会同意该项法规。

(选项 C) 联邦政府和州政府都可以对污染进行规制。但是，至高条款 (supremacy clause) 禁止州政府在没有国会同意的情况下对联邦政府执行其法规。

(选项 D) The Tenth Amendment 将广泛的警察权保留给各州，以制定和执行与保护公共健康、安全和福祉合理相关的法律——例如，规制污染。但在行使此项权力时，各州不得违反其他宪法规定，如此处所示的至高条款 (supremacy clause)。

教学目标: 联邦政府的运作——包括其下属机构和部门的运作——在没有国会同意的情况下，完全享有免受州法规管辖的豁免权。

References

Arizona v. California, 283 U.S. 423, 451 (1931) (explaining that "[t]he United States may perform its functions without conforming to the police regulations of a State").

MBE 考点解析

联邦与州的关系 (Federal-State Relations)

核心原则：政府间豁免权 (Intergovernmental Immunity)

根据美国宪法第六条的至高条款 (Supremacy Clause)，联邦政府及其下属机构（Instrumentalities）在行使职能时，完全免受州政府的监管，除非国会明确表示同意（Consent）。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 A)

本题考察的是联邦政府是否必须遵守州的法律法规。

  • 法律依据： 州政府无权监管联邦政府的运作。这源于著名的 McCulloch v. Maryland 判例精神及后续判例（如 Hancock v. Train）。
  • 案情应用： 题目中，该办公楼是联邦拥有并运营的（Federally owned and operated）。联邦拨款法案明确授权在必要时使用旧的供暖系统。
  • 结论： 即使旧系统违反了州的污染控制标准，由于国会没有同意接受该州法规的管辖（实际上，联邦法案反而授权了这种行为），州政府无权起诉联邦运营者。联邦法律和运作高于州法律。
❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 B (微不足道 De Minimis) 错误。豁免权是基于宪法原则，而不是基于违规程度的大小。无论违规是严重还是轻微，只要没有国会同意，联邦政府都享有豁免权。
选项 C (共同关注 Joint Concern) 错误。虽然环保确实是联邦和州的共同管辖领域（Concurrent Jurisdiction），但这并不意味着州法律可以凌驾于联邦机构之上。当州法律试图约束联邦政府本身时，至高条款禁止这种行为。
选项 D (警察权 Police Power) 错误。虽然第十修正案保留了各州的警察权（Police Power）以保护公众健康和安全，但这种权力不能违反宪法的其他部分。至高条款限制了州警察权对联邦政府的适用。
💡 MBE 解题技巧：
当你看到“州试图起诉/监管/征税联邦政府或其机构”的情景时，默认规则是“不可以”（Immune）。

唯一的例外是题目中明确提到“国会授权/同意”（Congressional Consent）。如果题目中没有这句话，州政府就无权干涉联邦运作。

questions.question:
A federal law provides that all motor vehicle tires discarded in this country must be disposed of in facilities licensed by the federal Environmental Protection Agency. Pursuant to this federal law and all proper federal procedural requirements, that agency has adopted very strict standards for the licensing of such facilities. As a result, the cost of disposing of tires in licensed facilities is substantial.
A state has a very large fleet of motor vehicles, including trucks used to support state-owned commercial activities and police cars. The state disposes of used tires from both kinds of state motor vehicles in a state-owned and operated facility. This state facility is unlicensed, but its operation in actual practice meets most of the standards imposed by the federal Environmental Protection Agency on facilities it licenses to dispose of tires.
Is it consistent with United States Supreme Court precedent for the state to continue disposing of its used tires in this manner?

choices.a: No, because a state must comply with valid federal laws that regulate matters substantially affecting interstate commerce.
choices.b: No, because some of the tires come from vehicles that are used by the state solely in its commercial activities.
choices.c: Yes, because some of the tires come from vehicles that are used by the state in the performance of core state governmental functions such as law enforcement.
choices.d: Yes, because the legitimate needs of the federal government are satisfied by the fact that the unlicensed state disposal scheme meets, in actual practice, most of the federal standards for the licensing of such facilities.

Is it consistent with United States Supreme Court precedent for the state to continue disposing of its used tires in this manner?

一项联邦法律规定，本国所有废弃的机动车轮胎必须在经联邦环境保护局（Environmental Protection Agency）许可的设施中进行处理。依据此项联邦法律及所有适当的联邦程序要求，该局对这类设施的许可采取了非常严格的标准。因此，在获得许可的设施中处理轮胎的成本相当高昂。

某州拥有一支庞大的机动车队，包括用于支持州有商业活动的卡车和警车。该州在其拥有和运营的设施中处理来自这两种州属机动车的废旧轮胎。该州设施未经许可，但其实际操作符合联邦环境保护局对其许可的轮胎处理设施所规定的大部分标准。

该州继续以此方式处理其废旧轮胎，是否符合美国最高法院（United States Supreme Court）的先例？
options:
A. No, because a state must comply with valid federal laws that regulate matters substantially affecting interstate commerce.
不，因为州必须遵守有效的联邦法律，这些法律规制对州际贸易有实质性影响的事项。

B. No, because some of the tires come from vehicles that are used by the state solely in its commercial activities.
不，因为部分轮胎来自该州完全用于其商业活动的车辆。

C. Yes, because some of the tires come from vehicles that are used by the state in the performance of core state governmental functions such as law enforcement.
是，因为部分轮胎来自该州在履行核心州政府职能（如执法）时使用的车辆。

D. Yes, because the legitimate needs of the federal government are satisfied by the fact that the unlicensed state disposal scheme meets, in actual practice, most of the federal standards for the licensing of such facilities.
是，因为该州未经许可的处理方案在实际操作中符合联邦对此类设施许可的大部分标准，这一事实满足了联邦政府的合法需求。
data.explanation:
Commerce clause

(U.S. Const. art. I, § 8) Congress can regulate:

  • channels of interstate commerce
  • instrumentalities of interstate commerce
  • persons/things moving in interstate commerce
  • activities that substantially affect interstate commerce


The commerce clause gives Congress the broad authority to regulate interstate commerce. This power extends to nearly any activity that involves two or more states - including in-state activities that, in the aggregate, substantially affect interstate commerce. And under the supremacy clause , these regulations are the supreme law of the land. Therefore, states must comply † with federal regulations just as any other entity or person must do.

Here, a federal law requires the disposal of all motor vehicle tires at facilities licensed by the EPA. The state disposes of used tires at in-state facilities, but the aggregate effect of this activity likely has a substantial effect on interstate commerce. This means that the federal law is a valid exercise of Congress's commerce powers. And since that law is supreme, the state must comply with it and cannot continue to dispose of its tires at the unlicensed facility.

†Under the Tenth Amendment anti-commandeering principle, the state would have been immune from the federal law had it required the state to (1) enact state legislation or (2) enforce federal law.

(Choice B) Although some of the disposed tires come from vehicles that are used solely in the state's commercial activities, the aggregate effect of tire disposal on interstate commerce is likely substantial. Therefore, the federal law is a valid exercise of Congress's commerce power with which states must comply.

(Choice C) The dormant commerce clause generally prohibits states from discriminating against out-of-state economic interests. And though such discrimination is permitted when states perform core government functions (eg, law enforcement, waste disposal), this does not authorize states to violate valid federal laws.

(Choice D) A state must fully comply with a federal law even if the state could satisfy the legitimate needs of the federal government by mostly complying with that law.

Educational objective: States must comply with all valid federal laws. This includes laws that are passed under Congress's broad commerce powers, which extend to any activities that substantially affect interstate commerce.

选项正确率统计：A选项 83%（正确选项），B选项 3%，C选项 3%，D选项 8%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Commerce clause (商业条款)

(美国宪法第一条第八款) 国会可以规制：

  • 州际贸易的渠道
  • 州际贸易的工具
  • 在州际贸易中流动的人员/物品
  • 对州际贸易有实质性影响的活动


Commerce clause (商业条款)赋予国会规制州际贸易的广泛权力。该权力几乎延伸至任何涉及两个或更多州的活动——包括那些在总体上对州际贸易有实质性影响的州内活动。根据Supremacy clause (至上条款)，这些法规是国家的最高法律。因此，州必须遵守†联邦法规，如同任何其他实体或个人一样。

在本案中，一项联邦法律要求所有机动车轮胎必须在经EPA许可的设施中处理。该州在州内设施处理废旧轮胎，但此活动的总和效应对州际贸易可能具有实质性影响。这意味着该联邦法律是国会商业权力的有效行使。由于该法律是最高法律，该州必须遵守，并且不能继续在未经许可的设施中处理其轮胎。

†根据第十修正案的反强征原则（anti-commandeering principle），如果联邦法律要求州 (1) 制定州级法规或 (2) 执行联邦法律，则该州将免受该联邦法律的约束。

（选项B）尽管部分被处理的轮胎来自该州完全用于其商业活动的车辆，但轮胎处理对州际贸易的总体影响可能是实质性的。因此，该联邦法律是国会商业权力的有效行使，各州必须遵守。

（选项C）休眠商业条款（dormant commerce clause）通常禁止州歧视州外经济利益。尽管当州履行核心政府职能（例如，执法、废物处理）时，这种歧视是允许的，但这并不授权州违反有效的联邦法律。

（选项D）即使一个州通过大部分遵守联邦法律能够满足联邦政府的合法需求，该州也必须完全遵守该法律。

教学目标：州必须遵守所有有效的联邦法律。这包括根据国会广泛的商业权力通过的法律，该权力延伸至任何对州际贸易有实质性影响的活动。

References

Reno v. Condon, 528 U.S. 141, 151 (2000) (holding that a state must comply with a federal law regulating commerce since it does not require the state to enact or enforce any laws).

MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations & Commerce Clause

✅ 正确答案：A

核心逻辑：只要联邦法律是依据Commerce Clause（商业条款）有效制定的，且属于普遍适用（Generally Applicable）的法律，州政府就必须像私人实体一样遵守该法律。

⚖️ 法律深度解析

本题考察的是联邦权力对州活动的规制边界。解题需要遵循以下三步逻辑：

  1. 联邦权力的来源：
    国会是否有权通过这项关于轮胎处理的法律？
    是的。根据 Commerce Clause，国会有权规制对州际贸易有“实质性影响”（Substantial Effect）的活动。废旧轮胎的处理涉及环境和经济成本，在总体上（in the aggregate）显然会影响州际贸易。
  2. 至上条款 (Supremacy Clause)：
    一旦确认联邦法律有效，根据宪法第六条的至上条款，该法律是“国家的最高法律”（Supreme Law of the Land）。
  3. 第十修正案的限制 (10th Amendment)：
    州是否有豁免权？
    这是本题的关键考点。 最高法院在 Garcia 案中确立了原则：如果联邦法律是普遍适用的（即同时规制私人和州政府的商业活动），而不是专门针对州政府进行“强征”（Commandeering），那么州政府必须遵守。
🏛 关键判例：Garcia v. San Antonio Metro. Transit Auth. (1985)
法院裁定，只要联邦法规没有破坏州的主权（例如强迫州立法），州在从事商业活动（如运营公交、处理垃圾）时，必须像私人企业一样遵守联邦标准（如最低工资法、环保法）。
❌ 为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 B (商业 vs. 政府职能)：
这是一个过时的法律概念。在 Garcia 案之前（即 National League of Cities 时代），法院曾区分“传统政府职能”和“商业活动”。但现在，这种区分已被废除。无论轮胎是来自警车（政府职能）还是商用卡车，州都必须遵守普遍适用的联邦法律。

选项 C (核心政府职能)：
同上。虽然执法是核心职能，但这并不赋予州违反联邦环保法的特权。只要联邦法律没有直接命令州立法机构制定法律（Anti-Commandeering Principle），州就必须合规。

选项 D (实质合规)：
法律要求的是完全合规（Strict Compliance）。“差不多符合标准”不是法律抗辩理由。如果联邦法律要求获得 EPA 许可，未获许可即为违法，无论实际操作有多规范。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

当看到联邦法律规制某个领域（如环保、劳动标准），而州政府作为参与者（Market Participant）违反该法律时：

  • 不要使用 Dormant Commerce Clause 的逻辑（那是限制州规制别人的）。
  • 不要过分纠结于“州的主权”。
  • 记住：如果该法律对私人企业有效，它通常也对州政府有效（除非涉及强迫州立法）。

questions.question:
A state statute requires corporations located in the state to pay an annual property tax based on the value of their inventory that is stored there. A tire distributor that imports tires manufactured in foreign countries and stores them at warehouses located in the state has sued to challenge the state tax, arguing that it is unconstitutional.
Is the state tax constitutional?

choices.a: No, because the import-export clause prohibits state taxes on imported goods.
choices.b: No, because the state tax discriminates against foreign commerce.
choices.c: Yes, because states have absolute authority to tax goods within their borders.
choices.d: Yes, because the state tax does not divert import revenue from the federal government.

data.questionStem:
Q82025

A state statute requires corporations located in the state to pay an annual property tax based on the value of their inventory that is stored there. A tire distributor that imports tires manufactured in foreign countries and stores them at warehouses located in the state has sued to challenge the state tax, arguing that it is unconstitutional.

Is the state tax constitutional?

某州法规要求，位于该州的公司须根据其储存在该州的库存价值缴纳年度财产税。一家进口外国制造轮胎并将其储存在该州仓库的轮胎分销商提起诉讼，对该州税收提出质疑，主张其违宪。

该州税收是否合宪？
options:
A. No, because the import-export clause prohibits state taxes on imported goods.
不合宪，因为《进出口条款》(import-export clause) 禁止州对进口商品征税。

B. No, because the state tax discriminates against foreign commerce.
不合宪，因为该州税收歧视了对外贸易。

C. Yes, because states have absolute authority to tax goods within their borders.
合宪，因为各州拥有对其境内商品征税的绝对权力。

D. Yes, because the state tax does not divert import revenue from the federal government.
合宪，因为该州税收并未分流本应属于联邦政府的进口税收收入。
data.explanation:
The import-export clause generally prohibits state taxation of imported goods unless Congress consents or the tax is absolutely necessary for the state to execute its inspection laws. Additionally, a state tax on imported goods is valid if:
  • the federal government is still able to speak with one voice in foreign commerce
  • there is interstate harmony because the tax satisfies the Complete Auto requirements and
  • the tax does not divert import revenue from the federal government.


Here, the state tax does not impair the federal government's ability to speak with one voice because the tax applies after the goods have gone through the import process. This means that the federal government may still tax the goods as they are imported. The tax also does not disturb interstate harmony because it:
  • applies to inventory that is stored at the distributor's warehouses in the state (substantial nexus)
  • is based on a rational formula that only taxes the value of the inventory in the state (fairly apportioned)
  • applies equally to imported and domestic goods (nondiscriminatory) (Choice B) and
  • is reasonable compared to services and benefits provided by the state (fairly related).


Finally, the tax does not divert import revenue from the federal government since the tax applies after the goods have been imported. It merely compensates the state for goods stored in the state. Therefore, the state tax is constitutional (Choice A).

(Choice C) The Tenth Amendment reserves to the states any power that the Constitution does not expressly grant to the federal government, including the power to generally tax goods within their borders. But this power is not absolute because states must comply with other constitutional provisions (eg, the import-export clause).

Educational objective: A state tax on imported goods is valid if (1) the federal government is still able to speak with one voice in foreign commerce, (2) there is interstate harmony because the tax satisfies the Complete Auto requirements, and (3) the tax does not divert import revenue from the federal government.



选项正确率统计：A选项 16%，B选项 7%，C选项 34%，D选项 41%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

《进出口条款》(import-export clause) 通常禁止州对进口商品征税，除非国会同意，或者该税收是州执行其检验法律所绝对必需的。此外，州对进口商品的税收在以下情况下是有效的：
  • 联邦政府在对外贸易中仍能以统一的立场发声
  • 存在州际和谐，因为该税收满足 Complete Auto 案的要求并且
  • 该税收没有分流本应属于联邦政府的进口税收收入。


在本案中，该州税收并未损害联邦政府以统一立场发声的能力，因为该税收是在商品完成进口流程后才适用的。这意味着联邦政府仍然可以在商品进口时对其征税。该税收也未破坏州际和谐，因为它：
  • 适用于储存在该州分销商仓库中的库存（实质性联系）
  • 基于合理的公式，仅对州内库存的价值征税（公平分配）
  • 同等适用于进口商品和国内商品（非歧视性）（选项 B）并且
  • 与州提供的服务和利益相比是合理的（公平关联）。


最后，该税收没有分流联邦政府的进口税收收入，因为该税收是在商品进口之后才适用的。它仅仅是补偿州因商品储存在其境内而产生的成本。因此，该州税收是合宪的（选项 A）。

（选项 C）《第十修正案》将《宪法》未明确授予联邦政府的任何权力保留给各州，包括对其境内商品进行普遍征税的权力。但这项权力并非绝对，因为各州必须遵守其他宪法条款（例如，《进出口条款》(import-export clause)）。

教学目标：州对进口商品的税收是有效的，需满足以下条件：(1) 联邦政府在对外贸易中仍能以统一的立场发声；(2) 存在州际和谐，因为该税收满足 Complete Auto 案的要求；以及 (3) 该税收没有分流本应属于联邦政府的进口税收收入。

References

U.S. Const. art. 1, § 10, cl. 2 (state import-export clause).

Itel Containers Int'l Corp. v. Huddleston, 507 U.S. 60, 76 - 78 (1993) (setting forth the components of the modern import-export clause test).

71 Am. Jur. 2d State and Local Taxation § 74 (explaining when a state tax violates the import-export clause).

MBE 考点解析

宪法：进出口条款与州税收权
核心考点：进出口条款 (Import-Export Clause)

美国宪法第一条第10款第2项规定：未经国会同意，任何州不得对进出口货物征收“关税” (Imposts or Duties)。

现代测试标准 (Modern Test)

根据最高法院在 Michelin Tire Corp. v. Wages (1976) 案中的裁决，并非所有针对进口商品的税收都被禁止。只有属于“关税”性质的税收才被禁止。

判断州税是否违宪，需看其是否违反以下三个政策目标：

  1. 联邦统一发声 (One Voice)： 是否干扰联邦政府在对外关系中的统一立场？
  2. 联邦收入 (Federal Revenue)： 是否分流了本应属于联邦政府的进口关税收入？
  3. 州际和谐 (Interstate Harmony)： 是否破坏州际贸易和谐（例如对过境商品征税）？
本案分析逻辑
1
税收性质： 这是一个非歧视性的从价财产税 (Nondiscriminatory Ad Valorem Property Tax)。它针对的是州内所有企业的库存，而不仅仅是进口商品。
2
征税时机： 轮胎已经存放在该州的仓库中，处于“静止”状态，享受该州提供的公共服务（如警察、消防、道路）。
3
是否分流联邦收入？ 没有。该税收是对州内财产价值的征税，用于支付州服务的成本，而不是对“进口行为”本身征税。因此，它没有夺走联邦政府的关税收入。
✅ 正确答案：D

合宪，因为该州税收并未分流本应属于联邦政府的进口税收收入。

这是 Michelin 测试的三个分支之一。只要该税收是非歧视性的财产税，且针对的是已经停止运输并储存在州内的货物，它就不被视为宪法禁止的“关税” (Impost or Duty)。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (原包装原则)： 错误。旧的“原包装原则” (Original Package Doctrine) 认为只要货物还在原包装内就免税，但这一原则已被推翻。现在即使在原包装内，只要货物在该州有了实质性停留，就可以被征收非歧视性财产税。
选项 B (歧视)： 错误。题目明确指出该法规要求“位于该州的公司”纳税，并未针对外国商品进行特殊征税。相反，如果免除进口商品的税收，反而会歧视国内商品。
选项 C (绝对权力)： 错误。在宪法题中，看到“绝对权力” (Absolute Authority) 几乎总是错的。州的征税权受到《进出口条款》和《商业条款》 (Commerce Clause) 的限制。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
当看到“非歧视性从价财产税” (Nondiscriminatory Ad Valorem Property Tax) 作用于进口商品时：
  • 如果商品正在运输途中 (In Transit) ➡️ 州不能征税。
  • 如果商品已经到达目的地并储存 (Came to rest) ➡️ 州可以征税。
本题中轮胎已经存储在仓库，故可以征税。

questions.question:
Due to the high cost of labor, several large corporations shut down their manufacturing plants in a state and moved their operations overseas. This caused severe and continuous unemployment in the state, which relies heavily on manufacturing jobs and manufactured goods to spur its economy. In response, the state legislature enacted a statute that requires certain businesses selling goods in the state to purchase goods produced in the state in an amount equal to at least half of the business's annual sales in the state. This statute only applies to businesses with annual sales in the state that exceed $3 million.
A company that has annual sales in the state of $5 million challenges the state statute in federal court.
Which constitutional provision provides the strongest ground on which to attack this statute?

choices.a: The Article I commerce clause.
choices.b: The Fourteenth Amendment due process clause.
choices.c: The Fourteenth Amendment equal protection clause.
choices.d: The Fourteenth Amendment privileges or immunities clause.

data.questionStem:
Q82033

Due to the high cost of labor, several large corporations shut down their manufacturing plants in a state and moved their operations overseas. This caused severe and continuous unemployment in the state, which relies heavily on manufacturing jobs and manufactured goods to spur its economy. In response, the state legislature enacted a statute that requires certain businesses selling goods in the state to purchase goods produced in the state in an amount equal to at least half of the business's annual sales in the state. This statute only applies to businesses with annual sales in the state that exceed $3 million.

A company that has annual sales in the state of $5 million challenges the state statute in federal court.

Which constitutional provision provides the strongest ground on which to attack this statute?

由于高昂的劳动力成本，几家大公司关闭了其在本州的制造工厂，并将业务转移到海外。这在该州造成了严重且持续的失业问题，而该州的经济严重依赖制造业岗位和制成品来推动。作为回应，州立法机关颁布了一项法规，要求在该州销售商品的某些企业，其购买的本州生产的商品金额，必须至少等于该企业在该州年销售额的一半。该法规仅适用于在该州年销售额超过300万美元的企业。

一家在该州年销售额为500万美元的公司，在联邦法院对该州法规提出质疑。

哪一项宪法条款为攻击此项法规提供了最有力的依据？
options:
A. The Article I commerce clause.
Article I 的商业条款。

B. The Fourteenth Amendment due process clause.
第十四修正案的正当程序条款。

C. The Fourteenth Amendment equal protection clause.
第十四修正案的平等保护条款。

D. The Fourteenth Amendment privileges or immunities clause.
第十四修正案的特权或豁免条款。
data.explanation:
Dormant commerce clause (state regulation of interstate commerce)


Type of regulationExamplesStandard
Discriminatory
(favors in-state interests)
  • Taxing out-of-state products more heavily
  • Requiring use of in-state products/services
Unconstitutional unless:
furthers legitimate state interest and no reasonable alternative
Nondiscriminatory
(otherwise burdensome)
  • Prohibiting all commercial vehicles on state highways
  • Overly strict requirements for all commercial shipments
Unconstitutional if:
burden clearly exceeds local benefits
The Article I commerce clause gives Congress extensive authority to regulate interstate commerce. This clause also carries a negative implication (ie, the dormant commerce clause), which prohibits states from discriminating against or otherwise unduly burdening interstate commerce. Discrimination against interstate commerce - ie, favoring in-state over out-of-state economic interests - is unconstitutional unless (1) it furthers a legitimate, noneconomic state interest and (2) no reasonable alternative exists.

Here, the state statute discriminates against interstate commerce since it requires certain businesses to purchase substantial goods in the state at the expense of out-of-state competitors. The statute was enacted to relieve severe and continuous unemployment in the state. But since that interest is economic in nature, it cannot justify discrimination against interstate commerce. Therefore, the commerce clause is the strongest constitutional basis on which to attack this statute.

(Choice B) Under the Fourteenth Amendment due process clause, state laws that substantially impact a fundamental right are almost always found invalid under strict scrutiny. But since there is no fundamental right to engage in business, a due process challenge would likely fail.

(Choice C) Discriminatory state laws that substantially impact a fundamental right or protected class generally violate the Fourteenth Amendment equal protection clause. But since no fundamental right is implicated and businesses are not a protected class, the statute likely satisfies this clause.

(Choice D) The Fourteenth Amendment privileges or immunities clause prohibits states from infringing on the very limited rights of national citizenship - none of which are at issue here.

Educational objective: State laws that favor in-state over out-of-state economic interests violate the dormant commerce clause unless (1) they further a legitimate, noneconomic state interest and (2) no reasonable alternative exists.

选项正确率统计：A选项 61%（正确选项），B选项 6%，C选项 18%，D选项 13%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

休眠商业条款（州对州际商业的规制）


法规类型示例标准
歧视性
(偏袒州内利益)
  • 对州外产品征收更重的税
  • 要求使用州内产品/服务
违宪，除非：
为促进合法的州利益且无其他合理替代方案
非歧视性
(但在其他方面构成负担)
  • 禁止所有商用车辆在州高速公路上行驶
  • 对所有商业运输设定过于严格的要求
违宪，如果：
其负担明显超过本地利益
Article I 的商业条款赋予国会广泛的权力来规制州际商业。该条款也带有一项消极含义（即休眠商业条款），禁止各州歧视或以其他方式过度负担州际商业。对州际商业的歧视——即偏袒州内经济利益而非州外经济利益——是违宪的，除非（1）其旨在促进合法的、非经济性的州利益，并且（2）不存在合理的替代方案。

在本案中，该州法规歧视了州际商业，因为它要求某些企业以牺牲州外竞争者为代价，在该州内大量购买商品。该法规的颁布是为了缓解州内严重且持续的失业问题。但由于该利益本质上是经济性的，它不能成为歧视州际商业的正当理由。因此，商业条款是攻击此项法规最有力的宪法依据。

（选项B）根据第十四修正案的正当程序条款，对基本权利有重大影响的州法律，在严格审查下几乎总是被认定为无效。但由于从事商业活动并非一项基本权利，基于正当程序的质疑很可能会失败。

（选项C）对基本权利或受保护阶层有重大影响的歧视性州法律，通常违反第十四修正案的平等保护条款。但由于本案未涉及基本权利，且企业不属于受保护阶层，该法规很可能符合此条款。

（选项D）第十四修正案的特权或豁免条款禁止各州侵犯非常有限的国民公民权——本案中并未涉及这些权利。

教学目的： 偏袒州内经济利益而非州外经济利益的州法律，违反了休眠商业条款，除非（1）其旨在促进合法的、非经济性的州利益，并且（2）不存在合理的替代方案。

References

U.S. Const. art. I, § 8, cl. 3 (commerce clause).

Maine v. Taylor, 477 U.S. 131, 138 (1986) (explaining that the appropriate test for a dormant commerce clause challenge depends on whether the burden on interstate commerce is discriminatory or nondiscriminatory).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations
正确答案：A (Commerce Clause)

本题考察的核心是休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause, DCC)。这是MBE宪法部分非常高频的考点。

核心法律规则 虽然宪法 Article I 赋予国会管理州际商业的权力，但最高法院推导出该条款具有“消极”或“休眠”的一面：禁止各州通过歧视或过度负担州际商业的法律。

1. 判题逻辑：歧视性 vs. 非歧视性

在分析DCC问题时，首先要判断州法律是否对州外利益构成歧视 (Discrimination)。

类型 定义 审查标准
歧视性法规
(Discriminatory)		 偏袒州内经济利益，打压州外竞争者（如本题）。 几乎总是违宪 (Per se invalid)。
除非：
1. 目的为非经济的合法利益；
2. 无其他替代方案。
非歧视性法规
(Nondiscriminatory)		 对州内和州外企业一视同仁，但客观上阻碍了商业流通。 Pike 平衡测试：
只有当负担明显超过本地收益时才违宪。

2. 本案分析

  • 事实认定：该州法律要求企业购买“本州生产”的商品（Buy Local）。
  • 性质：这是典型的表面歧视 (Facial Discrimination)。它直接偏袒本州制造业，排斥外州商品。
  • 例外测试：
    • 州政府的目的是解决失业问题。虽然解决失业是好事，但在DCC分析中，这属于经济保护主义 (Economic Protectionism)。
    • 关键点：最高法院明确规定，经济利益不能作为歧视州际商业的正当理由。

因此，该法律违反了 Article I 的商业条款。

为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 B、C、D 都涉及第十四修正案 (14th Amendment)。对于一般的商业/经济法规（不涉及基本权利或受保护阶层）：

  • Due Process & Equal Protection: 仅适用合理基础审查 (Rational Basis Review)。只要法律与合法的政府利益（如减少失业）有合理关联即可通过。该州法律很可能通过此测试，因此这两条不是攻击法律的“最有力”依据。
  • Privileges or Immunities: 该条款在历史上被最高法院（Slaughter-House Cases）解释得非常狭窄，仅保护极少数的“国民权利”（如跨州迁徙权），几乎从不用于推翻商业法规。
💡 考场实战技巧
当题目中出现“州法律” (State Statute) 且该法律偏袒本地企业 (Favoring local business) 或 限制外州商品 (Restricting out-of-state goods) 时：
  1. 首先考虑 Dormant Commerce Clause。
  2. 如果目的是“保护本地经济”（如本题的就业），该法律必死无疑（违宪）。
  3. 如果目的是“健康或安全”（如禁止进口某种带病害的鱼），则可能幸存，但需证明没有其他替代手段。

questions.question:
Widgets are manufactured wholly from raw materials mined and processed in a state. The only two manufacturers of widgets in the United States are also located in that state. However, their widgets are purchased by retailers located in every state.
The state legislature is considering the adoption of a statute that would impose a tax solely on the manufacture of widgets. The tax is to be calculated at 3% of their wholesale value.
Which of the following arguments would be LEAST helpful to the state in defending the constitutionality of this proposed state tax on widgets?

choices.a: A tax on the manufacture of widgets may be imposed only by the state in which the manufacturing occurs and, therefore, it is not likely to create the danger of a multiple tax burden on interstate commerce.
choices.b: At the time widgets are manufactured and taxed they have not yet entered the channels of interstate commerce.
choices.c: Because of the powers reserved to them by the Tenth Amendment, states have plenary authority to construct their tax system in any manner they choose.
choices.d: The economic impact of this tax will be passed on to both in-state and out-of-state purchasers of widgets and, therefore, the tax is wholly nondiscriminatory in its effect.

data.questionStem:
Q82036

Widgets are manufactured wholly from raw materials mined and processed in a state. The only two manufacturers of widgets in the United States are also located in that state. However, their widgets are purchased by retailers located in every state.

The state legislature is considering the adoption of a statute that would impose a tax solely on the manufacture of widgets. The tax is to be calculated at 3% of their wholesale value.

Which of the following arguments would be LEAST helpful to the state in defending the constitutionality of this proposed state tax on widgets?

小部件完全由某州开采和加工的原材料制造。美国仅有的两家小部件制造商也位于该州。然而，他们的小部件被位于每个州的零售商购买。

该州立法机构正在考虑通过一项法规，专门对小部件的制造征税。该税款将按其批发价值的3%计算。

在为这项拟议的州级小部件税的合宪性进行辩护时，以下哪项论点对该州最没有帮助？
options:
A. A tax on the manufacture of widgets may be imposed only by the state in which the manufacturing occurs and, therefore, it is not likely to create the danger of a multiple tax burden on interstate commerce.
对小部件制造的征税只能由制造业所在的州进行，因此，这不太可能对州际贸易造成多重税收负担的风险。

B. At the time widgets are manufactured and taxed they have not yet entered the channels of interstate commerce.
在小部件被制造和征税时，它们尚未进入州际贸易的渠道。

C. Because of the powers reserved to them by the Tenth Amendment, states have plenary authority to construct their tax system in any manner they choose.
由于Tenth Amendment赋予各州的保留权力，各州拥有以其选择的任何方式构建其税收制度的全权。

D. The economic impact of this tax will be passed on to both in-state and out-of-state purchasers of widgets and, therefore, the tax is wholly nondiscriminatory in its effect.
此税的经济影响将转嫁给州内和州外的小部件购买者，因此，该税在其效果上是完全非歧视性的。
data.explanation:
State taxation of interstate commerce

(Complete Auto test) State tax on interstate commerce valid if tax:

  • applied to person or activity with substantial nexus to state

  • fairly apportioned to avoid taxing interstate activities performed in other states

  • does not discriminate against interstate commerce AND

  • fairly related to services & benefits provided by state


Under the Tenth Amendment, any power that the Constitution does not expressly grant to the federal government - including the power to construct a state tax system - is reserved to the states. But here, this is the least helpful argument for the state because this power is not plenary (ie, absolute). Instead, states must comply with other constitutional provisions. For example, a state tax on interstate commerce (as seen here) must comply with the dormant commerce clause and is only valid if it:

  • is applied to persons or activities with a substantial nexus to the state - eg, widgets manufactured from raw materials mined and processed in the state

  • is fairly apportioned to avoid taxing interstate activities performed in other states and thereby imposing multiple tax burdens - eg, tax imposed only in state where manufacturing occurs (Choice A), tax applied before widgets enter channels of interstate commerce (Choice B)

  • does not discriminate by favoring in-state over out-of-state entities - eg, economic impact passed on to both in-state and out-of-state purchasers (Choice D) and

  • is fairly related (ie, reasonable compared) to services and benefits provided by the state - eg, police protection, public roads.


Educational objective: Under the dormant commerce clause, states cannot tax interstate commerce unless the tax is (1) levied on persons or activities that have a substantial nexus with the state, (2) fairly apportioned, (3) nondiscriminatory, and (4) fairly related to state-provided services or benefits.

选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 26%，C选项 50%（正确选项），D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

对州际贸易的州税

(Complete Auto 测试) 对州际贸易的州税在以下情况下有效，如果该税：

  • 适用于与该州有实质性联系 (substantial nexus) 的个人或活动

  • 公平分摊 (fairly apportioned) 以避免对在其他州进行的州际活动征税

  • 不歧视 (not discriminate) 州际贸易，并且

  • 与州提供的服务和利益合理相关 (fairly related)


根据 Tenth Amendment，宪法未明确授予联邦政府的任何权力——包括建立州税收制度的权力——均保留给各州。但在此案中，这对该州来说是最没有帮助的论点，因为这种权力并非全权（即绝对的）。相反，各州必须遵守其他宪法规定。例如，对州际贸易的州税（如本案所示）必须遵守休眠商业条款 (dormant commerce clause)，并且仅在以下情况下有效：

  • 适用于与该州有实质性联系的个人或活动——例如，由该州开采和加工的原材料制造的小部件

  • 公平分摊以避免对在其他州进行的州际活动征税，从而施加多重税收负担——例如，仅在制造业发生的州征税（选项 A），在小部件进入州际贸易渠道前征税（选项 B）

  • 通过不偏袒州内实体而不歧视州外实体——例如，经济影响转嫁给州内和州外的购买者（选项 D）并且

  • 与州提供的服务和利益合理相关（即，合理比较）——例如，警察保护、公共道路。


教学目标：根据休眠商业条款 (dormant commerce clause)，各州不得对州际贸易征税，除非该税 (1) 针对与该州有实质性联系的个人或活动征收，(2) 公平分摊，(3) 非歧视性，以及 (4) 与州提供的服务或利益合理相关。

References

Complete Auto Transit, Inc. v. Brady, 430 U.S. 274, 279 (1977) (setting forth the four-factor test used to determine if a state tax violates the commerce clause).

71 Am. Jur. 2d State and Local Taxation § 157 (2019) (explaining how state taxation cannot unduly burden interstate commerce).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations & Taxation
正确答案：选项 C

理由：第十修正案（10th Amendment）并不是各州违反宪法其他条款（如商业条款）的“挡箭牌”。

核心考点：休眠商业条款

本题考察的是休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause) 对州政府征税权的限制。

虽然宪法没有明确禁止州对州际贸易征税，但最高法院通过判例确立了规则：如果国会没有立法，各州也不能通过歧视或过度负担的方式阻碍州际贸易。

Complete Auto 测试标准

根据 Complete Auto Transit v. Brady (1977) 案，一项针对州际贸易的州税必须满足以下四个条件才合宪：

  • 实质性联系 (Substantial Nexus)： 征税对象必须与该州有实质联系。
  • 公平分摊 (Fair Apportionment)： 税收必须根据在该州进行的活动比例进行分摊，避免多重征税。
  • 非歧视性 (Nondiscrimination)： 不得歧视州外商业。
  • 合理相关 (Fair Relationship)： 税收必须与州提供的服务（如警察、道路）合理相关。
为什么 C 选项最没有帮助？

题目要求选出最没有帮助 (LEAST helpful) 的辩护理由。

选项 C 声称：根据第十修正案，各州拥有构建其税收制度的“全权” (Plenary Authority)。

法律缺陷：这是一个致命的法律错误。虽然第十修正案保留了各州的权力，但这些权力受制于宪法（根据至高条款 Supremacy Clause）。

各州的征税权不是绝对的 (Not Plenary)。如果州税违反了商业条款（例如歧视州际贸易），那么无论第十修正案如何规定，该税都是违宪的。因此，声称拥有“绝对权力”在法庭上是无效的辩护。

为什么其他选项是有帮助的？

其他三个选项都在试图证明该税符合 Complete Auto 测试的要求：

  • 选项 A (公平分摊)： 强调制造只发生在一个州，因此不会有其他州对同一活动征税，避免了“多重税收负担”。这是在辩护该税符合 Fair Apportionment。
  • 选项 B (实质性联系/时机)： 强调征税发生在进入州际贸易渠道之前。这有助于证明该税是针对州内活动（制造）的，符合 Substantial Nexus，且历史上曾被视为不属于“商业”范畴（虽然现代观点已变，但这仍是一个支持州权的论点）。
  • 选项 D (非歧视性)： 强调税负由州内和州外购买者共同承担，证明该税没有歧视外州人。这是在辩护该税符合 Nondiscrimination。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧：

看到 "Plenary" (全权/绝对)、"Unlimited" (无限) 这样的词描述州权力时要高度警惕。在联邦宪法架构下，各州的权力极少是绝对的，通常都要受到联邦宪法（特别是商业条款和第十四修正案）的限制。

当题目问“最没有帮助的论点”时，通常是在寻找一个法律上错误的陈述，或者一个被判例法明确驳回的理论。

questions.question:
A federal statute requires all owners of mineral springs to pay a sales tax on the mineral water they sell. A state that sells mineral water from the springs that it owns has refused to pay the tax. The United States has sued the state in federal court, seeking payment of the tax. The state has moved to dismiss the action.
Is the court likely to dismiss the action?

choices.a: No, because Congress has unlimited power to tax and spend for the general welfare.
choices.b: No, because the nondiscriminatory tax does not interfere with the essential functions of state government.
choices.c: Yes, because the Eleventh Amendment prohibits states from being sued in federal court without the state's consent.
choices.d: Yes, because the Tenth Amendment grants states immunity from all direct federal taxation.

data.questionStem:
Q82034

A federal statute requires all owners of mineral springs to pay a sales tax on the mineral water they sell. A state that sells mineral water from the springs that it owns has refused to pay the tax. The United States has sued the state in federal court, seeking payment of the tax. The state has moved to dismiss the action.

Is the court likely to dismiss the action?

一项联邦法规要求所有矿泉的所有者对其销售的矿泉水缴纳销售税。一个州份从其拥有的泉水中销售矿泉水，但拒绝缴纳该税。美国已在联邦法院起诉该州，要求其支付税款。该州已动议驳回此诉讼。

法院是否可能驳回此诉讼？
options:
A. No, because Congress's power to tax applies to states in the same way it applies to individuals and businesses.
不会，因为国会对州政府的征税权与其对个人和企业的征税权相同。

B. No, because the nondiscriminatory tax does not interfere with the essential functions of state government.
不会，因为这项非歧视性税收不会干涉州政府的基本职能。

C. Yes, because the Eleventh Amendment prohibits states from being sued in federal court without the state's consent.
会，因为 Eleventh Amendment 禁止在未经州份同意的情况下，在联邦法院起诉州份。

D. Yes, because the Tenth Amendment grants states immunity from all direct federal taxation.
会，因为 Tenth Amendment 授予州份豁免权，使其免于所有直接的联邦税收。
data.explanation:
Article I grants Congress the broad power to tax and spend for the general welfare. However, when exercising this power, Congress must comply with other constitutional provisions. This includes the Tenth Amendment, which prohibits Congress from imposing federal taxes on states that:
  • discriminate against states because the taxes apply to states and their agencies but not private individuals or entities or
  • would unduly interfere with the states' essential functions, including property used for or income received from the state's performance of traditional government actions (eg, public schools, state parks).

However, the Tenth Amendment does not immunize states from nondiscriminatory federal taxes that apply to the public and private sectors and do not interfere with essential state functions (Choice D).

Here, the federal sales tax is nondiscriminatory since it applies to all private and public owners of mineral springs who sell mineral water. The tax also does not unduly interfere with essential state functions because selling mineral water (or any other product) is a business action - not a traditional government action. As a result, the Tenth Amendment does not immunize the state from the tax, so the court is not likely to dismiss the action.

(Choice A) This statement is an oversimplification and therefore incorrect. While Congress has a broad power to tax, the Tenth Amendment places limitations on the federal government's ability to tax states that do not apply to its taxation of private individuals and businesses. A federal tax cannot, for example, unduly interfere with a state's essential government functions. Therefore, the power is not applied in exactly 'the same way.'

(Choice C) The Eleventh Amendment generally prohibits private parties and foreign governments from suing a state in federal court without the state's consent. However, this amendment does not bar actions brought by the United States (as seen here).

Educational objective: The Tenth Amendment immunizes states from federal taxes that discriminate against states or unduly interfere with essential state functions.

Article I 授予 Congress 为公共福祉而征税和支出的广泛权力。然而，在行使此权力时，Congress 必须遵守其他宪法规定。这包括 Tenth Amendment，该修正案禁止 Congress 对满足以下条件的州份征收联邦税：
  • 歧视州份，因为税收适用于州份及其机构，但不适用于私人个人或实体 或
  • 会不当干涉州份的基本职能，包括用于或源自州份履行传统政府行为（例如，公立学校、州立公园）的财产或收入。

然而，Tenth Amendment 并不使州份豁免于那些适用于公共和私营部门且不干涉州份基本职能的非歧视性联邦税收（选项D）。

在本案中，联邦销售税是非歧视性的，因为它适用于所有销售矿泉水的矿泉的私人和公共所有者。该税收也未不当干涉州份基本职能，因为销售矿泉水（或任何其他产品）是一种商业行为——而非传统的政府行为。因此，Tenth Amendment 并不使该州豁免于此税，所以法院不可能驳回此诉讼。

(选项A) 这个说法过于简化，因此不正确。虽然国会拥有广泛的征税权，但第十修正案对联邦政府向州征税的能力施加了限制，而这些限制不适用于对私人个人和企业的征税。例如，联邦税收不能不当干涉州政府的基本职能。因此，这项权力的适用方式并非完全“相同”。

（选项C）Eleventh Amendment 通常禁止私人当事人和外国政府在未经州份同意的情况下，在联邦法院起诉一个州。然而，该修正案不禁止由美国提起的诉讼（如本案所示）。

教学目标：Tenth Amendment 使州份豁免于那些歧视州份或不当干涉州份基本职能的联邦税收。

References

New York v. United States, 326 U.S. 572, 582 (1946) (holding that a state is not immune from a nondiscriminatory federal tax that does not interfere with essential state functions).

MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations (联邦与州的关系)
核心法律规则

Intergovernmental Tax Immunity (政府间税收豁免权)

联邦政府有权对州政府的活动征税，但必须满足两个条件：

  1. 非歧视性 (Nondiscriminatory)：税收必须同样适用于私营部门，不能仅针对州政府。
  2. 不干涉基本职能 (No Interference with Essential Functions)：税收不能不当干涉州的主权职能（如立法、执法、司法）。

如果州政府从事的是商业活动 (Proprietary/Business Activities)，而非传统的政府职能，且税收是非歧视性的，则州政府没有豁免权。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 B)

本题中，联邦税收针对的是所有矿泉水销售者（包括私人和公共所有者），因此它是非歧视性 (Nondiscriminatory) 的。

其次，销售矿泉水属于一种商业行为，并非州政府的“基本职能” (Essential Sovereign Function)。

结论： 既然税收是非歧视性的，且未干涉州的核心主权，联邦政府有权征收，法院不会驳回诉讼。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？

选项 A (过于绝对)：

虽然联邦征税权很广，但并非与对个人征税“完全相同”。第十修正案 (10th Amendment) 仍然保护州免受那些会“摧毁”其主权存在的税收。如果税收直接针对州的基本职能（如对州议会大楼征收房产税），则是违宪的。

选项 C (程序性陷阱)：

这是一个常见的 MBE 陷阱。第十一修正案 (11th Amendment) 确实禁止个人起诉州，但它不禁止联邦政府 (The United States) 起诉州。本案原告是美国政府，因此诉讼有效。

选项 D (误解豁免权范围)：

州并没有豁免于“所有”直接联邦税收。只要税收是非歧视性的且不破坏州的主权，州就必须像普通企业一样纳税。

💡 MBE 提分技巧

遇到“联邦向州征税”的题目，请按以下步骤思考：

  • 第一步： 该税是仅针对州（歧视性），还是针对所有人（普遍适用）？如果是普遍适用，通常是合宪的。
  • 第二步： 该活动是核心政府职能（如警察、立法），还是商业活动（如卖水、经营公园）？如果是商业活动，通常没有豁免权。
  • 第三步： 检查原告是谁。如果是 United States v. State，第十一修正案不适用。

In making this assertion, the representative played a recording of a phone conversation between the senator and staff member in which they admitted having such a relationship. The representative obtained the recording from an acquaintance, who had placed an illegal wiretap on the staff member's phone.
One year later, the federal government initiated a prosecution against the state representative for violating a federal criminal statute that prohibits the intentional publication of communications that were unlawfully recorded. The representative has moved to dismiss the action.

choices.a: No.

一名州众议员在州立法机构的议事厅发表演讲，在演讲中，她声称一名州参议员与一名工作人员发生性关系，从而违反了立法机构的道德准则。在做出这一断言时，该众议员播放了一段参议员与该工作人员之间的电话通话录音，录音中他们承认了有此种关系。该众议员从一位熟人处获得了该录音，此人对该工作人员的电话进行了非法窃听。

一年后，联邦政府对该州众议员提起诉讼，指控其违反了一项联邦刑事法规，该法规禁止故意公布通过非法录音获取的通讯内容。根据该法规，被判有罪者将被处以一年监禁和罚款。

该众议员已动议驳回此项诉讼。

法院是否可能驳回此项诉讼？
options:
A. No.
不会。

B. Yes, because state legislators are absolutely immune from liability for actions taken pursuant to their official legislative functions.
会，因为州立法者对其根据其官方立法职能所采取的行动享有绝对豁免权，可免于承担责任。

C. Yes, because the Eleventh Amendment bars actions of this kind in federal court.
会，因为 Eleventh Amendment 禁止在联邦法院进行此类诉讼。

D. Yes, because the speech or debate clause wholly insulates state legislators from civil and criminal liability for legislative activity.
会，因为 speech or debate clause 完全使州立法者免于因立法活动而承担民事和刑事责任。
data.explanation:
State legislative immunity


Absolute immunity for legislative actsstate civil or criminal action
federal civil action
No immunity for legislative actsfederal criminal action
State legislators generally possess absolute immunity from state civil or criminal liability for actions taken pursuant to official legislative functions (eg, making speeches in the legislature).† In the context of federal civil and criminal liability, the Supreme Court has held that a state legislator's absolute immunity :
  • extends to federal civil liability because the federal government's interest in ensuring private civil actions is outweighed by the substantial impact such actions have on state legislative functions but
  • does not extend to federal criminal liability because the federal government's important interest in enforcing criminal statutes outweighs the minimal impact prosecutions have on state legislative functions.

As a result, the state representative is not immune from federal prosecution for violating the federal statute, and the court will likely not dismiss the action (Choice B).

†State legislative immunity derives from the common law. Today, most states have codified legislative immunity in their constitutions or statutes.

(Choice C) The Eleventh Amendment generally prohibits private parties and foreign governments from suing a state or state official for money damages in federal court. However, this amendment does not apply to actions initiated by another state or the United States (as seen here).

(Choice D) The speech or debate clause of the U.S. Constitution wholly insulates members of Congress, but not state legislators, from civil and criminal liability for any official legislative activity.

Educational objective: A state legislator has absolute immunity from federal civil liability for official legislative actions. However, this immunity does not extend to federal criminal liability.

选项正确率统计：A选项 57%（正确选项），B选项 14%，C选项 1%，D选项 25%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

州立法豁免权


对立法行为的绝对豁免州民事或刑事诉讼
联邦民事诉讼
对立法行为无豁免联邦刑事诉讼
州立法者就其根据官方立法职能采取的行动（例如，在立法机构中发表演讲），通常享有免于承担州民事或刑事责任的绝对豁免权。† 在联邦民事和刑事责任方面，最高法院裁定，州立法者的绝对豁免权：
  • 适用于联邦民事责任，因为联邦政府在确保私人提起的民事诉讼中的利益，不及此类诉讼对州立法职能的重大影响重要，但是
  • 不适用于联邦刑事责任，因为联邦政府在执行刑事法规方面的重要利益，超过了刑事诉讼对州立法职能的微小影响。

因此，该州众议员因违反联邦法规而受到的联邦起诉不享有豁免权，法院可能不会驳回此项诉讼（选项 B）。

†州立法豁免权源于普通法。如今，大多数州已在其宪法或法规中将立法豁免权法典化。

（选项 C）Eleventh Amendment 通常禁止私人和外国政府在联邦法院就金钱损害赔偿起诉一个州或州官员。然而，该修正案不适用于由另一个州或美国提起的诉讼（如本案所示）。

（选项 D）U.S. Constitution 的 speech or debate clause 完全使国会议员（但不是州立法者）免于因任何官方立法活动而承担民事和刑事责任。

教学目标：州立法者对其官方立法行为享有免于联邦民事责任的绝对豁免权。然而，这种豁免权不适用于联邦刑事责任。

References

  • Tenney v. Brandhove, 341 U.S. 367, 378 - 79 (1951) (holding that state legislators are immune from civil liability for acts performed in the regular course of the legislative process).
  • United States v. Gillock, 445 U.S. 360, 373 (1980) (stating that a state legislator is subject to criminal prosecution for a violation of federal law).
  • 72 Am. Jur. 2d States, Territories, and Dependencies § 62 (2020) (explaining state legislative immunity).

MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations / Constitutional Law
正确答案：A (No)
核心结论：法院不会驳回此案。虽然州立法者在履行立法职能时享有广泛的豁免权，但这种豁免权不适用于联邦刑事起诉。
⚖️ 法律依据与推理
本题考察的是州立法豁免权 (State Legislative Immunity) 的边界。我们需要区分两个维度：
  1. 主体：是联邦国会议员还是州议员？
  2. 责任类型：是民事责任 (Civil Liability) 还是刑事责任 (Criminal Liability)？
关键规则 (The Rule)：
根据联邦普通法，州立法者对其官方立法行为（如在议会发表演讲）享有免受联邦民事诉讼的绝对豁免权。

⚠️ 但是： 这种豁免权并不延伸至联邦刑事诉讼。
参见判例：United States v. Gillock (1980)
本案分析：
虽然该众议员的行为（在议会发表演讲）属于典型的立法活动，且如果这是一起民事诽谤诉讼，她将享有豁免权。但本案是联邦政府提起的刑事起诉（违反联邦窃听法规）。最高法院认为，联邦执行刑事法律的重大利益超过了保护州立法独立性的利益。因此，她不能免于受审。
📊 豁免权速记矩阵
诉讼类型 联邦国会议员
(Speech or Debate Clause)		 州立法者
(Common Law)
民事责任 ✅ 豁免 ✅ 豁免 (针对立法行为)
刑事责任 ✅ 豁免 (针对立法行为) ❌ 无豁免 (联邦刑事)
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 B (Yes, absolute immunity...)：
错误。该选项混淆了民事和刑事豁免。虽然州立法者对立法行为享有绝对的民事豁免权，但如上所述，这不适用于联邦刑事起诉。
选项 C (Eleventh Amendment)：
错误。第十一修正案 (Eleventh Amendment) 禁止私人公民在联邦法院起诉州政府。但它不禁止联邦政府 (United States) 起诉一个州或州官员。本案原告是联邦政府。
选项 D (Speech or Debate Clause)：
错误。这是一个常见的陷阱。美国宪法中的 Speech or Debate Clause (Art. I, § 6) 仅适用于联邦国会议员，不适用于州立法者。州立法者的豁免权来自普通法，而非宪法此条款。

questions.question:
A state owned and operated an electric power system, which included a nuclear power plant. In order to ensure the availability of sites for the disposal of spent fuel from the nuclear power plant, the state refused to supply electric power to out-of-state purchasers residing in states that would not accept spent fuel from the plant for storage or disposal.
Assume that no federal statute applies.
Which of the following is the strongest argument that the state's action is constitutional?

choices.a: A state may condition the sale to out-of-state purchasers of any products produced in that state on the willingness of those purchasers to bear their fair share of the environmental costs of producing those products.
choices.b: The generation of electricity is intrastate by nature and therefore subject to plenary state control.
choices.c: The state itself owns and operates the power system, and therefore its refusal to supply power to out-of-state purchasers is not subject to the negative implications of the commerce clause.
choices.d: The state's action is rationally related to the health, safety, and welfare of state citizens.

data.questionStem:
Q82810 A state owned and operated an electric power system, which included a nuclear power plant. In order to ensure the availability of sites for the disposal of spent fuel from the nuclear power plant, the state refused to supply electric power to out-of-state purchasers residing in states that would not accept spent fuel from the plant for storage or disposal.

Assume that no federal statute applies.

Which of the following is the strongest argument that the state's action is constitutional? 一个州拥有并运营着一个电力系统，其中包括一座核电站。为了确保有可用的场址来处理核电站的乏燃料，该州拒绝向那些不愿接收该电站乏燃料进行储存或处置的州的州外购买者供电。

假设没有联邦法规适用。

以下哪项是支持该州行为合宪的最有力论据？
options:
A. A state may condition the sale to out-of-state purchasers of any products produced in that state on the willingness of those purchasers to bear their fair share of the environmental costs of producing those products.
一个州可以将在本州生产的任何产品销售给州外购买者的条件，设置为这些购买者愿意承担生产这些产品所产生的环境成本中的公平份额。

B. The generation of electricity is intrastate by nature and therefore subject to plenary state control.
发电本质上是州内行为，因此受到州的完全控制。

C. The state itself owns and operates the power system, and therefore its refusal to supply power to out-of-state purchasers is not subject to the negative implications of the commerce clause.
该州自己拥有并运营该电力系统，因此其拒绝向州外购买者供电的行为不受《商业条款》消极含义的约束。

D. The state's action is rationally related to the health, safety, and welfare of state citizens.
该州的行为与州公民的健康、安全和福祉有合理关联。
data.explanation:
The commerce clause grants Congress extensive authority to regulate interstate commerce. And the negative implication of this clause (ie, the dormant commerce clause) prohibits states from discriminating against or otherwise unduly burdening interstate commerce. But states are not restrained by this clause when they participate in the market by, for example, buying or selling goods or services (ie, market-participant exception).

Here, the state discriminated against interstate commerce by refusing to supply electricity to out-of-state purchasers residing in states that would not store or dispose of spent fuel. But since the state itself owns and operates the power system, the market-participant exception applies. As a result, the state's refusal to supply power is not subject to the negative implications of the commerce clause. Therefore, this is the strongest argument that its action is constitutional.

(Choice A) Discrimination against interstate commerce may be justified if it furthers a legitimate, noneconomic state interest and no reasonable alternative exists. But a state's economic interest in sharing the environmental costs of production with out-of-state purchasers cannot justify such discrimination.

(Choice B) Although generating electricity is intrastate (ie, within a state) by nature, supplying electricity to out-of-state purchasers is an interstate activity. But a state does not violate the dormant commerce clause by refusing to supply electricity to out-of-state purchasers when, as here, the state is acting as a market participant.

(Choice D) All powers not explicitly granted to the federal government by the Constitution are reserved to the states through the Tenth Amendment. This includes the states' police power to take action that is rationally related to protecting the health, safety, and welfare of its citizens. But this power does not allow states to violate other constitutional provisions—including the dormant commerce clause.



《商业条款》授予国会管理州际商业的广泛权力。而该条款的消极含义（即休眠商业条款）禁止各州歧视或以其他方式过度负担州际商业。但是，当州作为市场参与者（例如，购买或销售商品或服务）时，它们不受此条款的约束（即市场参与者例外）。

在本案中，该州通过拒绝向那些不愿储存或处置乏燃料的州的州外购买者供电，从而歧视了州际商业。但由于该州自己拥有并运营该电力系统，因此市场参与者例外原则适用。因此，该州拒绝供电的行为不受《商业条款》消极含义的约束。所以，这是支持其行为合宪的最有力论据。

（选项A）如果对州际商业的歧视是为了促进合法的、非经济性的州利益，并且没有合理的替代方案，那么这种歧视可能是正当的。但是，一个州希望与州外购买者分担生产环境成本的经济利益，不能成为这种歧视的正当理由。

（选项B）尽管发电本质上是州内（即在一州之内）行为，但向州外购买者供电是一种州际活动。但是，当一个州作为市场参与者行事时（如此案），其拒绝向州外购买者供电并不违反休眠商业条款。

（选项D）《宪法》未明确授予联邦政府的所有权力，都通过《第十修正案》保留给各州。这包括各州采取与其公民的健康、安全和福祉有合理关联的行动的警察权。但这项权力不允许各州违反其他宪法规定——包括休眠商业条款。

Educational objective:
A state's activities are not restricted by the dormant commerce clause when the state is acting as a market participant (as opposed to a market regulator).

References

  • U.S. Const. art. I, § 8, cl. 3 (commerce clause).

  • Reeves, Inc. v. Stake, 447 U.S. 429, 439–40 (1980) (holding that a state is not subject to the dormant commerce clause when it acts as a market participant).

  • 15A Am. Jur. 2d Commerce § 33 (2019) (explaining the market-participant exception to the dormant commerce clause).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law | Dormant Commerce Clause

核心考点：市场参与者例外 The Market Participant Exception
本题考察的是休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause) 的一个重要例外。通常情况下，各州不得歧视州际商业或对其施加过度负担。
但是，当州政府不再是“监管者 (Regulator)”，而是作为“市场参与者 (Market Participant)”（即买方或卖方）进入市场时，它就不受休眠商业条款的约束。
为什么选 C 是正确的？
正确答案 C
分析：题目明确指出该州“拥有并运营 (owned and operated)”该电力系统。

这意味着该州在市场上销售电力，就像任何私人企业一样。根据市场参与者例外原则，该州有权选择它的交易对象（Trading Partners）。它可以决定只卖给本州居民，或者只卖给那些愿意接收核废料的州的居民。

因为该州是市场参与者，所以它拒绝向特定州外购买者供电的行为，完全豁免于休眠商业条款的限制。
相关判例参考：
Reeves, Inc. v. Stake (1980)
最高法院裁定，南达科他州拥有的水泥厂可以在水泥短缺期间优先向本州居民出售水泥，而拒绝向州外买家出售。法院认为，当州作为私营企业的经营者行事时，它享有与私营贸易商相同的选择交易对象的权利。
为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A 错误 试图用“环境成本公平份额”来辩护。如果州是作为监管者（Regulator）行事，这种基于经济利益的歧视通常是违宪的。只有“市场参与者例外”才能为这种明显的歧视提供强有力的宪法依据。
选项 B 错误 声称发电是“州内行为 (Intrastate)”。这是错误的法律结论。电力一旦进入电网跨境传输，就是典型的州际商业 (Interstate Commerce)。
选项 D 错误 声称这与“健康、安全和福祉 (Police Power)”有关。虽然州有警察权，但如果州作为监管者公然歧视州际商业（只卖给某些州，不卖给其他州），通常需要通过严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)，即证明该措施对于实现非经济的合法目的至关重要且没有替代方案。这是一个很难满足的标准。相比之下，选项 C 的“市场参与者例外”是一个绝对的抗辩理由，不需要进行复杂的利益平衡。
MBE 考试技巧
遇到涉及州政府歧视外州人的题目时，请按以下步骤思考：
  1. 第一步：看是否有联邦法律授权？（本题说 Assume no federal statute applies）。
  2. 第二步：看州政府的角色。
    • 如果是制定规则限制私人交易 ➡️ 适用休眠商业条款（通常违宪）。
    • 如果是自己买卖商品/服务 ➡️ 适用市场参与者例外（通常合宪）。
看到 "State owned and operated" 这种字眼，立刻联想 Market Participant Exception。

questions.question:
A state law requires any lawn mower sold in the state to meet a specified minimum level of fuel efficiency.
A new federal statute requires all power equipment, including lawn mowers, to be labeled with energy efficiency stickers to permit purchasers to make informed choices when buying such equipment. The statute does not expressly preempt state law.
Assume that no other federal statute or administrative regulation addresses the energy efficiency of power equipment.
Which of the following is the best argument the state can make for the continued validity of its law?

choices.a: Congress cannot preempt state laws requiring a specified minimum level of fuel efficiency for lawn mowers, because the use of such equipment is a wholly local event and, therefore, is beyond the regulatory authority vested in Congress by the commerce clause.
choices.b: The law is unaffected by the federal statute, because Congress did not expressly prohibit state laws requiring power equipment to meet specified levels of fuel efficiency.
choices.c: The purpose of the law is consistent with the purpose of the federal statute, enforcement of the law would not interfere with the full execution of the statute, and there is no evidence that Congress intended to preclude the states from enacting supplemental laws on this subject.
choices.d: There is a very strong presumption that a specific state law on a subject normally within the state's police power prevails over a more general federal statute, because the Tenth Amendment reserves to the states primary authority over matters affecting public health, welfare, and safety.

data.questionStem:
Q82816 A state law requires any lawn mower sold in the state to meet a specified minimum level of fuel efficiency.

A new federal statute requires all power equipment, including lawn mowers, to be labeled with energy efficiency stickers to permit purchasers to make informed choices when buying such equipment. The statute does not expressly preempt state law.

Assume that no other federal statute or administrative regulation addresses the energy efficiency of power equipment.

Which of the following is the best argument the state can make for the continued validity of its law? 州法律要求，在该州销售的任何割草机都必须达到规定的最低燃油效率水平。

一项新的联邦法规要求，所有动力设备（包括割草机）都必须贴上能效标签，以便购买者在购买此类设备时能够做出明智的选择。该法规并未明示优先于州法律适用。

假设没有其他联邦法规或行政法规涉及动力设备的能效问题。

为维持其法律的持续有效性，该州可以提出的最佳论点是以下哪一项？
options:
A. Congress cannot preempt state laws requiring a specified minimum level of fuel efficiency for lawn mowers, because the use of such equipment is a wholly local event and, therefore, is beyond the regulatory authority vested in Congress by the commerce clause.
国会不能优先适用州法律，因为使用此类设备纯属地方性活动，因此超出了《商业条款》赋予国会的监管权力。

B. The law is unaffected by the federal statute, because Congress did not expressly prohibit state laws requiring power equipment to meet specified levels of fuel efficiency.
该州法律不受联邦法规的影响，因为国会并未明示禁止州法律要求动力设备达到特定的燃油效率水平。

C. The purpose of the law is consistent with the purpose of the federal statute, enforcement of the law would not interfere with the full execution of the statute, and there is no evidence that Congress intended to preclude the states from enacting supplemental laws on this subject.
该州法律的目的与联邦法规的目的相一致，执行该州法律不会妨碍联邦法规的全面执行，且没有证据表明国会有意阻止各州就此主题制定补充性法律。

D. There is a very strong presumption that a specific state law on a subject normally within the state's police power prevails over a more general federal statute, because the Tenth Amendment reserves to the states primary authority over matters affecting public health, welfare, and safety.
存在一个非常强的推定，即在通常属于州警察权范围内的事项上，特定的州法律优先于更宽泛的联邦法规，因为《第十修正案》将影响公共健康、福利和安全事务的主要权力保留给了各州。
data.explanation:
The Article VI supremacy clause allows a federal law to preempt a conflicting state law, thereby rendering the state law void and without effect. But there is a presumption against preemption—whether express or implied—that can only be overcome when Congress clearly intended to supersede the state law.

Here, the federal statute requiring power equipment (including lawn mowers) to have energy efficiency stickers does not expressly preempt the state law requiring lawn mowers to meet a minimum fuel-efficiency level. But the state must also show that the federal statute does not impliedly preempt the state law (Choice B). It can do so here because:

† there is no evidence that Congress intended to fully occupy the field of power equipment, leaving no room for supplemental state laws (no field preemption)

† enforcement of the state law would not directly interfere with the full execution of the federal statute since a lawn mower can satisfy both laws' requirements (no direct conflict preemption) and

† the state and federal laws have consistent purposes since both aim to promote energy efficiency (no indirect conflict preemption).

Therefore, this is the state's best argument for the continued validity of its law.

(Choice A) The commerce clause gives Congress the power to regulate local activities that, singly or in the aggregate, substantially impact interstate commerce. Although the use of lawn mowers is a local activity, their aggregated sales likely have a substantial impact on interstate commerce. As a result, they are within Congress's regulatory authority.

(Choice D) The Tenth Amendment reserves to the states all powers that the Constitution does not expressly grant to the federal government—including the police power to enact and enforce laws that protect the public's health, safety, and welfare. But there is no presumption that state laws prevail over federal laws.

Educational objective: The supremacy clause allows federal laws to expressly or impliedly preempt conflicting state laws. But there is a presumption against preemption that is only overcome when Congress clearly intended to supersede state laws.



第六条“至上条款”允许联邦法律优先于与之冲突的州法律适用，从而使州法律无效。但存在一种反对优先适用的推定——无论是明示的还是默示的——只有当国会有明确意图取代州法律时，这种推定才能被推翻。

在本案中，要求动力设备（包括割草机）贴上能效标签的联邦法规并未明示优先适用于州法律，即该州要求割草机达到最低燃油效率水平的法律。但该州还必须证明联邦法规并未默示优先适用于州法律（选项 B）。在本案中，州可以这样做，因为：

† 没有证据表明国会有意完全占据动力设备这一领域，从而不给补充性的州法律留有任何空间（不存在领域优先适用）

† 执行州法律不会与联邦法规的全面执行产生直接冲突，因为割草机可以同时满足两部法律的要求（不存在直接冲突优先适用），并且

† 州法律和联邦法律具有一致的目的，因为两者都旨在提高能源效率（不存在间接冲突优先适用）。

因此，这是该州为其法律的持续有效性可以提出的最佳论点。

（选项 A）《商业条款》赋予国会权力，可以监管那些单独或总体上对州际贸易产生重大影响的地方性活动。尽管割草机的使用是地方性活动，但其销售总额很可能对州际贸易产生重大影响。因此，它们属于国会的监管权力范围。

（选项 D）《第十修正案》将《宪法》未明确授予联邦政府的所有权力保留给各州——包括制定和执行保护公众健康、安全和福利的法律的警察权。但并无州法律优先于联邦法律的推定。

教学目的： “至上条款”允许联邦法律明示或默示地优先于与之冲突的州法律。但是，存在一种反对优先适用的推定，只有当国会有明确意图取代州法律时，这种推定才能被推翻。

References

† Gade v. Nat'l Solid Wastes Mgmt. Ass'n, 505 U.S. 88, 98 (1992) (explaining when federal law expressly or impliedly preempts state law).
  • 16A Am. Jur. 2d Constitutional Law § 234 (2019) (stating the tests used to determine preemption).

MBE 宪法考点解析

联邦优先权 (Preemption)
⚖️ 核心考点：至上条款

本题考查的是美国宪法第六条的至上条款 (Supremacy Clause)。当联邦法律与州法律发生冲突时，联邦法律优先。

联邦优先适用 (Preemption) 的三种形式：
  1. 明示优先 (Express Preemption)：国会明确说明禁止州立法。
  2. 领域优先 (Field Preemption)：联邦监管非常全面，不给州法留空间。
  3. 冲突优先 (Conflict Preemption)：
    • 无法同时遵守两者 (Physical Impossibility)。
    • 州法阻碍了联邦目标的实现 (Obstacle)。
✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 C)

本题要求找出州政府维护其法律有效性的最佳论点。

案情分析：

  • 州法：要求最低燃油效率（实质标准）。
  • 联邦法：要求贴能效标签（信息披露），且未明示优先于州法。

为什么 C 是最佳论点？

1
排除明示优先：题目已说明联邦法规没有明示优先条款。
2
排除领域优先：没有证据表明国会想独占“动力设备”的所有监管权。
3
排除冲突优先：这是关键。
• 制造商可以既制造高效率机器（满足州法），又贴上标签（满足联邦法）。
• 州法的目的（提高效率）与联邦法（通过标签促进选择）是一致的 (Consistent)，而非冲突。

因此，州政府最有力的反驳是：不存在任何形式的默示优先 (Implied Preemption)。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (商业条款)：
Commerce Clause。这是个很糟糕的论点。虽然割草是地方活动，但其销售属于州际贸易。根据 Wickard v. Filburn 原则，国会有权监管。州政府如果用这个理由，必输无疑。

选项 B (仅依赖未明示)：
这个论点太弱。仅仅因为国会没有“明示”禁止，并不意味着州法就安全了。州法仍可能因为“默示优先”（如冲突或领域独占）而被废止。

选项 D (第十修正案推定)：
10th Amendment。这是一个常见的陷阱。虽然有“反对优先适用的推定” (Presumption against preemption)，但这并不意味着州法在冲突时自动优先于联邦法。至上条款明确规定联邦法是最高法律。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到 Preemption (优先权) 问题时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 找明示：题目有没有说 "Federal law expressly prohibits..."？
  2. 找冲突：能不能同时遵守两部法律？(本题可以)
  3. 找阻碍：州法是否让联邦目的落空？(本题没有，反而互补)

如果既无明示，又无冲突，且国会没打算独占该领域，州法律有效。

questions.question:
A fatal virus recently infected poultry in several nations. Some scientific evidence indicates that the virus can be transmitted from poultry to humans.
Poultry farming is a major industry in several U.S. states. In one such state, the legislature has enacted a law imposing a fee of two cents per bird on all poultry farming and processing operations in the state. The purpose of the fee is to pay for a state inspection system to ensure that no poultry raised or processed in the state is infected with the virus.
A company that has poultry processing plants both in the state and in other states has sued to challenge the fee.
Is the fee constitutional?

choices.a: No, because although it attaches only to intrastate activity, in the aggregate, the fee substantially affects interstate commerce.
choices.b: No, because it places an undue burden on interstate commerce in violation of the negative implications of the commerce clause.
choices.c: Yes, because it applies only to activities that take place wholly within the state, and it does not unduly burden interstate commerce.
choices.d: Yes, because it was enacted pursuant to the state's police power, which takes precedence over the negative implications of the commerce clause.

Q82030

A fatal virus recently infected poultry in several nations. Some scientific evidence indicates that the virus can be transmitted from poultry to humans.

Poultry farming is a major industry in several U.S. states. In one such state, the legislature has enacted a law imposing a fee of two cents per bird on all poultry farming and processing operations in the state. The purpose of the fee is to pay for a state inspection system to ensure that no poultry raised or processed in the state is infected with the virus.

A company that has poultry processing plants both in the state and in other states has sued to challenge the fee.

Is the fee constitutional?

一种致命病毒最近在几个国家感染了家禽。一些科学证据表明，该病毒可以从家禽传播给人类。

家禽养殖是美国几个州的主要产业。在其中一个州，立法机关颁布了一项法律，对州内所有的家禽养殖和加工业务征收每只家禽两美分的费用。该费用的目的是为一个州检查系统提供资金，以确保在该州饲养或加工的家禽没有感染该病毒。

一家在该州和其它州都设有家禽加工厂的公司提起诉讼，对该费用提出质疑。

该费用合宪吗？
options:
A. No, because although it attaches only to intrastate activity, in the aggregate, the fee substantially affects interstate commerce.
否，因为尽管该费用仅适用于州内活动，但总体而言，它对州际贸易产生了实质性影响。

B. No, because it places an undue burden on interstate commerce in violation of the negative implications of the commerce clause.
否，因为它对州际贸易构成了不当负担，违反了商业条款的负面含义。

C. Yes, because it applies only to activities that take place wholly within the state, and it does not unduly burden interstate commerce.
是，因为它仅适用于完全在州内进行的活动，且未对州际贸易构成不当负担。

D. Yes, because it was enacted pursuant to the state's police power, which takes precedence over the negative implications of the commerce clause.
是，因为它是根据州的警察权颁布的，而警察权优先于商业条款的负面含义。
data.explanation:
The commerce clause gives Congress the power to regulate interstate commerce - ie, nearly all activities involving two or more states. This clause also carries a negative implication (ie, the dormant commerce clause) that prohibits states from discriminating against or unduly burdening interstate commerce. But a state tax that affects interstate commerce is not unduly burdensome if the tax is:
  • applied to a person or activity that has a substantial nexus with the state
  • fairly apportioned to avoid taxing activities performed in other states
  • not discriminatory against interstate commerce and
  • fairly related to services or benefits provided by the state.


Here, the state law imposes a fee (ie, tax) on all poultry farming and processing operations in the state. Although the fee only attaches to intrastate activity, in the aggregate, the fee likely has a substantial effect on interstate commerce (Choice A). But it does not unduly burden interstate commerce - and is therefore constitutional - because:
  • the entities taxed have poultry farming and processing operations in the state (substantial nexus)
  • the fee only applies to birds raised or processed in the state (fairly apportioned)
  • the fee applies to all poultry farming and processing operations in the state (nondiscriminatory) and
  • the fee appears reasonable compared to the poultry inspection system that the state will provide (fairly related) (Choice B).


(Choice D) The Tenth Amendment gives states all powers that are not expressly granted to the federal government by the Constitution - eg, police power to impose taxes on state activities. But pursuant to the supremacy clause, state police powers do not take precedence over other constitutional provisions, including the negative implications of the commerce clause.

Educational objective: A state tax that affects interstate commerce does not violate the dormant commerce clause if it is (1) applied to a person or activity that has a substantial nexus with the state, (2) fairly apportioned, (3) nondiscriminatory, and (4) fairly related to services or benefits provided by the state.



选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 5%，C选项 73%（正确选项），D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

商业条款 (commerce clause) 赋予国会监管州际贸易的权力——即几乎所有涉及两个或两个以上州的活动。该条款还有一个负面含义（即休眠商业条款 (dormant commerce clause)），即禁止各州歧视或不当地加重州际贸易的负担。但是，一项影响州际贸易的州税，如果满足以下条件，则不构成不当负担：
  • 适用于与该州有实质性联系 (substantial nexus) 的个人或活动
  • 公平分配 (fairly apportioned)，以避免对在其他州进行的活动征税
  • 对州际贸易不构成歧视 (not discriminatory)并且
  • 与州所提供的服务或利益公平相关 (fairly related)。


在本案中，州法律对州内所有的家禽养殖和加工业务征收一项费用（即税收）。尽管该费用仅针对州内活动，但总体而言，该费用可能对州际贸易产生实质性影响（选项A）。但它并未不当加重州际贸易的负担——因此是合宪的——因为：
  • 被征税的实体在该州有家禽养殖和加工业务（实质性联系）
  • 该费用仅适用于在该州饲养或加工的家禽（公平分配）
  • 该费用适用于州内所有的家禽养殖和加工业务（非歧视性）并且
  • 与州将提供的家禽检查系统相比，该费用显得合理（公平相关）（选项B）。


（选项D）美国宪法第十修正案 (Tenth Amendment) 将所有未由宪法明确授予联邦政府的权力赋予各州——例如，对州内活动征税的警察权。但是，根据至上条款 (supremacy clause)，州的警察权并不能优先于其他宪法规定，包括商业条款的负面含义。

教学目的：一项影响州际贸易的州税，如果其 (1) 适用于与该州有实质性联系的个人或活动，(2) 得到公平分配，(3) 非歧视性，以及 (4) 与州提供的服务或利益公平相关，则不违反休眠商业条款 (dormant commerce clause)。

References

Complete Auto Transit, Inc. v. Brady, 430 U.S. 274, 279 (1977) (setting forth the four-factor test for determining whether a state tax violates the commerce clause).
