MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law: Dormant Commerce Clause

正确答案：C

本题的核心考点是休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause) 下，州政府对州际贸易活动征税（或收费）的合宪性标准。

⚖️ 核心法律规则
Complete Auto Transit Test (四要素测试)
根据最高法院在 Complete Auto Transit v. Brady 案中的确立的标准，一项影响州际贸易的州税（或类似费用）若要合宪，必须同时满足以下四个条件：
  1. 实质性联系 (Substantial Nexus): 纳税人或活动与该州有实质联系。
  2. 公平分配 (Fair Apportionment): 税收必须公平分配，避免双重征税。
  3. 非歧视性 (Non-discrimination): 不得歧视州际贸易。
  4. 公平相关 (Fair Relationship): 税收与州提供的服务或福利合理相关。
🔍 案情分析

让我们将本案事实代入上述测试：

✔
实质性联系：该公司在该州设有家禽加工厂，并在该州开展业务，满足 Nexus 要求。
✔
公平分配：费用仅针对“在该州”饲养或加工的家禽征收。该州没有试图对该州以外发生的活动征税。
✔
非歧视性：费用适用于该州内所有的家禽养殖和加工业务，无论是本地公司还是跨州公司，一视同仁。
✔
公平相关：费用的目的是资助检查系统，这直接造福于该行业（确保家禽无病毒），因此费用与服务是相关的。

结论：该费用满足所有条件，没有对州际贸易造成不当负担 (Undue Burden)，因此是合宪的。

🚫 避坑指南 (为什么其他选项错)
陷阱 A：混淆了国会权力与州权力 选项 A 提到“实质性影响 (substantially affects)”。这是判断国会 (Congress) 是否有权根据商业条款进行立法的标准（Wickard v. Filburn）。

但在判断州 (State) 的法律是否违反休眠商业条款时，我们不看它是否有“实质影响”，而是看它是否构成“不当负担 (Undue Burden)”或“歧视”。
陷阱 D：警察权不是万能牌 虽然州拥有警察权 (Police Power) 来保护公众健康，但根据至上条款 (Supremacy Clause)，宪法（包括商业条款的负面含义）高于州法律。

如果州法违反了休眠商业条款（例如具有歧视性），即使它是基于警察权颁布的，也会被判违宪。因此，不能简单地说警察权“优先于”商业条款。
🎓 考试技巧

遇到涉及州税 (State Tax) 或州收费 (State Fee) 的题目时，直接套用 Complete Auto 四要素测试。只要该税收是非歧视的、公平分配的，并且与在该州的活动有关，通常都是合宪的。

questions.question:
A state statute requires each insurance company that offers burglary insurance policies in the state to charge a uniform rate for such insurance to all of its customers residing within the same county in that state. So long as a company complies with this requirement, it is free to charge whatever rate the market will bear for its burglary insurance policies.
An insurance company located in the state files suit in federal district court against appropriate state officials to challenge this statute on constitutional grounds. The insurance company wishes to charge customers residing within the same county in the state rates for burglary insurance policies that will vary because they would be based on the specific nature of the customer's business, on its precise location, and on its past claims record.
How should the court rule in this suit?

choices.a: Abstain from ruling on the merits of this case until the state courts have had an opportunity to pass on the constitutionality of this state statute.
choices.b: Hold the statute constitutional, because the statute is a reasonable exercise of the state's police power.
choices.c: Hold the statute unconstitutional, because the statute deprives the insurance company of its liberty or property without due process of law.
choices.d: Hold the statute unconstitutional, because the statute imposes an undue burden on interstate commerce.

data.questionStem:
Q82013

A state statute requires each insurance company that offers burglary insurance policies in the state to charge a uniform rate for such insurance to all of its customers residing within the same county in that state. So long as a company complies with this requirement, it is free to charge whatever rate the market will bear for its burglary insurance policies.

An insurance company located in the state files suit in federal district court against appropriate state officials to challenge this statute on constitutional grounds. The insurance company wishes to charge customers residing within the same county in the state rates for burglary insurance policies that will vary because they would be based on the specific nature of the customer's business, on its precise location, and on its past claims record.

How should the court rule in this suit?

某州的一项法规要求，在该州提供入室犯法罪保险的每家保险公司，必须对居住在该州同一县内的所有客户就该保险收取统一的费率。只要公司遵守此要求，其可以自由地就其入室犯法罪保险收取市场能承受的任何费率。

位于该州的一家保险公司向联邦地区法院提起诉讼，控告相应的州政府官员，以该法规违反宪法为由对其提出质疑。该保险公司希望对居住在州内同一县的客户收取可变的入室犯法罪保险费率，因为费率将基于客户业务的具体性质、其精确位置以及其过往的索赔记录。

法院应如何裁决此案？
options:
A. Abstain from ruling on the merits of this case until the state courts have had an opportunity to pass on the constitutionality of this state statute.
对本案的实体问题不作裁决，直到州法院有机会就此州法规的合宪性作出裁决。

B. Hold the statute constitutional, because the statute is a reasonable exercise of the state's police power.
裁定该法规合宪，因为该法规是州政府合理行使其警察权的结果。

C. Hold the statute unconstitutional, because the statute deprives the insurance company of its liberty or property without due process of law.
裁定该法规违宪，因为该法规未经正当法律程序剥夺了保险公司的自由或财产。

D. Hold the statute unconstitutional, because the statute imposes an undue burden on interstate commerce.
裁定该法规违宪，因为该法规对州际贸易施加了不当负担。
data.explanation:
Under the Tenth Amendment, any power that the Constitution does not expressly grant to the federal government is reserved to the states. This includes the broad police power to enact and enforce laws that are reasonably related to protecting public health, safety, and welfare - eg, requiring insurers to charge uniform rates to residents is reasonably related to protecting their financial welfare (as seen here). But when exercising this power, states cannot violate other constitutional provisions like the due process and dormant commerce clauses.

The Fourteenth Amendment due process clause prohibits state deprivations of life, liberty, or property unless adequately justified. A deprivation impacting an ordinary right (eg, an economic right - as seen here) is justified if it satisfies mere rational basis scrutiny. Here, the statute satisfies this standard because it is reasonably related to the state's legitimate interest in protecting its citizens from varying insurance rates. As a result, the statute does not deprive the insurance company of due process of law (Choice C).

Additionally, the Article I dormant commerce clause prohibits states from discriminating against or otherwise unduly burdening interstate commerce. A nondiscriminatory law is unduly burdensome if its burden on interstate commerce clearly exceeds its local benefits. Here, the statute is nondiscriminatory since it applies to all insurance companies. And it is not unduly burdensome because there is no indication that it has any effect outside the state (Choice D). Therefore, the statute is a constitutional exercise of the state's police power.

(Choice A) A federal court should abstain from hearing a case that involves an unsettled issue of state law so that state courts can sort out the issue. But since this case concerns whether the statute violates the federal Constitution, the court need not abstain.

Educational objective: States possess the police power to enact and enforce laws that are reasonably related to protecting public health, safety, and welfare. But states cannot violate other constitutional provisions when exercising this power.



选项正确率统计：A选项 18%，B选项 43%（正确选项），C选项 8%，D选项 30%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据Tenth Amendment（第十修正案），宪法未明确授予联邦政府的任何权力均保留给各州。这包括制定和执行与保护公共健康、安全和福祉相关的法律的广泛警察权——例如，要求保险公司向居民收取统一费率，与保护其财务福祉合理相关（如本案所示）。但在行使此权力时，各州不得违反其他宪法条款，如正当程序条款和休眠商业条款。

Fourteenth Amendment（第十四修正案）的正当程序条款禁止州政府剥夺生命、自由或财产，除非有充分理由。一项影响普通权利（例如，本案中的经济权利）的剥夺，如果满足合理基础审查标准，则为正当。在此案中，该法规满足此标准，因为它与州政府保护其公民免受不同保险费率影响的合法利益合理相关。因此，该法规并未剥夺保险公司的正当法律程序权利（选项C）。

此外，Article I（第一条）的休眠商业条款禁止各州歧视或以其他方式不当加重州际贸易的负担。如果一项非歧视性法律对州际贸易的负担明显超过其本地利益，那么它就是不当的负担。本案中，该法规是非歧视性的，因为它适用于所有保险公司。而且它并非不当负担，因为没有迹象表明它在该州之外有任何影响（选项D）。因此，该法规是州政府合宪地行使其警察权。

（选项A） 当案件涉及未决的州法律问题时，联邦法院应避免审理，以便州法院可以解决该问题。但由于本案涉及该法规是否违反联邦宪法，法院无需回避审理。

教学目标： 各州拥有制定和执行与保护公共健康、安全和福祉合理相关的法律的警察权。但在行使此权力时，各州不得违反其他宪法规定。

References

O'Gorman & Young, Inc. v. Hartford Fire Ins. Co., 282 U.S. 251, 257 - 58 (1931) (holding that a state regulation of insurance rates is a reasonable exercise of the state's police power and does not violate the due process clause).

Kassel v. Consol. Freightways Corp., 450 U.S. 662, 669 - 70 (1981) (describing how a state acting pursuant to its police power can violate the dormant commerce clause).

16A Am. Jur. 2d Constitutional Law § 379 (2019) (explaining that a state cannot violate other constitutional provisions when exercising its police powers).

MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations & Police Power

💡 核心考点：合理基础审查 (Rational Basis Review) 当州政府行使警察权 (Police Power) 对商业或经济活动进行监管时，只要该法律与一个合法的政府利益 (Legitimate Government Interest) 存在合理的关联 (Rationally Related)，该法律通常就是合宪的。
✅ 为什么选 B？

本题考察的是州政府监管私营企业的权力边界。

1. 警察权 (Police Power)：
根据第十修正案 (10th Amendment)，各州拥有广泛的权力来制定法律以保护公众的健康、安全、道德和福利。保险业直接关系到公众的财务安全，因此属于州政府合法的监管范围。

2. 审查标准 (Standard of Review)：
本案涉及的是经济监管 (Economic Regulation)，而非基本权利 (Fundamental Rights) 或可疑分类 (Suspect Classification)。因此，法院适用最低级别的审查标准——合理基础审查 (Rational Basis Review)。

3. 逻辑推演：
州政府要求同一县内的保险费率统一，目的是防止价格歧视，保护消费者利益。这是一个合法的政府目的。该手段（统一费率）与该目的之间存在合理的关联。因此，该法规是警察权的合理行使，符合宪法。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 C：实质性正当程序 (Substantive Due Process) 自1937年以来，最高法院已不再使用“实质性正当程序”来废除经济法规（即推翻了 Lochner 时代的做法）。只要法规通过了合理基础审查，就不会被视为剥夺了公司的“自由或财产”。
选项 D：休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause) 该法规并未歧视外州公司（它适用于所有在该州经营的公司），也没有对州际贸易造成“过度负担” (Undue Burden)。保险监管主要是地方性的，其本地利益通常超过对州际贸易的轻微影响。
选项 A：联邦法院回避 (Abstention) 普尔曼回避原则 (Pullman Abstention) 仅适用于州法律含义模糊不清 (Ambiguous) 且州法院的解释可能消除联邦宪法问题的情况。本题中法规含义明确，只是受到宪法挑战，因此联邦法院无需回避。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 在 MBE 宪法题中，如果看到州政府对商业、经济或社会福利进行监管，且不涉及种族、言论自由等基本权利：
1. 默认适用合理基础审查。
2. 法律几乎总是合宪的。
3. 寻找包含“Police Power”或“Rational Basis”字眼的选项。

The legislatures of several states entered into an agreement in which each state pledged to curb its pollution emissions. The agreement authorized a commission that contained a representative of each state to investigate how the states could reach their pollution emission goals and propose solutions for the states to adopt. The commission determined that each state needed to commit a fixed percentage of its energy consumption to clean energy sources, and each state enacted legislation that implemented the commission's suggestion. As a result, the states' demand for electricity produced by a company that uses coal-burning plants has significantly declined.
The company has filed suit against the commission in a federal district court, seeking a declaratory judgment that the states' agreement is unconstitutional.
Assume that no federal statute applies.
What action should the federal court take?

choices.a: Dismiss the suit without reaching the merits, because the Eleventh Amendment bars suits of this kind in federal court.
choices.b: Dismiss the suit without reaching the merits, because the suit presents a nonjusticiable political question.
choices.c: Invalidate the states' agreement, because the states failed to obtain congressional consent.
choices.d: Uphold the states' agreement, because the states validly entered into an interstate compact.

data.questionStem:
Q82035

The legislatures of several states entered into an agreement in which each state pledged to curb its pollution emissions. The agreement authorized a commission that contained a representative of each state to investigate how the states could reach their pollution emission goals and propose solutions for the states to adopt. The commission determined that each state needed to commit a fixed percentage of its energy consumption to clean energy sources, and each state enacted legislation that implemented the commission's suggestion. As a result, the states' demand for electricity produced by a company that uses coal-burning plants has significantly declined.

The company has filed suit against the commission in a federal district court, seeking a declaratory judgment that the states' agreement is unconstitutional.

Assume that no federal statute applies.

What action should the federal court take?

几个州的立法机关达成一项协议，其中每个州承诺控制其污染排放。该协议授权成立一个由各州代表组成的委员会，负责调查各州如何实现其污染排放目标，并提出供各州采纳的解决方案。该委员会确定，每个州都需要将其能源消耗的固定百分比用于清洁能源，并且每个州都颁布了实施该委员会建议的立法。结果，各州对一家使用燃煤电厂的公司所生产电力的需求大幅下降。

该公司已在联邦地区法院对该委员会提起诉讼，请求作出宣告性判决，认定该州际协议违宪。

假设没有联邦法规适用。

联邦法院应采取何种行动？
options:
A. Dismiss the suit without reaching the merits, because the Eleventh Amendment bars suits of this kind in federal court.
驳回诉讼，不进行实质审理，因为《第十一修正案》(Eleventh Amendment) 禁止联邦法院审理此类诉讼。

B. Dismiss the suit without reaching the merits, because the suit presents a nonjusticiable political question.
驳回诉讼，不进行实质审理，因为该诉讼提出了一个不可由法院裁决的政治问题。

C. Invalidate the states' agreement, because the states failed to obtain congressional consent.
宣告州际协议无效，因为各州未能获得国会同意。

D. Uphold the states' agreement, because the states validly entered into an interstate compact.
维持州际协议的效力，因为各州有效订立了一项州际协定。
data.explanation:
Congressional consent for interstate compacts


States' political power increased at federal government's expense - eg, states:
Required		States do not encroach on federal government supremacy - eg, states:
Not required
  • cede territory to each other
  • exercise powers they cannot exercise on own
  • enact reciprocal legislation for benefit of each state's residents (eg, state college tuition reciprocity)
  • form administrative body to study joint problems and make recommendations
  • create entity to operate transportation facility (eg, port authority)

States generally may enter into agreements with each other (ie, interstates compacts) without permission from the federal government.† However, the compact clause requires that states obtain Congress's consent for interstate compacts that increase the compacting states' political power at the expense of the federal government. This situation arises when the compact grants states or an administrative body powers that they could not exercise on their own.


Here, several states entered into an interstate compact to curb pollution emissions and created a commission that suggested that each state commit a fixed percentage of its energy consumption to clean energy sources. Each state did so. Since each state could have adopted energy guidelines without the commission's suggestion, the compact does not grant power to the states at the expense of the federal government. As a result, congressional consent was not required, and the federal court is likely to uphold the states' agreement (Choice C).


†The compact clause also permits states to enter into agreements with foreign governments if Congress consents.


(Choice A) The Eleventh Amendment generally bars suits in federal court against state governments. However, it does not prohibit suits against commissions created by interstate compacts (as seen here).


(Choice B) The political-question doctrine prevents federal courts from hearing the merits of suits that present issues that (1) are reserved to the executive or legislative branch or (2) lack judicially manageable standards for resolution - neither of which are seen here.


Educational objective: The compact clause requires states to obtain Congress's consent for agreements between the states (ie, interstate compacts) that increase the political power of the compacting states at the expense of the federal government.




选项正确率统计：A选项 22%，B选项 17%，C选项 12%，D选项 46%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

州际协定的国会同意


以牺牲联邦政府利益为代价增加州的政治权力 - 例如，州：
需要同意		州不侵犯联邦政府的最高权力 - 例如，州：
不需要同意
  • 相互割让领土
  • 行使它们自身无法行使的权力
  • 为各州居民的利益制定互惠立法（例如，州立大学学费互惠）
  • 成立行政机构研究共同问题并提出建议
  • 创建实体以运营交通设施（例如，港务局）

通常情况下，各州可以在未经联邦政府许可的情况下相互签订协议（即州际协定）。†然而，协定条款 (compact clause) 要求，对于那些以牺牲联邦政府利益为代价来增加缔约州政治权力的州际协定，各州必须获得国会的同意。当协定授予各州或某个行政机构其自身无法行使的权力时，就会出现这种情况。


在本案中，几个州为控制污染排放签订了一项州际协定，并设立了一个委员会，该委员会建议每个州将其能源消耗的固定百分比用于清洁能源。每个州都这样做了。由于每个州在没有委员会建议的情况下也可以采纳能源指导方针，因此该协定并未以牺牲联邦政府利益为代价授予各州权力。因此，不需要国会的同意，联邦法院很可能会维持各州协议的效力（选项D）。


†协定条款 (compact clause) 也允许各州在国会同意的情况下与外国政府签订协议。


（选项A）《第十一修正案》(Eleventh Amendment)通常禁止在联邦法院对州政府提起诉讼。然而，它不禁止对由州际协定设立的委员会（如本案所示）提起诉讼。


（选项B）政治问题原则 (political-question doctrine) 阻止联邦法院对提出以下问题的诉讼进行实质审理：（1）这些问题保留给行政或立法部门处理，或（2）缺乏司法上可管理的解决标准——本案中均未出现这些情况。


教学目标：协定条款 (compact clause) 要求，对于那些以牺牲联邦政府利益为代价来增加缔约州政治权力的州际协议（即州际协定），各州必须获得国会的同意。




References





  • U.S. Const. art. I, § 10, cl. 3 (compact clause).


  • U.S. Steel Corp. v. Multistate Tax Comm'n, 434 U.S. 452, 473 - 76 (1978) (holding that congressional consent was not required when an interstate compact granted powers that compacting states could exercise on their own).


  • 72 Am. Jur. 2d States, Territories, and Dependencies § 10 (2020) (explaining when congressional consent is required for an interstate compact).

核心考点：协定条款
The Compact Clause

本题考察的是美国宪法第一条第10款中的协定条款 (Compact Clause)。核心问题在于：州与州之间达成的协议，在什么情况下必须获得国会 (Congress) 的同意？

正确答案是 D。

法律规则解析

虽然宪法文本字面上规定“任何州未经国会同意，不得与他州缔结协定”，但最高法院 (Supreme Court) 对此进行了限缩解释。

关键判例规则 (U.S. Steel Corp. Test) 只有当州际协定增加了各州的政治权力，并以牺牲联邦政府的最高权力 (Federal Supremacy) 为代价时，才需要国会的同意。

不需要国会同意的情况：

  • 各州行使原本就拥有的权力（如本案中的环保立法）。
  • 成立仅具有咨询性质 (Advisory) 或建议权的行政机构。
  • 互惠立法（如大学学费互惠政策）。

本案案情分析

在本题中，各州成立的委员会 (Commission) 仅有权“调查”和“提出建议”。

  • 权力来源： 最终的法律效力来自于每个州各自颁布的立法，而不是委员会的直接命令。
  • 联邦利益： 这种合作没有侵犯联邦政府的权力，因为各州本身就有权监管能源消耗和环境污染。

因此，该协议并未以牺牲联邦利益为代价来扩张州权，不需要国会同意。该州际协定是有效的。

为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (第十一修正案)
虽然第十一修正案通常禁止在联邦法院起诉“州”，但最高法院已裁定，由州际协定设立的多州实体 (Multi-state entities) 通常不享有第十一修正案赋予的豁免权 (Sovereign Immunity)，除非该实体的结构和资金完全依赖于各州财政且被视为州的“手臂”。此外，本题考点在于协议的合宪性，而非程序性障碍。

选项 B (政治问题)
解释宪法条款（如协定条款）是否被违反，是法院的典型职责，存在司法上可管理的标准，不属于不可裁决的政治问题 (Nonjusticiable Political Question)。

选项 C (未获国会同意)
这是最强的干扰项。它错误地假设所有州际协定都必须获得国会同意。如前所述，只有侵犯联邦权力的协定才需要同意。

MBE 考试技巧

看到涉及 "Interstate Compact" (州际协定) 的题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 该协定是否建立了一个新的政治实体，其权力凌驾于各州之上？
  2. 该协定是否侵犯了联邦政府的专属领域（如外交、宣战）？

如果答案是“否”（例如仅是咨询委员会、互惠政策），则通常不需要国会同意，协定有效。

questions.question:
A man bought an antique car from a car dealer in State A. Under State A law, a person who buys from such a dealer acquires good title, even if the property was stolen from a previous owner. The man showed the car at an antique car show in State B. A woman recognized the car as having been stolen from her. Under State B law, a person whose property is stolen may reclaim it, even if the current possessor is an innocent purchaser.
The woman sued the man in a State B court to reclaim the car. In his defense, the man claimed that he had good title under the law of State A. Nevertheless, the State B court applied State B law, and the woman prevailed. The man did not appeal. The sheriff had the car returned to State B and gave the woman possession of the car.
Several months later, the woman moved to State A, bringing the car with her. The man brought a new suit against the woman in a State A court, claiming that the State B court in the prior suit should have applied the State A law, which protects innocent purchasers. The woman appeared and moved to dismiss the suit.
What should the State A court do?

choices.a: Apply State A law, because the car is currently located in State A.
choices.b: Apply the federal law on sale of goods, because the car has moved in interstate commerce.
choices.c: Dismiss the suit, because the State A court must give full faith and credit to the State B judgment.
choices.d: Remove the case to federal court, because the car has moved in interstate commerce, and therefore the case raises a federal question.

data.questionStem:
Q82044

A man bought an antique car from a car dealer in State A. Under State A law, a person who buys from such a dealer acquires good title, even if the property was stolen from a previous owner. The man showed the car at an antique car show in State B. A woman recognized the car as having been stolen from her. Under State B law, a person whose property is stolen may reclaim it, even if the current possessor is an innocent purchaser.

The woman sued the man in a State B court to reclaim the car. In his defense, the man claimed that he had good title under the law of State A. Nevertheless, the State B court applied State B law, and the woman prevailed. The man did not appeal. The sheriff had the car returned to State B and gave the woman possession of the car.

Several months later, the woman moved to State A, bringing the car with her. The man brought a new suit against the woman in a State A court, claiming that the State B court in the prior suit should have applied the State A law, which protects innocent purchasers. The woman appeared and moved to dismiss the suit.

What should the State A court do?

一名男子在A州从一个汽车经销商处购买了一辆古董车。根据A州法律，从该经销商处购买的人可以获得有效所有权，即使该财产是从前任所有者处被盗的。该男子在B州的一场古董车展上展示了这辆车。一名女子认出这辆车是从她那里被盗的。根据B州法律，财产被盗的人可以收回其财产，即使目前的占有人是善意购买者。

该女子在B州法院对该男子提起诉讼，要求收回该车。该男子辩称，根据A州法律，他拥有该车的有效所有权。然而，B州法院适用了B州法律，该女子胜诉。该男子没有上诉。法警已将该车运回B州，并将该车的占有权交给了该女子。

几个月后，该女子搬到了A州，并带上了这辆车。该男子在A州法院对该女子提起了新的诉讼，声称在之前的诉讼中，B州法院本应适用保护善意购买者的A州法律。该女子出庭并请求驳回该诉讼。

A州法院应该怎么做？
options:
A. Apply State A law, because the car is currently located in State A.
适用A州法律，因为该车目前位于A州。

B. Apply the federal law on sale of goods, because the car has moved in interstate commerce.
适用关于货物销售的联邦法律，因为该车已进入州际贸易。

C. Dismiss the suit, because the State A court must give full faith and credit to the State B judgment.
驳回该诉讼，因为A州法院必须对B州的判决给予充分的信任和尊重。

D. Remove the case to federal court, because the car has moved in interstate commerce, and therefore the case raises a federal question.
将案件移送至联邦法院，因为该车已进入州际贸易，因此该案引发了一个联邦问题。
data.explanation:
Under the Article IV full faith and credit clause , states have a duty to respect the public acts, records, and judicial proceedings of other states. This requires state courts to recognize and enforce decisions rendered by a court in another state when:

  • that court had personal jurisdiction and subject-matter jurisdiction
  • the case was decided on its merits - ie, the substantive elements or grounds of the claim or defense - and
  • a final judgment was entered.


Here, the woman sued the man in a State B court to reclaim her car. And the State A court must give full faith and credit to the State B judgment since:

  • the man waived any right to challenge personal jurisdiction by appearing in the State B court and presenting a defense
  • state courts, including the State B court, have subject matter jurisdiction over virtually any case arising under federal or state law
  • the case was decided on its merits when the State B court applied State B's substantive law and ruled in the woman's favor and
  • the judgment became final when the man failed to appeal.


Therefore, the State A court should dismiss the man's suit.

(Choices A & B) The fact that the car is currently located in State A and has moved in interstate commerce is irrelevant in determining whether the State A court must give full faith and credit to the State B judgment.

(Choice D) Even if the car's movement in interstate commerce created a federal question, the state court cannot remove the case to federal court on its own initiative. Removal is only proper when the defendant requests it (not seen here).

Educational objective: The full faith and credit clause requires a state court to recognize and enforce a decision by a court in another state when (1) that court had personal and subject matter jurisdiction, (2) the case was decided on its merits, and (3) a final judgment was entered.



选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 0%，C选项 98%（正确选项），D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据宪法第四条充分信任和尊重条款 (full faith and credit clause)，各州有义务尊重其他州的公共法案、记录和司法程序。这要求州法院在以下情况下，承认并执行由另一州法院作出的判决：

  • 该法院拥有属人管辖权和事项管辖权 (subject-matter jurisdiction)
  • 案件是经实体审理 (on its merits) 后判决的——即，基于诉求或抗辩的实体要素或理由——并且
  • 作出了最终判决 (final judgment)。


在本案中，该女子在B州法院起诉该男子以收回她的车。A州法院必须对B州的判决给予充分的信任和尊重，因为：

  • 该男子通过在B州法院出庭并提出抗辩，放弃了任何挑战属人管辖权 (personal jurisdiction) 的权利
  • 州法院，包括B州法院，对几乎所有根据联邦或州法律提起的案件都拥有事项管辖权
  • 当B州法院适用B州的实体法并作出有利于该女子的裁决时，该案已通过实体审理作出判决并且
  • 在该男子未提起上诉时，该判决已成为最终判决。


因此，A州法院应驳回该男子的诉讼。

(选项 A & B) 车辆目前位于A州并且已进入州际贸易这一事实，与决定A州法院是否必须对B州的判决给予充分的信任和尊重无关。

(选项 D) 即使车辆进入州际贸易引发了联邦问题，州法院也不能主动将案件移送至联邦法院。只有在被告提出请求时，移送才是适当的（本案中未见）。

教学目标：充分信任和尊重条款要求一州法院承认并执行另一州法院的判决，条件是 (1) 该法院拥有属人和事项管辖权，(2) 案件经实体审理作出判决，以及 (3) 作出了最终判决。

References

Baker v. Gen. Motors Corp., 522 U.S. 222, 231 - 33 (1998) (explaining when the full faith and credit clause applies to state court judgments).

V.L. v. E.L., 136 S. Ct. 1017, 1020 - 22 (2016) (holding that a state court cannot relitigate a case that has already been decided on its merits in a court of another state).

MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations / Constitutional Law
✅ 正确答案：选项 C 驳回该诉讼 (Dismiss the suit)。
因为A州法院必须根据宪法给予B州判决充分的信任和尊重。
⚖️ 核心法律依据
Full Faith and Credit Clause
(充分信任和尊重条款)

美国宪法第四条第一款规定，各州必须承认并执行其他州的司法判决。这实际上是将既判力 (Res Judicata) 原则扩展到了州际之间。

要触发该条款的保护，原判决必须满足三个条件：

1️⃣
管辖权 (Jurisdiction)： 原审法院（B州）必须拥有属人管辖权 (Personal Jurisdiction) 和事项管辖权 (Subject Matter Jurisdiction)。
2️⃣
实体审理 (On the Merits)： 判决必须是基于案件的实质内容作出的，而非仅仅因为程序问题（如管辖权不足）被驳回。
3️⃣
最终判决 (Final Judgment)： 案件必须已经终结，没有未决的上诉。
🔍 案情深度解析

在本案中，A州法院必须驳回男子的诉讼，理由如下：

  • 管辖权无争议： 男子在B州出庭并进行了抗辩，这构成了对B州属人管辖权的接受。
  • 已进行实体判决： B州法院根据B州法律审理了所有权归属，并判决女子胜诉。
  • 判决已生效： 男子败诉后没有上诉 (did not appeal)，因此B州的判决是最终判决。
⚠️ 关键考点：法律适用错误不影响判决效力

男子争辩的核心是“B州法院本应该适用A州法律”。即使B州法院真的犯了法律适用错误 (Choice of Law error)，这也不能成为在A州重新起诉的理由。

纠正法律错误的唯一途径是在B州法院系统中上诉。一旦判决成为最终判决，其他州（包括A州）就必须执行它，不得重新审查其实体问题。

❌ 干扰项排除
选项 A (适用A州法律) 错误。虽然车现在在A州，但所有权问题已经在B州得到了最终裁决。既判力原则 (Res Judicata) 禁止重新审理同一诉因。
选项 B (适用联邦法) 错误。这是一起关于动产所有权的私法纠纷，主要受州法管辖。虽然车辆跨州移动，但这并不自动触发联邦普通法 (Federal Common Law) 来取代州法判决。
选项 D (移送联邦法院) 错误。首先，仅仅因为涉及“州际贸易”并不一定构成联邦问题管辖权 (Federal Question Jurisdiction)。其次，移送 (Removal) 是被告的权利，法院通常不会主动移送。最重要的是，本案的核心是既判力问题，应直接驳回。
🎓 MBE 备考锦囊

遇到涉及跨州判决执行的题目时，请遵循以下思维路径：
1. 检查原判决是否满足 J-M-F (Jurisdiction, Merits, Finality)。
2. 如果满足，第二州必须承认该判决。
3. 陷阱警报： 题目常会诱导你思考“原法院是否用错了法律”。请记住，即使原法院用错了法律，只要判决是最终的，第二州也不能纠正该错误（那是上诉法院的事）。

questions.question:
Congressional hearings determined that the use of mechanical power hammers is very dangerous to the persons using them and to persons in the vicinity of the persons using them. As a result, Congress enacted a statute prohibiting the use of mechanical power hammers on all construction projects in the United States.
Subsequently, a study conducted by a private research firm concluded that nails driven by mechanical power hammers have longer-lasting joining power than hand-driven nails. After learning about this study, a city council enacted an amendment to its building safety code requiring the use of mechanical power hammers in the construction of all buildings intended for human habitation.
Is this amendment to the city's building safety code constitutional?

choices.a: No, because it conflicts with the provisions of the federal statute.
choices.b: No, because it was enacted subsequent to the federal statute.
choices.c: Yes, because the federal statute does not expressly indicate that it supersedes inconsistent state or local laws.
choices.d: Yes, because the long-term safety of human habitations justifies some additional risk to the people engaged in their construction.

国会听证会认定，使用机械动力锤对使用者及使用者附近的人员都非常危险。因此，国会颁布了一项法规，禁止在美国所有建筑项目中使用机械动力锤。

随后，一家私营研究公司进行的一项研究得出结论，由机械动力锤钉入的钉子比手动钉入的钉子具有更持久的连接力。在了解到这项研究后，一个市议会通过了其建筑安全法规的一项修正案，要求在所有旨在供人类居住的建筑物的建造中使用机械动力锤。

该市建筑安全法规的这项修正案是否合宪？
options:
A. No, because it conflicts with the provisions of the federal statute.
否，因为它与联邦法规的规定相冲突。

B. No, because it was enacted subsequent to the federal statute.
否，因为它是在联邦法规之后颁布的。

C. Yes, because the federal statute does not expressly indicate that it supersedes inconsistent state or local laws.
是，因为联邦法规没有明确表示其将取代不一致的州或地方法律。

D. Yes, because the long-term safety of human habitations justifies some additional risk to the people engaged in their construction.
是，因为人类居住建筑的长期安全，为从事其建造的人员带来一些额外风险是正当的。
data.explanation:
It is common for the federal government to regulate the same subject matter as states and/or municipalities because these governments share many of the same powers. But under the supremacy clause, federal law is the supreme law of the land. Therefore, a federal law can preempt (ie, supersede) conflicting state or municipal laws and render them void. One example is implied conflict preemption, which occurs when there is:
  • direct conflict - a state/municipal law conflicts with a federal law to such a degree that it is impossible (or nearly impossible) for a person or entity to comply with both laws or
  • indirect conflict - a state/municipal law frustrates the accomplishment of the federal law's purpose.
Here, the federal statute prohibits the use of mechanized hammers on all construction projects. But the city council amendment requires the use of such hammers on all construction projects for human habitation. These laws directly conflict since it is impossible for a company constructing human habitations in the city to comply with both laws. Therefore, the federal statute impliedly preempts the city council amendment and renders it unconstitutional.

(Choice B) In determining preemption, the timing of the laws is irrelevant. Therefore, it makes no difference whether the city council enacted the amendment before or after the federal statute.

(Choice C) Although the federal statute does not expressly state that it supersedes inconsistent state or local laws, it impliedly preempts them.

(Choice D) Federal laws always preempt inconsistent state and local laws - regardless of their justification.

Educational objective: Implied conflict preemption exists when (1) it is impossible to comply with a federal law and a conflicting state/municipal law (ie, direct conflict) or (2) a state/municipal law frustrates the accomplishment of a federal law's purpose (ie, indirect conflict).



选项正确率统计：A选项 94%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 2%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

联邦政府与州和/或市政当局对同一主题事项进行监管是常见的，因为这些政府拥有许多相同的权力。但是，根据最高条款 (Supremacy Clause)，联邦法律是国家的最高法律。因此，联邦法律可以优先适用 (preempt)（即，取代）相冲突的州或市级法律，并使其无效。其中一个例子是默示冲突优先适用 (implied conflict preemption)，它发生在以下情况：
  • 直接冲突 (direct conflict) - 州/市级法律与联邦法律的冲突程度达到使个人或实体不可能（或几乎不可能）同时遵守两种法律的程度，或者
  • 间接冲突 (indirect conflict) - 州/市级法律阻碍了联邦法律目的的实现。
此处，联邦法规禁止在所有建筑项目中使用机械化锤具。但市议会修正案要求在所有供人类居住的建筑项目中使用此类锤具。这些法律直接冲突，因为在该市建造人类居住建筑的公司不可能同时遵守这两种法律。因此，联邦法规默示地优先适用市议会修正案，使其违宪。

(Choice B) 在确定优先适用 (preemption) 时，法律的颁布时间无关紧要。因此，市议会是在联邦法规之前还是之后颁布修正案并无区别。

(Choice C) 尽管联邦法规没有明确声明它将取代不一致的州或地方法律，但它默示地优先适用它们。

(Choice D) 联邦法律总是优先适用不一致的州和地方法律——无论其理由为何。

教学目标： 默示冲突优先适用 (Implied conflict preemption) 存在于以下情况：（1）不可能同时遵守联邦法律和与之冲突的州/市级法律（即直接冲突, direct conflict）或（2）州/市级法律阻碍了联邦法律目的的实现（即间接冲突, indirect conflict）。

References

  • English v. Gen. Elec. Co., 496 U.S. 72, 79 (1990) (stating that federal law preempts state law when "it is impossible for a private party to comply with both state and federal requirements").
  • 16A Am. Jur. 2d Constitutional Law § 235 (2019) (explaining when federal and state laws conflict).

MBE 考点解析

宪法：联邦与州的关系 (Federal-State Relations)
⚖️ 核心法律原则：最高条款

本题考查的是美国宪法中的最高条款 (Supremacy Clause)，位于宪法第六条第二款。

规则：联邦法律是国家的最高法律。当有效的联邦法律与州或地方法律发生冲突时，联邦法律优先适用 (Preempts)，州法无效。
🔍 案情冲突分析

本案中存在典型的“物理上的不可能” (Physical Impossibility)：

联邦法律
🚫 禁止
使用动力锤
VS
市议会法规
⚠️ 强制
使用动力锤

建筑商不可能同时遵守这两条法律：你无法在“必须使用”某工具的同时又“禁止使用”它。

✅ 正确答案：选项 A

"No, because it conflicts with the provisions of the federal statute."

解析：

  • 这是默示冲突优先适用 (Implied Conflict Preemption) 的教科书式案例。
  • 当遵守州法和联邦法在物理上是不可能的 (physically impossible) 时，联邦法自动废止州法。
  • 不论州法的初衷多么良好（为了建筑更坚固），只要与联邦法直接冲突，即违宪。
❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 B (时间先后)：
"enacted subsequent to..."
错误点：在优先适用权 (Preemption) 问题上，时间顺序无关紧要。只要联邦法有效，它就优于任何时间颁布的州法。

选项 C (明示条款)：
"does not expressly indicate..."
错误点：优先适用分为“明示” (Express) 和“默示” (Implied)。即使国会没有写明“本法取代州法”，只要存在实际冲突 (Actual Conflict)，默示优先适用依然发生。

选项 D (正当理由)：
"justifies some additional risk..."
错误点：这是典型的政策性干扰项。法院在判定优先适用时，不进行“利益权衡” (Balancing Test)。一旦确定冲突，联邦法胜出，州法的立法目的（即使是为了公共安全）也无法挽救该法律。

💡 MBE 提分技巧

在处理 Preemption 题目时，按以下步骤思考：

  1. 找冲突：能不能同时遵守两部法律？
    • 如果不能（如本题）→ Direct Conflict (直接冲突) → 联邦法胜。
  2. 找阻碍：如果能同时遵守，州法是否阻碍了联邦目标的实现？
    • 如果是 → Obstacle Preemption (障碍优先适用) → 联邦法胜。
  3. 看领域：国会是否意图独占该领域？
    • 如果是 → Field Preemption (领域优先适用) → 联邦法胜。

questions.question:
A state law makes it a crime for an individual to intentionally provide false information on state tax forms when applying for employment.
A federal statute prohibits employers from hiring individuals who provide false Social Security numbers when applying for employment. The statute's purpose is to prevent individuals from assuming a false identity to obtain employment. A provision of the federal statute states that the statute expressly preempts state laws imposing civil or criminal punishments on employers who hire individuals who provide fraudulent Social Security numbers.
A man was charged in state court with violating the state law by intentionally providing a false Social Security number on his state tax withholding form when he applied for employment in the state. The man argued that the prosecution should not proceed because the federal statute preempts the state law.
Assume that no other federal statute applies.
How should the state court proceed with the case?

choices.a: Determine whether the man intentionally provided false information on his state tax form and, if so, find him guilty of violating the state law.
choices.b: Refuse to adjudicate the merits of the case and dismiss it, because the federal statute expressly preempts the state law.
choices.c: Refuse to adjudicate the merits of the case and dismiss it, because the federal statute impliedly preempts the state law.
choices.d: Refuse to adjudicate the merits of the case and dismiss it, because the federal statute expressly and impliedly preempts the state law.

一项州法律规定，个人在申请就业时，于州税表格上故意提供虚假信息构成一项罪行。

一项联邦法规禁止雇主雇佣在申请就业时提供虚假社会安全号码的个人。该法规的目的是防止个人为获得就业而冒用虚假身份。该联邦法规的一项条款规定，该法规明示优先于（expressly preempts）对雇佣了提供欺诈性社会安全号码的个人的雇主施加民事或刑事处罚的州法律。

一名男子在州法院被指控违反了州法律，因为他在该州申请就业时，于其州预扣税表格上故意提供了虚假的社会安全号码。该男子辩称，由于联邦法规优先于州法律，因此检控不应继续进行。

假设没有其他联邦法规适用。

州法院应如何处理此案？
options:
A. Determine whether the man intentionally provided false information on his state tax form and, if so, find him guilty of violating the state law.
裁定该男子是否在其州税表格上故意提供了虚假信息，如果是，则裁定他违反州法律的罪名成立。

B. Refuse to adjudicate the merits of the case and dismiss it, because the federal statute expressly preempts the state law.
拒绝就案件的实体问题进行裁决并予以驳回，因为联邦法规明示优先于州法律。

C. Refuse to adjudicate the merits of the case and dismiss it, because the federal statute impliedly preempts the state law.
拒绝就案件的实体问题进行裁决并予以驳回，因为联邦法规默示优先于州法律。

D. Refuse to adjudicate the merits of the case and dismiss it, because the federal statute expressly and impliedly preempts the state law.
拒绝就案件的实体问题进行裁决并予以驳回，因为联邦法规明示和默示地优先于州法律。
data.explanation:
The supremacy clause renders a state law void and without effect when a federal law expressly or impliedly preempts it. Express preemption occurs when a federal law :
  • was enacted pursuant to a power exclusively reserved to the federal government by the U.S. Constitution (eg, power to declare war) or
  • explicitly prohibits state regulation.

The federal government shares power with state governments to regulate hiring practices within the respective state. And though the federal statute here expressly preempts state laws that punish employers , it does not mention applicants . As a result, the federal statute does not expressly preempt the state law (Choices B & D).

The federal statute also does not impliedly preempt the state law. Implied preemption occurs through:
  • field preemption - when Congress intended to completely occupy a particular field by legislating so thoroughly that it has left no room for supplementary state regulations
  • direct conflict preemption - when it is impossible or nearly impossible to comply with both federal and state law or
  • indirect conflict preemption - when the state law frustrates the purpose of the federal law.

Here, there is no field preemption since the federal statute punishes employers but leaves room for states to punish applicants. There is no direct conflict preemption because individuals can comply with both statutes. And there is no indirect conflict preemption since the state law furthers the federal statute's purpose of preventing individuals from assuming a false identity to obtain employment (Choices C & D).

Therefore, the state court should adjudicate the merits to determine whether the man intentionally provided false information on his state tax form and, if so, find him guilty.

Educational objective: Express preemption occurs when a federal law is enacted under an exclusive federal power or explicitly bars state regulation. Implied preemption occurs when there is no room for state regulation (field), it is nearly impossible to comply with both laws (direct conflict), or the state law frustrates the federal law's purpose (indirect conflict).



选项正确率统计：A选项 64%（正确选项），B选项 25%，C选项 4%，D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当联邦法律明示或默示地优先于（preempts）州法律时，《至上条款》（supremacy clause）使州法律无效。明示优先（Express preemption）发生在联邦法律：
  • 根据美国宪法专门保留给联邦政府的权力而制定（例如，宣战权）或
  • 明确禁止州的规制。

联邦政府与州政府分享权力，以规制各州内的雇佣行为。尽管此处的联邦法规明示优先于惩罚雇主的州法律，但它并未提及申请人。因此，该联邦法规并未明示优先于州法律（选项B和D）。

该联邦法规也未默示优先于州法律。默示优先（Implied preemption）通过以下方式发生：
  • 领域优先（field preemption） - 当国会有意通过如此彻底的立法完全占据某一特定领域，以至于没有为补充性的州规制留下任何空间
  • 直接冲突优先（direct conflict preemption） - 当遵守联邦和州法律是不可能或几乎不可能时或
  • 间接冲突优先（indirect conflict preemption） - 当州法律阻碍了联邦法律的目的时。

在此案中，不存在领域优先，因为联邦法规惩罚雇主，但为州惩罚申请人留下了空间。不存在直接冲突优先，因为个人可以同时遵守两项法规。也不存在间接冲突优先，因为州法律促进了联邦法规防止个人为获得就业而冒用虚假身份的目的（选项C和D）。

因此，州法院应就实体问题进行裁决，以裁定该男子是否在其州税表格上故意提供了虚假信息，如果是，则裁定其有罪。

教学目标：当联邦法律是根据专属联邦权力制定或明确禁止州规制时，发生明示优先。当没有空间容纳州规制（领域优先）、几乎不可能同时遵守两部法律（直接冲突优先）或州法律阻碍了联邦法律的目的（间接冲突优先）时，发生默示优先。

References

Kansas v. Garcia, 140 S. Ct. 791, 804 - 07 (2020) (holding that a federal law regulating employment hiring practices does not expressly or impliedly preempt a state law criminalizing fraud when applying for employment).

16A Am. Jur. 2d Constitutional Law § 234 (2020) (explaining the tests used to determine preemption).

MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations | Preemption
正确答案：A 州法院应裁定该男子是否故意提供虚假信息，如属实则定罪。联邦法律并未优先于（Preempt）该州法律。
核心法律原则：联邦优先权 (Preemption)

根据美国宪法《至上条款》（Supremacy Clause），当联邦法律与州法律发生冲突时，联邦法律优先。优先权分为两类：

1. 明示优先 (Express Preemption)
联邦法律文本中明确写明禁止州进行监管。
🔍 本题分析：联邦法规明确禁止的是对雇主的处罚。而本案被告是雇员/申请人。因此，明示优先条款不适用。
2. 默示优先 (Implied Preemption)
虽然没有明文规定，但通过以下方式体现：
  • 领域优先 (Field Preemption): 联邦监管如此全面，不给州留空间（如移民身份登记）。
  • 冲突优先 (Conflict Preemption):
    • 无法同时遵守两者；或
    • 州法律阻碍了联邦目标的实现。
🔍 本题分析：州法律惩罚欺诈行为，这实际上促进（而非阻碍）了联邦防止身份欺诈的目标。且雇佣法通常是州行使警察权（Police Power）的领域，非联邦独占。
逻辑图解
联邦法规
对象：雇主 (Employers)
禁止：雇佣假身份者
(未提及申请人)
州法律
对象：个人 (Individuals)
禁止：税表造假
(与联邦互补)

两者针对不同主体，互不冲突 → 无 Preemption

判例背景 (Case Reference)
Kansas v. Garcia (2020) 本题改编自美国最高法院2020年的真实判例。法院裁定，尽管联邦《移民改革与控制法案》(IRCA) 规范了就业资格验证，但它并不优先于州政府利用州税表上的信息来起诉身份盗窃或欺诈行为的权力。
MBE 解题技巧
  • 仔细阅读优先权条款的范围：如果条款说“禁止各州监管X”，不要自动推导为“禁止各州监管Y”。本题中 X=雇主，Y=雇员。
  • 寻找“阻碍”证据：如果州法律帮助实现了联邦法律的目的（如本题中的反欺诈），通常不存在冲突优先。
  • 区分主体：注意联邦法和州法分别惩罚的是谁。主体不同往往意味着可以并存。

questions.question:
Congress enacted a federal statute providing that any state may "require labeling to show the state or other geographic origin of citrus fruit that is imported into the receiving state."
Pursuant to the federal statute, a state that produced large quantities of citrus fruit enacted a law requiring all citrus fruit imported into the state to be stamped with a two-letter postal abbreviation signifying the state of the fruit's origin. The law did not impose any such requirement for citrus fruit grown within the state. When it adopted the law, the state legislature declared that its purpose was to reduce the risks of infection of local citrus crops by itinerant diseases that have been found to attack citrus fruit.
A national association of citrus growers has sued to have the state law declared unconstitutional. The association claims that the law is prohibited by the negative implications of the commerce clause of the Constitution.
Which of the following is the best argument in favor of the state's effort to have this lawsuit dismissed?

choices.a: Any burden on interstate commerce imposed by the state law is outweighed by a legitimate state interest.
choices.b: Congress has the authority to authorize specified state regulations that would otherwise be prohibited by the negative implications of the commerce clause, and it has done so in this situation.
choices.c: The state law does not discriminate against out-of-state citrus growers or producers.
choices.d: The state law furthers a legitimate state interest, the burden it imposes on interstate commerce is only incidental, and the state's interest cannot be satisfied by other means that are less burdensome to interstate commerce.

Pursuant to the federal statute, a state that produced large quantities of citrus fruit enacted a law requiring all citrus fruit imported into the state to be stamped with a two-letter postal abbreviation signifying the state of the fruit's origin. The law did not impose any such requirement for citrus fruit grown within the state. When it adopted the law, the state legislature declared that its purpose was to reduce the risks of infection of local citrus crops by itinerant diseases that have been found to attack citrus fruit.

A national association of citrus growers has sued to have the state law declared unconstitutional. The association claims that the law is prohibited by the negative implications of the commerce clause of the Constitution.

Which of the following is the best argument in favor of the state's effort to have this lawsuit dismissed?

美国国会颁布了一项联邦法规，规定任何州可以“要求标签标明进口到本州的柑橘类水果的州或其他地理来源地”。

根据该联邦法规，一个大量生产柑橘类水果的州颁布了一项法律，要求所有进口到该州的柑橘类水果都必须盖上标明其原产州的双字母邮政缩写。该法律并未对州内种植的柑橘类水果施加任何此类要求。在通过该法律时，州立法机构宣称其目的是为了降低本地柑橘作物被已发现会侵袭柑橘类水果的流行性疾病感染的风险。

一个全国性的柑橘种植者协会提起诉讼，要求宣布该州法律违宪。该协会声称，该法律被宪法中commerce clause（商业条款）的负面含义所禁止。

以下哪项是支持该州为驳回此诉讼所作努力的最佳论点？
options:
A. Any burden on interstate commerce imposed by the state law is outweighed by a legitimate state interest.
州法律对州际贸易造成的任何负担，都被一项合法的州利益所超越。

B. Congress has the authority to authorize specified state regulations that would otherwise be prohibited by the negative implications of the commerce clause, and it has done so in this situation.
国会有权授权特定的州法规，而这些法规在没有国会授权的情况下，本会被commerce clause（商业条款）的负面含义所禁止，并且国会在此案中已经这么做了。

C. The state law does not discriminate against out-of-state citrus growers or producers.
该州法律并未歧视州外的柑橘种植者或生产者。

D. The state law furthers a legitimate state interest, the burden it imposes on interstate commerce is only incidental, and the state's interest cannot be satisfied by other means that are less burdensome to interstate commerce.
该州法律促进了一项合法的州利益，其对州际贸易施加的负担仅是附带性的，并且该州的利益无法通过对州际贸易负担较轻的其他方式来满足。
data.explanation:
The negative implication of the commerce clause (ie, the dormant commerce clause) prohibits states from discriminating against or otherwise unduly burdening interstate commerce. As a result, states generally cannot favor in-state over out-of-state economic interests unless:
  • the state law furthers a legitimate, noneconomic state interest and no reasonable, nondiscriminatory alternatives are available.
But this analysis is unnecessary - and states can engage in such discrimination - when Congress explicitly authorizes the state's conduct (or some other exception to the dormant commerce clause applies).

Here, the state law discriminates against interstate commerce by requiring citrus fruit imported into the state - but not citrus fruit grown within the state - to have a stamp showing its origin (Choice C). This law would ordinarily violate the dormant commerce clause since there are reasonable alternatives to prevent citrus fruit infections (eg, conducting safety inspections) (Choice D). But since Congress explicitly authorized states to require this labeling, this is the state's best argument to have the lawsuit dismissed.

(Choice A) Under the undue burden test, a state regulation is justified if its legitimate, local benefits exceed the burdens imposed on interstate commerce. But this test does not apply to discriminatory state regulations (as seen here).

Educational objective: The dormant commerce clause generally prohibits states from discriminating against or unduly burdening interstate commerce. But states can do so when Congress has explicitly authorized that conduct.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

commerce clause（商业条款）的负面含义（即dormant commerce clause，休眠商业条款）禁止各州歧视或以其他方式过度加重州际贸易的负担。因此，各州通常不能偏袒州内经济利益而排斥州外经济利益，除非：
  • 该州法律促进了一项合法的、非经济性的州利益，并且没有合理的、非歧视性的替代方案。
但当国会明确授权州的该行为时（或当休眠商业条款的其他例外情况适用时），此项分析则无必要——并且各州可以进行此类歧视。

在本案中，该州法律要求进口到本州的柑橘类水果——而非州内种植的柑橘类水果——必须盖上标明其来源地的印章，从而构成了对州际贸易的歧视（选项C）。该法律通常会违反休眠商业条款，因为存在合理的替代方案来防止柑橘类水果的感染（例如，进行安全检查）（选项D）。但由于国会明确授权各州要求此种标签，这是该州要求驳回诉讼的最佳论点。

（选项A）根据过度负担测试，如果一项州法规的合法本地利益超过其对州际贸易施加的负担，则该法规是正当的。但此测试不适用于歧视性的州法规（如本案所示）。

教学目的：休眠商业条款通常禁止各州歧视或过度加重州际贸易的负担。但当国会明确授权该行为时，各州可以这样做。

References

  • U.S. Const. art. I, § 8 (commerce clause).
  • Ne. Bancorp, Inc. v. Bd. of Governors of Fed. Reserve Sys., 472 U.S. 159, 174 (1985) (explaining that states can discriminate against interstate commerce when Congress authorizes them to do so).
  • 15A Am. Jur. 2d Commerce § 27 (2019) (discussing congressional authorization to regulate interstate commerce).

MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations / Commerce Clause

核心考点：国会的授权

本题考察的是宪法中的一个关键例外原则：国会对州际贸易管制的授权 (Congressional Authorization)。

基本原则 (Dormant Commerce Clause):
通常情况下，如果国会保持沉默（未立法），Dormant Commerce Clause（休眠商业条款）禁止各州通过歧视州际贸易或对其造成过度负担的法律。
例外情况 (The Exception):
如果国会明确授权 (Explicitly Authorizes) 州政府进行某种管制，那么即使该州法律具有歧视性或阻碍了州际贸易，它也是合宪的。

这是因为宪法赋予国会管理州际贸易的权力是完全的 (Plenary Power)，国会可以将这种权力“下放”或“许可”给各州。

答案解析

正确答案：B

逻辑推理链条：

  1. 事实认定： 题目第一句明确指出“Congress enacted a federal statute...”（国会颁布了一项联邦法规），允许各州要求进口柑橘标明原产地。
  2. 州的行为： 该州随后颁布了法律，完全符合联邦法规的授权范围。
  3. 法律后果： 虽然该州法律只针对“进口”水果（表面上构成了对州际贸易的歧视），但因为有国会的尚方宝剑（明确授权），休眠商业条款的限制不再适用。

因此，该州最好的辩护理由就是：“国会让我们这么做的。”

为什么其他选项不是“最佳”？

选项 A & D (错误):
这两个选项试图使用利益平衡测试 (Balancing Test) 或 严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)。
  • 如果国会没有立法，我们需要分析州法律是否为了合法的本地利益（如防疫）且没有更轻微的替代手段（如选项D所述）。
  • 但这在法庭上是一个很难证明的标准（通常歧视性法律会被判违宪）。
  • 相比之下，国会授权 (选项B) 是一个绝对的、不可反驳的防御理由，因此它是“最佳”论点。
选项 C (错误):
这是一个事实上的错误。该法律明确只要求“进口到该州”的水果贴标签，而不要求州内种植的水果贴标签。这在法律上构成了表面上的歧视 (Facially Discriminatory)。否认歧视的存在是一个非常弱的论点。
🎓 MBE 抢分技巧

在处理涉及 Commerce Clause 的题目时，请遵循以下步骤：

  1. 先看国会： 检查题干是否提到国会通过了相关法律？
    • 如果有联邦法律授权：州法律有效（本题情况）。
    • 如果有联邦法律禁止：州法律无效（Preemption/先占原则）。
  2. 若国会沉默： 才进入 Dormant Commerce Clause 的分析（区分是否歧视、是否过度负担）。

切记： 一旦看到 "Congress enacted..." 或 "Pursuant to federal statute..."，你的雷达就应该响起来：这通常意味着休眠商业条款的限制被解除了。

questions.question:
State A sent three of its employees to a city located in State B to consult with a chemical laboratory there about matters of state business. While in the course of their employment, the three State A employees negligently released into local State B waterways some of the chemical samples they had received from the laboratory in State B.
Persons in State B injured by the release of the chemicals sued the three State A employees and State A in a State B court for the damages they suffered. After a trial in which all of the defendants admitted jurisdiction of the State B court and fully participated, the plaintiffs received a judgment against all of the defendants for $5 million, which became final.
Subsequently, the plaintiffs sought to enforce their State B court judgment by commencing a proper proceeding in an appropriate State A court. In that enforcement proceeding, State A argued, as it had done unsuccessfully in the earlier action in the State B court, that its liability is limited by a State A law to $100,000 in any tort case. Because the three individual employees of State A are able to pay only $50,000 of the judgment, the only way the plaintiffs can fully satisfy their State B court judgment is from the funds of State A.
Can the plaintiffs recover the full balance of their State B court judgment from State A in the enforcement proceeding they filed in the State A court?

choices.a: No, because the State A employees were negligent and, therefore, their actions were not authorized by State A.
choices.b: No, because the Tenth Amendment preserves the right of a state to have its courts enforce the state's public policy limiting its tort liability.
choices.c: Yes, because a limitation on damage awards against State A for tortious actions of its agents would violate the equal protection clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
choices.d: Yes, because the final judgment of the State B court is entitled to full faith and credit in the State A courts.

A州派遣其三名雇员前往B州的一座城市，就州政府业务事宜与当地一家化学实验室进行咨询。在其雇佣过程中，这三名A州雇员因过失将他们从B州实验室获得的一些化学样本释放到B州当地的水道中。

B州因化学品释放而受伤的人员在B州法院起诉了这三名A州雇员和A州，要求赔偿他们所遭受的损害。经过审判，所有被告都承认了B州法院的管辖权并充分参与了诉讼，原告获得了针对所有被告的500万美元的判决，该判决已成为终审判决。

随后，原告在A州的一个适当法院启动了适当的程序，试图执行他们在B州法院的判决。在该执行程序中，A州辩称（正如其早先在B州法院的诉讼中未成功地主张过的那样），根据A州的一项法律，其在任何侵权案件中的赔偿责任以10万美元为限。由于A州的三名雇员个人只能支付判决中的5万美元，原告要完全满足他们在B州法院的判决，唯一途径是从A州的资金中获得。

原告能否在他们向A州法院提起的执行程序中，从A州追讨其在B州法院判决的全部余额？
options:
A. No, because the State A employees were negligent and, therefore, their actions were not authorized by State A.
不可以，因为A州的雇员存在过失，因此，他们的行为未经A州授权。

B. No, because the Tenth Amendment preserves the right of a state to have its courts enforce the state's public policy limiting its tort liability.
不可以，因为《第十修正案》(Tenth Amendment) 保留了州通过其法院执行本州限制其侵权责任的公共政策的权利。

C. Yes, because a limitation on damage awards against State A for tortious actions of its agents would violate the equal protection clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
可以，因为对A州因其代理人的侵权行为而应付的损害赔偿金进行限制，将违反《第十四修正案》(Fourteenth Amendment) 的平等保护条款 (equal protection clause)。

D. Yes, because the final judgment of the State B court is entitled to full faith and credit in the State A courts.
可以，因为B州法院的终审判决有权在A州法院获得充分信任与尊重 (full faith and credit)。
data.explanation:
The Article IV full faith and credit clause requires states to respect the public acts, records, and judicial proceedings of other states. Under this clause, a state court must recognize and enforce judicial decisions rendered by a court in another state when:
  • that court had personal jurisdiction and subject-matter jurisdiction
  • the case was decided on its merits - ie, the substantive elements or grounds of a claim or defense
  • a final judgment was entered.
Here, the State B residents (plaintiffs) sued the State A employees and State A (defendants) in a State B court. The defendants admitted that the court had jurisdiction . The case was then decided on its merits when the court issued a $5 million judgment against the defendants. And since the State B judgment became final , it is entitled to full faith and credit in the State A courts. Therefore, the plaintiffs can recover the full balance of that judgment from State A in the enforcement proceeding they filed in the State A court.

(Choice A) Since the employees acted in the course of their employment, their actions were authorized by State A - even if the employees were negligent. And State A is vicariously liable for that negligence under the doctrine of respondeat superior.

(Choice B) The Tenth Amendment gives states any power that is not expressly given to the federal government by the Constitution - eg, the power of state courts to enforce the state's public policy limiting its tort liability. But when exercising such powers, states must comply with other constitutional provisions - eg, the full faith and credit clause.

(Choice C) A limitation on damage awards against State A likely would not violate the equal protection clause because it would not substantially impact a fundamental right or protected class.

Educational objective: Under the full faith and credit clause, a state court must recognize and enforce a judicial decision by a court in another state when:
  • that court had personal and subject matter jurisdiction
  • the case was decided on its merits
  • a final judgment was entered.




选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 11%，C选项 1%，D选项 83%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

《宪法》第四条 (Article IV) 的充分信任与尊重条款 (full faith and credit clause) 要求各州尊重其他州的公法、记录和司法程序。根据该条款，一个州法院必须承认并执行由另一州法院作出的司法判决，前提是：
  • 该法院拥有对人管辖权 (personal jurisdiction) 和事务管辖权 (subject-matter jurisdiction)
  • 案件是依据其实体是非曲直 (merits) 作出裁决的——即，基于诉讼请求或抗辩的实体要素或理由
  • 已经作出了终审判决 (final judgment)。
在本案中，B州居民（原告）在B州法院起诉A州雇员和A州（被告）。被告承认该法院拥有管辖权 (jurisdiction)。随后，法院对被告作出了500万美元的判决，这是根据案件的实体是非曲直 (merits) 作出的裁决。并且，由于B州的判决已成为终审判决 (final)，它有权在A州法院获得充分信任与尊重。因此，原告可以在他们向A州法院提起的执行程序中，从A州追讨该判决的全部余额。

(选项A) 由于雇员是在其雇佣过程中行事，他们的行为是经过A州授权的——即使雇员存在过失。根据“雇主责任”原则 (doctrine of respondeat superior)，A州对该过失承担替代责任。

(选项B) 《第十修正案》(Tenth Amendment) 将宪法未明确授予联邦政府的任何权力赋予各州——例如，州法院有权执行本州限制其侵权责任的公共政策。但在行使这些权力时，各州必须遵守其他宪法规定——例如，充分信任与尊重条款 (full faith and credit clause)。

(选项C) 对A州的损害赔偿金进行限制可能不会违反平等保护条款 (equal protection clause)，因为它不会对一项基本权利或受保护阶层产生实质性影响。

教学目标：根据充分信任与尊重条款 (full faith and credit clause)，一个州法院必须承认并执行另一州法院的司法判决，前提是：
  • 该法院拥有对人管辖权和事务管辖权
  • 案件是根据其案件实体是非曲直作出裁决的
  • 已经作出了终审判决。


References

Baker v. Gen. Motors Corp., 522 U.S. 222, 231 - 33 (1998) (explaining when the full faith and credit clause applies to state court judgments).

V.L. v. E.L., 136 S. Ct. 1017, 1020 - 22 (2016) (holding that a state court cannot relitigate a case that has already been decided on its merits in a court of another state).

MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations & Full Faith and Credit

正确答案：D

本题的核心考点是美国宪法第四条的充分信任与尊重条款 (Full Faith and Credit Clause)。

简单来说，一旦B州法院作出了有效的终审判决，A州法院必须承认并执行该判决，即使该判决结果违反了A州的法律或公共政策。

法律原理详解

根据《美国宪法》第四条第一款，各州必须给予其他州的“公共法令、记录和司法程序”以充分的信任与尊重。

执行判决的三要素：
A州法院必须执行B州法院的判决，只要满足以下三个条件：
  • 管辖权 (Jurisdiction)： 原法院拥有对人和对事管辖权。
  • 实体判决 (On the Merits)： 案件是基于事实和法律作出的裁决，而非程序性驳回。
  • 终审判决 (Final Judgment)： 判决是最终的，不可再上诉。

本案关键点分析：

  1. 管辖权已承认： 题目明确指出A州作为被告“承认了B州法院的管辖权并充分参与了诉讼”。这意味着A州放弃了可能拥有的主权豁免 (Sovereign Immunity) 抗辩。
  2. 判决已生效： B州法院作出了500万美元的终审判决。
  3. 无“公共政策”例外： 这是MBE常考的一个误区。虽然在法律适用 (Choice of Law) 阶段，法院可以拒绝适用违背本州公共政策的外州法律；但在判决执行 (Enforcement of Judgment) 阶段，不存在“公共政策例外”。

因此，A州不能以“本州法律规定赔偿上限为10万美元”为由，拒绝执行B州500万美元的判决。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (雇员过失未授权)

错误原因： 这是一个事实和法律上的错误结论。根据Respondeat Superior（上级责任/雇主替代责任）原则，只要雇员是在“受雇过程中” (course of employment) 造成的过失侵权，雇主（A州）就需要负责。题目已明确说明是在受雇过程中。

选项 B (第十修正案/公共政策)

错误原因： 这是最强的干扰项。虽然第十修正案保留了州的权力，且州确实有权制定限制侵权责任的法律，但这种权力不能凌驾于宪法明确规定的Full Faith and Credit Clause之上。一旦案件在B州判决生效，A州的公共政策就不能再用来阻碍该判决的执行。

选项 C (平等保护条款)

错误原因： 限制政府的侵权赔偿责任通常通过“合理性审查” (Rational Basis Review)，因为这不涉及基本权利或嫌疑分类。因此，设立赔偿上限通常不会违反第十四修正案的平等保护条款。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

遇到涉及跨州判决执行的题目时，请遵循以下逻辑：

  1. 检查管辖权： 原法院是否有管辖权？（本题中被告同意了，所以有）。
  2. 检查判决性质： 是否是基于实体 (Merits) 的终审 (Final) 判决？
  3. 应用规则： 如果上述都满足，执行州必须执行判决。
  4. 警惕陷阱： 不要被执行州的“法律”或“公共政策”所迷惑。判决 (Judgment) 的效力高于执行州的本地法律。

questions.question:
A plaintiff has sued a defendant in a court of the state in which both parties reside. The plaintiff alleges only a cause of action arising under a federal statute, although state law provides a similar cause of action. The federal statute provides that claims under the statute can be brought in any court of competent jurisdiction. The statute has not yet been interpreted by any federal court.
Should the state court hear the case?

choices.a: No, because cases arising under federal law must be decided in federal court.
choices.b: No, because state courts must abstain in cases arising under federal law until a federal court has decided the federal issue.
choices.c: Yes, because state courts may not discriminate against cases arising under federal law.
choices.d: Yes, because the parties cannot proceed in federal court since there is no diversity of citizenship.

data.questionStem:
Q82812 A plaintiff has sued a defendant in a court of the state in which both parties reside. The plaintiff alleges only a cause of action arising under a federal statute, although state law provides a similar cause of action. The federal statute provides that claims under the statute can be brought in any court of competent jurisdiction. The statute has not yet been interpreted by any federal court.

Should the state court hear the case? 一名原告在其与被告共同居住的州的州法院起诉了该被告。原告仅主张一项源于联邦法规的诉因，尽管州法律也规定了类似的诉因。该联邦法规规定，依据该法规提起的诉讼可以向任何有管辖权的法院提出。该法规尚未被任何联邦法院解释过。

州法院是否应该审理此案？
options:
A. No, because cases arising under federal law must be decided in federal court.
不应审理，因为源于联邦法律的案件必须在联邦法院裁决。

B. No, because state courts must abstain in cases arising under federal law until a federal court has decided the federal issue.
不应审理，因为在联邦法院对联邦问题作出裁决之前，州法院必须对源于联邦法律的案件行使回避原则。

C. Yes, because state courts may not discriminate against cases arising under federal law.
应审理，因为州法院不得歧视源于联邦法律的案件。

D. Yes, because the parties cannot proceed in federal court since there is no diversity of citizenship.
应审理，因为当事人之间不存在州籍多元化，所以无法在联邦法院进行诉讼。
data.explanation:
Concurrent jurisdiction


Type of claimFederal courtState court
Federal lawJurisdiction always properJurisdiction proper unless:
  • Congress granted federal courts exclusive jurisdiction or
  • neutral state rule bars state court jurisdiction
State lawJurisdiction proper if:
  • diverse opposing parties and
  • amount in controversy > $75,000
Jurisdiction always proper
State and federal courts share concurrent jurisdiction over claims arising under federal law (Choice A). But under the supremacy clause, state courts cannot discriminate against cases arising under federal law. As a result, state courts can only refuse to hear such a case in two narrow circumstances:
  • when Congress expressly granted federal courts exclusive jurisdiction over the subject matter (eg, bankruptcy) or
  • when a neutral state rule prohibits the state court from adjudicating the case (eg, a rule barring state courts from deciding cases that do not involve state residents or property).
Here, the plaintiff sued the defendant in state court, alleging only a cause of action arising under federal law. The relevant statute provides that claims under the statute can be brought in any court of competent jurisdiction, and there is no indication that a state rule prohibits the state court from hearing the case. And since state courts cannot discriminate against cases arising under federal law, the state court should hear the case.

(Choice B) A federal court should abstain from hearing a case involving an unsettled issue of state law so that state courts can sort out the issue. But state courts need not abstain from hearing unsettled issues of federal law (as seen here).

(Choice D) Federal courts can obtain subject-matter jurisdiction under either (1) diversity jurisdiction or (2) federal-question jurisdiction—ie, when the case arises under the Constitution, a treaty, or a federal law (as seen here). Therefore, the parties could have proceeded in federal court even though they lack diversity of citizenship—ie, are citizens of the same state.

共同管辖权


诉讼类型联邦法院州法院
联邦法律管辖权始终适当管辖权适当，除非：
  • 国会授予联邦法院专属管辖权或
  • 中立的州规则禁止州法院行使管辖权
州法律管辖权适当，如果：
  • 对立当事人州籍多元且
  • 争议金额 > 75,000美元
管辖权始终适当
州法院和联邦法院对源于联邦法律的诉讼享有共同管辖权（选项A）。但根据至上条款，州法院不得歧视源于联邦法律的案件。因此，州法院只有在两种狭窄的情况下才能拒绝审理此类案件：
  • 当国会明确授予联邦法院对该标的物的专属管辖权时（例如，破产案件）或
  • 当一项中立的州规则禁止州法院裁决该案件时（例如，禁止州法院裁决不涉及本州居民或财产的案件的规则）。
在本案中，原告在州法院起诉被告，仅主张一项源于联邦法律的诉因。相关法规规定，依据该法规提起的诉讼可以向任何有管辖权的法院提出，并且没有迹象表明有州规则禁止州法院审理此案。由于州法院不得歧视源于联邦法律的案件，因此州法院应该审理此案。

(选项B) 联邦法院对于涉及未决的州法律问题的案件应行使回避原则，以便州法院可以解决该问题。但州法院无需对未决的联邦法律问题（如本案所示）行使回避原则。

(选项D) 联邦法院可以通过（1）州籍多元管辖权或（2）联邦问题管辖权获得事物管辖权——即，当案件源于宪法、条约或联邦法律时（如本案所示）。因此，即使当事人缺乏州籍多元化——即他们是同一州的公民，他们本也可以在联邦法院提起诉讼。

Educational objective:

The supremacy clause bars state courts from discriminating against cases arising under federal law. As a result, state courts can only refuse to hear federal-law claims if (1) Congress expressly granted federal courts exclusive jurisdiction or (2) a neutral state rule prohibits the state court from hearing the case.

References

  • Claflin v. Houseman, 93 U.S. 130, 136 (1876) (holding that state courts share concurrent jurisdiction with federal courts over cases arising under federal law).

  • Haywood v. Drown, 556 U.S. 729, 735–36 (2009) (explaining that state courts can refuse to hear a case involving a federal law only when federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction or a neutral state rule prohibits the state court from hearing it).

  • 20 Am. Jur. 2d Courts § 88 (2019) (describing federal and state courts' concurrent jurisdiction).

MBE 考点解析：州法院管辖权

本题考察的核心是州法院与联邦法院的共同管辖权以及至上条款对州法院义务的规定。

正确答案：C
州法院应审理此案，因为州法院不得歧视源于联邦法律的案件。

1. 核心法律规则

共同管辖权 (Concurrent Jurisdiction)

默认规则是：州法院对联邦法律诉讼享有共同管辖权。除非国会明确规定某类案件由联邦法院专属管辖 (Exclusive Jurisdiction)（如专利、反垄断、破产），否则原告可以选择在州法院起诉。

反歧视原则 (Non-discrimination Principle)

根据宪法第六条的至上条款 (Supremacy Clause)，联邦法律是“国家的最高法律”。

最高法院在 Testa v. Katt (1947) 和 Haywood v. Drown (2009) 等判例中确立了以下原则：

  • 如果州法院有权审理类似的州法诉因 (State Law Claims)，则其不能仅仅因为诉因源于联邦法律而拒绝行使管辖权。
  • 州法院不能“歧视”联邦诉讼。

2. 案情分析

在本题中：

  • 法规内容：联邦法规允许在“任何有管辖权的法院”起诉（暗示非专属管辖）。
  • 州法背景：州法律提供了“类似的诉因”。这意味着该州法院有能力和权限审理此类性质的案件。
  • 结论：既然州法院能审理类似的州法案件，它就不得拒绝审理该联邦法案件。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 A 错误
"Cases arising under federal law must be decided in federal court."
这是常见的误区。联邦问题 (Federal Question) 案件通常是共同管辖的，只有极少数是联邦专属管辖。
选项 B 错误
"State courts must abstain..."
回避原则 (Abstention Doctrines) 通常是指联邦法院在涉及未决的州法问题时回避，让州法院先决断（如 Pullman Abstention）。反之则不然，州法院有义务解释和适用联邦法律，无需等待联邦法院先例。
选项 D 错误
"...parties cannot proceed in federal court since there is no diversity..."
虽然结论是“应审理”，但理由错误。即使没有州籍多元 (Diversity of Citizenship)，只要案件涉及联邦法律，联邦法院就有联邦问题管辖权 (Federal Question Jurisdiction, 28 U.S.C. § 1331)。原告本可以去联邦法院，但这并不是州法院必须审理此案的理由（理由是反歧视原则）。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 中，看到“州法院拒绝审理联邦案件”的情景时，请立即检查：
  1. 是否为联邦专属管辖（如破产、专利）？
  2. 是否有“正当的行政理由”或“中立的程序规则”？
如果都不是，且州法院能审理类似的州法案件，那么根据至上条款，州法院必须审理，不得歧视。

questions.question:
A state spends several million dollars a year on an oyster conservation program. As part of that program, the state limits, by statute, oyster fishing in its coastal waters to persons who have state oyster permits. In order to promote conservation, it issues only a limited number of oyster permits each year. The permits are effective for only one year from the date of their issuance and are awarded on the basis of a lottery, in which there is no differentiation between resident and nonresident applicants. However, each nonresident who obtains a permit is charged an annual permit fee that is $5 more than the fee charged residents.
A large fishing company operates from a port in another state and is incorporated in that other state. Each of the company's boats has a federal shipping license that permits it "to engage in all aspects of the coastal trade, to fish and to carry cargo from place to place along the coast, and to engage in other lawful activities along the coast of the United States." These shipping licenses are authorized by federal statute. Assume no other federal statutes or administrative rules apply.
Although it had previously held a state oyster permit, the company did not obtain a permit in that state's lottery this year.
Which of the following is the strongest argument that can be made in support of a continued right of the company to fish for oysters this year in the state's coastal waters?

choices.a: The company has a right to fish for oysters in the state's waters despite the state law because it holds a federal shipping license.
choices.b: The refusal to grant the company a permit this year is a taking of its property without due process of law because the company previously held a state oyster permit and the state knows that the company is engaged in a continuing business operation.
choices.c: The state law denies the company the privileges and immunities of state citizenship because it provides higher permit charges for nonresidents.
choices.d: The state law is an undue burden on interstate commerce because it provides higher permit charges for nonresidents.

Which of the following is the strongest argument that can be made in support of a continued right of the company to fish for oysters this year in the state's coastal waters?

某州每年花费数百万美元用于一项牡蛎保护计划。作为该计划的一部分，该州通过法规将其沿海水域的牡蛎捕捞活动限制在持有州牡蛎许可证的人员范围内。为促进保护，该州每年仅发放数量有限的牡蛎许可证。许可证自签发之日起有效期仅为一年，并通过抽签方式授予，抽签不对州内居民和非居民申请人加以区分。但是，每位获得许可证的非居民需缴纳的年度许可费比州内居民高出5美元。

一家大型渔业公司在另一州的港口运营，并于该州注册成立。该公司的每艘船都持有联邦航运执照，该执照允许其“从事沿海贸易的各个方面，在沿海地区捕鱼和运输货物，以及在美国沿海从事其他合法活动”。这些航运执照由联邦法规授权。假设没有其他联邦法规或行政规则适用。

尽管该公司之前曾持有该州的牡蛎许可证，但在今年的州抽签中未能获得许可证。

以下哪项是支持该公司今年有权继续在该州沿海水域捕捞牡蛎的最有力论点？
options:
A. The company has a right to fish for oysters in the state's waters despite the state law because it holds a federal shipping license.
该公司有权在该州水域捕捞牡蛎，尽管存在州法律的规定，因为其持有联邦航运执照。

B. The refusal to grant the company a permit this year is a taking of its property without due process of law because the company previously held a state oyster permit and the state knows that the company is engaged in a continuing business operation.
今年拒绝授予该公司许可证，构成未经正当法律程序剥夺其财产，因为该公司先前曾持有州牡蛎许可证，且州政府知晓该公司正在从事持续的商业运营。

C. The state law denies the company the privileges and immunities of state citizenship because it provides higher permit charges for nonresidents.
该州法律拒绝给予该公司州公民的特权和豁免权，因为它对非居民收取更高的许可费用。

D. The state law is an undue burden on interstate commerce because it provides higher permit charges for nonresidents.
该州法律对州际贸易构成了不当负担，因为它对非居民收取更高的许可费用。
data.explanation:
Under the supremacy clause , the provisions of the U.S. Constitution, federal laws, and treaties are the supreme law of the land. As a result, these provisions preempt conflicting provisions in state constitutions, state laws , and local laws - rendering such provisions void and without effect.

Here, the fishing company possesses a shipping license authorized by a federal statute that permits it to fish in the state's waters. But the state statute prohibits the company from fishing since it lacks a state-issued permit. Since these statutes conflict, the company's strongest argument is that its federal shipping license gives it a right to fish in the state's waters despite the state law.

(Choice B) The Fourteenth Amendment due process clause requires a state to provide notice and a meaningful opportunity to be heard to those it deprives of life, liberty, or property. But the company has no property interest in its expired state permit, so the state did not violate this clause.

(Choice C) The Article IV privileges and immunities clause prohibits states from discriminating against citizens of other states by denying them a right of state citizenship. But aliens and corporations (like the fishing company) are not considered citizens under this clause. Therefore, this clause does not apply.

(Choice D) The dormant commerce clause generally bars states from discriminating against or otherwise unduly burdening interstate commerce. But discrimination is permitted when the state participates in the market - ie, buys or sells goods or services. And since the state is selling permits to fish in its coastal waters, it can charge nonresidents more for a permit.

Educational objective: Under the supremacy clause, the U.S. Constitution, federal laws, and treaties preempt conflicting state constitutions, state laws, and local laws.



选项正确率统计：A选项 62%（正确选项），B选项 5%，C选项 9%，D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据 supremacy clause（最高条款），U.S. Constitution（美国宪法）、联邦法律和条约的规定是国家的最高法律。因此，这些规定优先于州宪法、州法律和地方法律中的冲突条款，使此类条款无效。

在本案中，该渔业公司持有一项由联邦法规授权的航运执照，该执照允许其在该州水域捕鱼。但州法规因其缺少州颁发的许可证而禁止该公司捕鱼。由于这些法规相冲突，公司最有力的论点是，其联邦航运执照赋予了它在该州水域捕鱼的权利，尽管存在州法律的规定。

（选项B） Fourteenth Amendment（第十四修正案）的 due process clause（正当程序条款）要求州在剥夺任何人的生命、自由或财产时，必须提供通知和有意义的听证机会。但该公司对其已过期的州许可证不享有财产权，因此该州并未违反此条款。

（选项C） Article IV（第四条）的 privileges and immunities clause（特权与豁免条款）禁止各州通过拒绝给予州公民权来歧视其他州的公民。但外国人和公司（如本案的渔业公司）在此条款下不被视为公民。因此，该条款不适用。

（选项D） dormant commerce clause（休眠商业条款）通常禁止各州歧视或以其他方式不当加重州际贸易的负担。但当州作为市场参与者——即购买或销售商品或服务时，歧视是被允许的。并且，由于该州正在销售其沿海水域的捕鱼许可证，它可以向非居民收取更高的费用。

教学目标：根据 supremacy clause（最高条款），U.S. Constitution（美国宪法）、联邦法律和条约优先于相冲突的州宪法、州法律和地方法律。

References

U.S. Const. art. VI, cl. 2 (supremacy clause).

Douglas v. Seacoast Prods., Inc., 431 U.S. 265, 283 (1977) (holding that a state fishing law that prohibits federally licensed ships from fishing in the state's waters violates the supremacy clause).

MBE 考点解析

Federal-State Relations & Preemption

核心考点

本题考察的是美国宪法中的最高条款 (Supremacy Clause) 以及联邦法律对州法律的优先权 (Preemption)。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 A)
法律依据：Supremacy Clause (Art. VI, Cl. 2)

根据美国宪法第六条第二款，宪法、联邦法律和条约是“国家的最高法律”(Supreme Law of the Land)。当有效的联邦法律与州法律发生冲突时，联邦法律优先。

逻辑推演：

  1. 联邦授权： 题目指出该公司持有联邦航运执照 (Federal shipping license)，该执照明确允许其“从事沿海贸易...及捕鱼 (to fish)”。
  2. 州法限制： 州法律设立了抽签制度，导致该公司因未中签而被禁止在该州水域捕鱼。
  3. 直接冲突： 联邦法律说“你可以捕鱼”，州法律说“你不能捕鱼”。
  4. 结论： 联邦执照赋予的权利优先于州的限制性法规。
💡 判例背景： 本题改编自真实判例 Douglas v. Seacoast Products, Inc. (1977)。最高法院裁定，联邦颁发的从事渔业的执照优先于州限制非居民或特定船只捕鱼的法律。
❌ 陷阱选项分析
⚠️ 陷阱一：特权与豁免条款 (选项 C)

错误原因： Privileges and Immunities Clause (Art. IV) 确实禁止州歧视外州公民。但是，公司 (Corporations) 和外国人 (Aliens) 不被视为该条款下的“公民” (Citizens)。

👉 MBE 铁律： 看到“公司”引用 P&I Clause 维权，直接排除。

⚠️ 陷阱二：正当程序条款 (选项 B)

错误原因： Due Process Clause 保护的是生命、自由或财产。要主张程序性正当程序权利，必须先证明拥有合法的财产权益 (Legitimate Property Interest)。

👉 许可证已过期，且新许可证是基于“抽签” (Lottery) 发放的，这意味着公司对新许可证只有“单方面的期望” (Unilateral Expectation)，而非既得的财产权利。

⚠️ 陷阱三：休眠商业条款 (选项 D)

错误原因： 虽然州法律歧视非居民可能违反 Dormant Commerce Clause，但本题中：

  • 州作为“市场参与者” (Market Participant, 出售许可证) 可能享有例外豁免。
  • 更重要的是： 当有明确的联邦法律（航运执照）存在时，直接使用最高条款 (Supremacy Clause) 总是比使用隐含的休眠商业条款论证更强有力。
🎓 考试技巧总结

在处理涉及联邦与州关系的 MBE 题目时，请遵循以下论证层级：

  1. 最高层级： 联邦法律/宪法直接优先 (Supremacy Clause)。如果题目中有联邦法规或执照，首先考虑这个。
  2. 中间层级： 如果没有联邦法规，看州法是否歧视外州 (Dormant Commerce Clause / P&I Clause)。
  3. 注意主体： 只有自然人享有 P&I 保护，公司没有。

questions.question:
In recent years, several large corporations incorporated and headquartered in State A have been acquired by out-of-state corporations that have moved all of their operations out of State A. Other corporations incorporated and headquartered in State A have successfully resisted such acquisition attempts by out-of-state corporations, but they have suffered severe economic injury as a result.
In an effort to preserve jobs in State A and to protect its domestic corporations against their sudden acquisition by out-of-state purchasers, the legislature of State A enacts a statute governing acquisitions of shares in all corporations incorporated in State A. This statute requires that any acquisition of more than 25% of the voting shares of a corporation incorporated in State A that occurs over a period of less than one year must be approved by the holders of record of a majority of the shares of the corporation as of the day before the acquisition of those shares commences. The statute expressly applies to acquisitions of State A corporations by both in-state and out-of-state entities.
Assume that no federal statute applies.
Is this statute of State A constitutional?

choices.a: No, because one of the purposes of the statute is to prevent out-of-state entities from acquiring corporations incorporated and headquartered in State A.
choices.b: No, because the effect of the statute will necessarily be to hinder the acquisition of State A corporations by other corporations, many of whose shareholders are not residents of State A and, therefore, it will adversely affect the interstate sale of securities.
choices.c: Yes, because corporations exist only by virtue of state law and, therefore, the negative implications of the commerce clause do not apply to state regulations governing their creation and acquisition.
choices.d: Yes, because the statute imposes the same burden on both in-state and out-of-state entities wishing to acquire a State A corporation, it regulates only the acquisition of State A corporations, and it does not create an impermissible risk of inconsistent regulation on this subject by different states.

data.questionStem:
Q82022

In recent years, several large corporations incorporated and headquartered in State A have been acquired by out-of-state corporations that have moved all of their operations out of State A. Other corporations incorporated and headquartered in State A have successfully resisted such acquisition attempts by out-of-state corporations, but they have suffered severe economic injury as a result.

In an effort to preserve jobs in State A and to protect its domestic corporations against their sudden acquisition by out-of-state purchasers, the legislature of State A enacts a statute governing acquisitions of shares in all corporations incorporated in State A. This statute requires that any acquisition of more than 25% of the voting shares of a corporation incorporated in State A that occurs over a period of less than one year must be approved by the holders of record of a majority of the shares of the corporation as of the day before the acquisition of those shares commences. The statute expressly applies to acquisitions of State A corporations by both in-state and out-of-state entities.

Assume that no federal statute applies.

Is this statute of State A constitutional?

近年来，数家在 A 州注册并设立总部的大公司被州外公司收购，这些州外公司已将其所有业务迁出 A 州。另一些在 A 州注册并设立总部的公司虽然成功抵制了州外公司的此类收购企图，但因此遭受了严重的经济损失。

为保留 A 州的就业机会并保护其本州公司免遭州外购买者的突然收购，A 州立法机构颁布了一项法规，用以管辖在 A 州注册的所有公司的股份收购行为。该法规要求，任何在不到一年的时间内收购一家在 A 州注册的公司超过 25% 有表决权股份的行为，必须在该股份收购开始前一日，获得该公司在册多数股份持有人的批准。该法规明确适用于州内和州外实体对 A 州公司的收购。

假设没有联邦法规适用。

A 州的这项法规是否合宪？
options:
A. No, because one of the purposes of the statute is to prevent out-of-state entities from acquiring corporations incorporated and headquartered in State A.
不合宪，因为该法规的目的之一是阻止州外实体收购在 A 州注册并设立总部的公司。

B. No, because the effect of the statute will necessarily be to hinder the acquisition of State A corporations by other corporations, many of whose shareholders are not residents of State A and, therefore, it will adversely affect the interstate sale of securities.
不合宪，因为该法规的效力必然会阻碍其他公司对 A 州公司的收购，而这些公司的许多股东并非 A 州居民，因此，它将对州际证券销售产生不利影响。

C. Yes, because corporations exist only by virtue of state law and, therefore, the negative implications of the commerce clause do not apply to state regulations governing their creation and acquisition.
合宪，因为公司的存在仅依据州法律，因此，商业条款的消极含义不适用于管辖公司设立和收购的州法规。

D. Yes, because the statute imposes the same burden on both in-state and out-of-state entities wishing to acquire a State A corporation, it regulates only the acquisition of State A corporations, and it does not create an impermissible risk of inconsistent regulation on this subject by different states.
合宪，因为该法规对希望收购 A 州公司的州内和州外实体施加了相同的负担，它仅管辖对 A 州公司的收购，并且不会造成不同州就此问题制定不一致法规的不可允许的风险。
data.explanation:
Under the dormant commerce clause, states are prohibited from discriminating against or otherwise unduly burdening interstate commerce. A state regulation is not discriminatory if it treats in-state and out-of-state activities equally. But the nondiscriminatory regulation is unduly burdensome if its burden on interstate commerce clearly exceeds its legitimate, local benefits. This often occurs when there is a risk of inconsistent regulations on the same activity by different states.

Here, the State A statute is not discriminatory since it imposes an equal burden on acquisitions by both in-state and out-of-state entities. And the statute is not unduly burdensome because there is no risk of inconsistent regulations by different states. That is because, as the Supreme Court reasoned in CTS Corp. v. Dynamics Corp. of Am. , corporations are typically governed by the law of the state in which they are incorporated, and this statute regulates only the acquisition of State A corporations. Therefore, the statute is constitutional.

(Choices A & B) The statute's purpose is to prevent out-of-state entities from acquiring State A corporations. And it will likely hinder acquisitions by corporations with out-of-state shareholders - adversely affecting the interstate sale of securities. But the statute's impact on interstate commerce is permissible because it is not discriminatory or unduly burdensome.

(Choice C) The negative implications of the commerce clause (ie, dormant commerce clause) do apply to state regulations governing the creation and acquisition of corporations if those regulations discriminate against or unduly burden interstate commerce. But the State A statute does not do so.

Educational objective: The dormant commerce clause bars states from enacting nondiscriminatory regulations that unduly burden interstate commerce. This occurs when the regulation's burden on interstate commerce clearly exceeds its legitimate, local benefits - eg, when it creates a risk of inconsistent regulations by different states.



选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 17%，C选项 1%，D选项 72%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据休眠商业条款(dormant commerce clause)，各州不得歧视或以其他方式过度加重州际商业的负担。如果一项州法规平等对待州内和州外的活动，那么它就不是歧视性的。但是，如果一项非歧视性法规对州际商业造成的负担明显超过其合法的本地利益，那么它就构成了过度负担。这种情况通常发生在不同州对同一活动存在不一致法规的风险时。

在此案中，A 州的法规不具歧视性，因为它对州内和州外实体的收购施加了同等负担。并且，该法规并未构成过度负担，因为不存在不同州制定不一致法规的风险。这是因为，正如最高法院在 CTS Corp. v. Dynamics Corp. of Am. 案中所论述的，公司通常受其注册所在州的法律管辖，而该法规仅管辖对 A 州公司的收购。因此，该法规是合宪的。

(选项 A 和 B) 该法规的目的是阻止州外实体收购 A 州公司。它也可能会阻碍拥有州外股东的公司进行收购——对州际证券销售产生不利影响。但该法规对州际商业的影响是允许的，因为它不具歧视性，也没有构成过度负担。

(选项 C) 如果管辖公司设立和收购的州法规歧视或过度加重州际商业的负担，商业条款的消极含义（即休眠商业条款）确实适用。但 A 州的法规并未如此。

教学目标：休眠商业条款禁止各州颁布非歧视性但过度加重州际商业负担的法规。当法规对州际商业的负担明显超过其合法的本地利益时（例如，当它造成不同州对同一问题制定不一致法规的风险时），就会发生这种情况。

References

  • U.S. Const. art. I, § 8, cl. 3 (commerce clause).
  • CTS Corp. v. Dynamics Corp. of Am., 481 U.S. 69, 88 - 91 (1987) (explaining that a nondiscriminatory law governing the acquisition of a state corporation does not unduly burden interstate commerce).
  • 15A Am. Jur. 2d Commerce § 39 (2019) (setting forth that a nondiscriminatory law violates the dormant commerce clause if its burdens on interstate commerce clearly exceed the law's local benefits).

MBE 考点解析

宪法：联邦与州的关系 (Federal-State Relations)
核心考点：休眠商业条款 (Dormant Commerce Clause) 即使联邦国会没有立法，宪法商业条款也隐含地限制了各州干预州际商业的权力。各州法规不得：
  1. 歧视州际商业 (Discriminate against interstate commerce)；或
  2. 对州际商业施加过度负担 (Undue burden)。
第一步：检查是否具有歧视性？

题目明确指出，该法规适用于“州内和州外实体 (both in-state and out-of-state entities)”。

因此，该法规是中立的 (neutral)，不具有表面上的歧视性。我们不能直接因为它是保护主义目的而判定其违宪，必须进行下一步分析。

第二步：是否施加了“过度负担”？

对于非歧视性法规，法院会进行 Pike 平衡测试：法规对州际商业的负担是否明显超过了其带来的本地利益？

这里最关键的判断标准是：是否存在不同州制定不一致法规的风险 (Risk of inconsistent regulations)？

⚖️ 关键判例：CTS Corp. v. Dynamics Corp. of Am. (1987)

最高法院裁定，州政府有权监管在其州内注册成立 (Incorporated) 的公司的内部治理。因为一家公司只能在一个州注册，所以只有一个州的法律适用。因此，不存在“不一致法规”的风险（例如，A州说必须这样做，B州说必须那样做）。
✅ 正确答案：D

为什么选 D？

  • 平等负担：法规对州内和州外收购者一视同仁（非歧视）。
  • 特定管辖范围：它仅监管在 A 州注册的公司 (State A corporations)。
  • 无冲突风险：根据公司法原则，只有注册地州有权监管公司内部事务（如股东投票权）。因此，不会出现其他州法律与此冲突的情况，不存在不可允许的监管冲突风险。

为什么其他选项错误？

  • A 错误： 仅有保护主义的“目的”不足以违宪，只要手段是非歧视的且未造成过度负担。州有权保护其公司治理结构的稳定性。
  • B 错误： 虽然法规确实会“阻碍”收购并影响证券销售，但这并不等同于宪法禁止的“过度负担”。只要没有监管冲突且利益（公司治理）大于负担，就是允许的。
  • C 错误： 这种说法太绝对。商业条款的消极含义（DCC）确实适用于公司法领域，只是在本案的具体事实下没有被违反。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 中遇到“反收购法规” (Anti-takeover statutes) 的题目时：

1. 检查法规是否仅适用于在该州注册 (Incorporated) 的公司。
2. 如果是，且对所有收购者一视同仁，该法规通常是合宪的。
3. 理由通常是：公司内部事务由注册地法管辖，不存在多州法律冲突的风险。

questions.question:
A federal statute authorizes a federal agency to issue rules requiring that state legislatures adopt laws of limited duration to reduce water pollution from gasoline-powered boat motors. The purpose of these rules is to assist the agency in attaining the clean water standards required by the statute.
After the agency issued such rules, several states filed an action challenging the rules on the sole ground that they are unconstitutional.
Should the court uphold the constitutionality of the agency's rules?

choices.a: No, because the federal government may not compel a state legislature to enact into state law a federally mandated regulatory program.
choices.b: No, because the Tenth Amendment grants states immunity from all direct federal regulation.
choices.c: Yes, because the rules serve an important purpose, and the requirements they impose on the states are only temporary and do not excessively interfere with the functioning of the state governments.
choices.d: Yes, because the supremacy clause of Article VI requires states to enforce federal law.
